title: Samadee Yoga Studio Aonang Krabi
ownerDescription:
Samadee Yoga & Retreat Aonang Krabi, for all yoga ethusiasts and spiritual seekers, offers a transformative journey that integrates body, mind, and soul. Nestled amidst the captivating landscape of Ao Nang, Krabi. We invites you to deepen your practice, embrace mindfulness, and find harmony through various yoga styles including Hatha, Vinyasa, Anusaranga, and more. Immerse yourself in an array of experiences, from sunrise and sunset beach yoga sessions to rejuvenating half-day and full-day retreats that combine yoga with spa treatments, nature immersion, and meditation. Immerse in the essence of yoga, embark on a transformative journey of self-discovery, and find your true essence at Samadee Yoga & Retreat Aonang Krabi.

reviews.name: Giorgia Vellucci
reviews.text: Ho fatto una lezione di ashtanga yoga e mi è piaciuta moltissimo. Il maestro è molto bravo e ti aiuta nelle posizioni più difficoltose. Lo consiglio a chi alloggia qui ad AO nang e vuole fare una bella lezione di yoga.
reviews.textTranslated: I took an Ashtanga yoga class and really enjoyed it. The instructor is very good and helps you with the more difficult poses. I recommend it to anyone staying here in Ao Nang and looking for a good yoga class.

reviews.name: Nagrani Wittwer
reviews.text: Las clases estuvieron geniales , pude aprender realmente de qué trata el ashtanga y fue bastante completa! También tome una clase de prana Flow Vinyasa! En ambos casos los profesores muy profesionales , con buena onda y el ambiente muy armónico. Hubiera tenido más días tomaba más clases !!
reviews.textTranslated: The classes were great! I really learned what Ashtanga is all about, and it was quite comprehensive! I also took a Prana Flow Vinyasa class! In both cases, the teachers were very professional, friendly, and the atmosphere was very harmonious. If I had more days, I would have taken more classes!

reviews.name: Kylah Pacamarra
reviews.text:
I took my first-ever Ashtanga class at Samadee Ao Nang as a beginner, and honestly, it humbled me—in the best way. 😅

I came in thinking I can just wing it, only to realise I still have so much to learn. Instead of discouraging me, though, it inspired me to become better and keep practicing.

The yoga master was excellent at teaching proper form and making corrections without disrupting the natural flow of the class. I really appreciated how attentive and knowledgeable he was.

A challenging but very rewarding first Ashtanga experience. I left humbled, inspired, and already wanting to come back and improve. 🧘🏻‍♀️🤍

Sumalee Boxing Gym offers Muay Thai and Yoga Training in Phuket with excellent standards of service, accommodation, facilities and food.

We offer a traditional Muay Thai training program and a mixed, varied style Yoga program. Both are specifically tailored to cater towards all levels of experience and abilities.

reviews.name: Scott Ko
reviews.text: I came to Phuket specifically for a Muay Thai training retreat and Sumalee provided exactly that. The trainers made the experience not just challenging, but also fun. The accommodation is clean, and the food here is healthy and nutritious. What I personally appreciate is that there aren't any bars or nightclubs or beaches nearby, meaning there's no distractions (but appreciate this might not be for everyone). So the packages that include meals on site were absolutely perfect for me. I'm looking forward to coming back!

reviews.name: Wesley Burton
reviews.text: Had a fantastic experience at Sumalee Muay Thai. The trainers were excellent — knowledgeable, motivating, and clearly passionate about the sport, whether you’re a beginner or more experienced. Beyond the training, the accommodation exceeded expectations: comfortable, clean rooms and a really nice pool to relax in after sessions. It’s a great setup for anyone wanting to combine a proper Muay Thai training camp with a comfortable stay. Highly recommend to anyone looking to train seriously while still enjoying a great place to unwind.

reviews.text: I was impressed by friendliness and excellent customer service of hotel staff. They remembered my name as well as my food and drink preferences which made me feel welcome. reviews.textTranslated: Not everything is clearly indicated on the hotel's website, which can lead to unpleasant surprises...

reviews.name: Büsra Dogan
reviews.text:
Wir hatten insgesamt einen schönen Aufenthalt im CC Hideaway. Besonders hervorheben möchte ich das freundliche und hilfsbereite Personal – alle Mitarbeiter waren wirklich herzlich und haben sich viel Mühe gegeben. Wer Ruhe sucht oder an den Yoga-Sessions teilnehmen möchte, ist hier gut aufgehoben.

Das Frühstück war in Ordnung und es gab täglich frisches Obst sowie die Möglichkeit, warme Speisen zu bestellen. Dennoch hätten wir uns insgesamt etwas mehr Auswahl und Abwechslung beim Buffet gewünscht.

Etwas schade fanden wir die Zimmerreinigung. Obwohl wir diese in Anspruch nehmen wollten, wurden während unseres Aufenthalts weder die Bettwäsche gewechselt noch die Handtücher ausgetauscht. Gleichzeitig wird im Hotel sehr darauf hingewiesen, dass keine Make-up-Flecken oder andere Flecken auf Bettwäsche und Handtüchern entstehen sollen. Da hätten wir uns beim Reinigungsservice etwas mehr erwartet.

Auch die Lage ist Geschmackssache. Das Hotel liegt recht abgelegen und aufgrund der steilen Zufahrt kam es bei einigen unserer gebuchten Touren zu Verzögerungen bei der Abholung, da Fahrer das Hotel nicht immer problemlos erreichen konnten. Wer hauptsächlich die Umgebung, Restaurants oder das Nachtleben erkunden möchte, sollte das berücksichtigen.

Insgesamt ist es ein gutes Hotel mit einer ruhigen Atmosphäre und sehr netten Mitarbeitern. Für einen entspannten Yoga- oder Erholungsurlaub können wir es empfehlen, für einen Aufenthalt mit vielen Ausflügen und Stadtbesuchen würden wir eher eine zentralere Unterkunft wählen.
reviews.textTranslated:
Overall, we had a lovely stay at CC Hideaway. I'd especially like to commend the friendly and helpful staff – everyone was genuinely welcoming and went out of their way to make us feel welcome. It's a great place for those seeking peace and quiet or wanting to participate in the yoga sessions.

Breakfast was adequate, with fresh fruit available daily and the option to order hot dishes. However, we would have appreciated a bit more variety and choice at the buffet.

We were somewhat disappointed with the room cleaning. Although we requested it, neither the bed linens nor the towels were changed during our stay. At the same time, the hotel clearly states that no makeup or other stains should be left on the bed linens and towels. We expected a bit more attention to detail from the cleaning service.

The location is also a matter of personal preference. The hotel is quite remote, and due to the steep access road, there were delays with pick-ups for some of our booked tours, as drivers sometimes had difficulty reaching the hotel. Those primarily interested in exploring the surrounding area, restaurants, or nightlife should keep this in mind.
... Overall, it's a good hotel with a peaceful atmosphere and very friendly staff. We can recommend it for a relaxing yoga or wellness holiday; however, for a stay with lots of excursions and city visits, we would suggest choosing more centrally located accommodation.

reviews.name: Christina Heath
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I’ve just finished 3.5 weeks at Action Point Phuket, and I miss it already!

What was planned as a trip of a lifetime with friends to celebrate our 40th birthdays exceeded every expectation and then some. ❤️

Action Point is truly something special. Whether you arrive with friends or travel solo, the community is incredibly welcoming and inclusive. You can participate as much or as little as you like, and everything is taken care of — you just need to show up!

From the amazing selection of meals and protein shakes to classes covering cardio, HIIT, strength, mobility and recovery, there’s something for everyone. Add one-on-one PT, Muay Thai, hot and cold therapy, and massages to ease those hard-working muscles, and you have the perfect balance of challenge, recovery and relaxation.

The accommodation is clean, modern, spacious and comfortable, and the team who look after you are nothing short of exceptional.

There’s so much more I could say about what an incredible experience this has been. I can absolutely see why so many guests return time and time again. I can’t recommend Action Point highly enough and am already looking forward to my next visit! 🌴❤️

reviews.name: Mark Tozer
reviews.text:
I had an amazing two week stay at Action Point. There is a wide variety of classes/experiences so you can tailor your stay to your specific needs and the coaches are incredibly knowledgeable (shout out Jany and Angelos). Every single staff member goes out of their way to make sure you are getting what you want from your stay.

The rooms are spacious and comfortable with everything you need, with options to stay in the main building or a villa a few doors down from the gym.

I was particularly impressed with the food. As a vegan, I normally go into things with low expectations, but I enjoyed everything I ate while staying at Action Point. There is a dedicated vegan menu and the cooks are happy to make adjustments to any non-vegan menu items to make them suitable. All meals are healthy, protein focussed and most importantly, tasty (but you better enjoy tofu).

Overall, it offers great value and I would definitely stay again.

reviews.name: Nivi Thyagarajan
reviews.text:
A wonderful property with a personal touch! We enjoyed our weekend at Mangosteen very much! Rooms were spacious and very comfortable. Loved that Rawai was just a few minutes away by car. We were on a weekend wellness package which was lovely and appreciate that we would have alternative options for food if the set menus didn’t appeal.
My only opportunity for improvement is with the massage choice. Coming to an Ayurveda resort, we expected our wellness package to include Ayurvedic options. Instead our massage choices were more traditional massages. Would suggest to include if people would like to try.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Nivi,

thank you so much for your lovely review! 😊

I'm delighted that you and your friends enjoyed your weekend at Mangosteen and appreciated the spacious villas, peaceful atmosphere, and personal touch that we try to bring to everything we do.

It's also wonderful to hear that you enjoyed the flexibility of our dining options. We believe that healthy eating should always be enjoyable, and we're happy to accommodate individual preferences.

Thank you also for your suggestion regarding Ayurveda treatments. I completely understand your expectations when visiting an Ayurveda resort, so perhaps I can clarify the difference between our programs.

Our shorter wellness retreats are designed to offer a relaxing introduction to the Mangosteen experience, combining spa treatments, yoga, healthy cuisine, and time to unwind. Our dedicated Ayurveda programs, on the other hand, are more comprehensive and individually designed by our resident Ayurveda doctors. They involve a different treatment structure and considerably more therapist time, which is naturally reflected in the program pricing.

Guests on our shorter wellness packages are always welcome to add individual Ayurveda treatments if they would like to experience them, subject to availability. Perhaps we should make this distinction a little clearer when guests book, so thank you for bringing it to our attention.

Most importantly, I'm very happy that you had such an enjoyable weekend with us. Hopefully, next time you'll have a little more time to stay and perhaps discover the deeper side of Ayurveda as well! 🌿

Warm regards,

Hajo
Owner, Mangosteen Ayurveda & Wellness Resort

reviews.name: 謝語姍
reviews.text:
Please evaluate carefully before making a reservation here. Be warned: if you don't join 7 days' wellness program, your booking might not be respected.
​I am extremely disappointed with Mangosteen's booking policy. On October 10th, I tried to reserve a 4-day Ayurveda package for January 26th of next year. Despite trying to book more than three months in advance for an 18,000 THB package, customer service informed me that January is their peak season and they prioritize all time slots for 7-day wellness program guests.
​I was told to check back in early January—just about three weeks before my planned arrival—to see if there were any remaining slots available. This is a completely unreasonable arrangement. It essentially forces international guests to book flights and accommodations first, and then gamble on whether they can actually get the treatment they are traveling for. This policy is incredibly unfriendly to overseas tourists and shows a severe lack of basic hospitality consideration.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Guest,

Thank you for sharing your concerns. I am sorry that our reservation policy has caused disappointment, but I would like to clarify a few important points, as your review may give future guests the wrong impression.

Mangosteen is primarily an Ayurveda & Wellness Retreat Resort, offering a variety of residential wellness programs. During our peak season, our doctors, therapists and spa facilities are heavily booked, and we naturally need to prioritize guests who are staying at the resort and have reserved complete retreat programs.

We also warmly welcome outside guests whenever capacity allows. However, particularly during the busy January season, we can only confirm spa appointments for non-resident guests approximately 2–3 days in advance, once we know our actual availability. This is not intended to inconvenience anyone, but simply to ensure that we can deliver the treatments and services already committed to our resident guests.

I would also like to clarify that we did not cancel or refuse any confirmed reservation. Your inquiry was made more than three months in advance, and our team explained that we could not guarantee availability for an external Ayurveda package that far ahead during peak season.

There is certainly no obligation to book a seven-day program. We offer different retreat durations, but our residential wellness programs naturally take priority over bookings without accommodation.

I fully understand that international travelers prefer to plan their holidays well in advance. However, it would be unfair to accept a reservation that we might later be unable to honor. We believe that being transparent about our availability from the beginning is the more responsible approach.

We would genuinely be happy to welcome you to Mangosteen if our spa schedule allows, and I hope this explanation helps you better understand our policy.

Warm regards,

Hajo
Owner, Mangosteen Ayurveda & Wellness Resort

reviews.name: Snap Pea
reviews.text: Horrific place with bad owners. Run down rooms, bad service and people who enter your space without permission.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Guest,

We are sorry to see yet another negative review concerning your stay, but we feel it is important to clarify a few facts for future readers.

Regarding your accusation that our staff entered your room without permission: You contacted our reception because you had forgotten the code to your in-room safe and requested assistance. Our team responded promptly. However, after requesting help, you left the room before our staff arrived.

For security and transparency, our standard procedure in such situations is that three team members from housekeeping and maintenance attend together. Their sole purpose was to assist with the safe, as you had requested. Nothing inappropriate occurred.

As for your comments about the owners, we understand that you were disappointed when you decided to check out early and your request for a refund was declined. However, an early departure does not automatically entitle a guest to a refund, and our booking conditions still apply.

We take genuine criticism very seriously and always welcome constructive feedback. However, we also believe that public reviews should present events fairly and accurately.

We regret that your stay did not work out as expected and wish you all the best.

Warm regards,

Hajo
Owner, Mangosteen Ayurveda & Wellness Resort

reviews.name: Surabhi G
reviews.text:
I had a mixed experience with Island Yoga during my visit.

My Yin & Restorative session with Marina was wonderful - thoughtful sequencing, a calming atmosphere, and exactly the kind of restorative practice I was hoping for. I'd happily recommend her sessions to anyone.

Unfortunately, a drop-in morning session with the teacher on 03/09 left a very different impression. The class jumped straight into practice without any introduction, which felt a little impersonal but is understandably a matter of teaching style. What was harder to look past was being singled out during a partner exercise (Warrior pose) - I have some coordination difficulty, especially when attention is directly on me, and the teacher commented in front of the whole class that I was "very beginner" and needed a lot of attention. In many years of practicing yoga, I've never had an instructor call out a student's ability publicly like that, and it really took away from the experience.

Island Yoga clearly has excellent teachers - Marina's session was a highlight of my trip - but I'd suggest more consistency in how instructors handle beginners or corrections, ideally with a quieter, more private approach.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Surabhi,
Thank you for taking the time to give your feedback, we value every students' experience and take them into consideration. We are sorry you felt called out during the class, the purpose of mentioning the kind of adjustment needed as a beginner was aimed at bringing awareness while doing so, it was not directed to you personally but just as an example of good practice. 
We understand that this might have compromised your experience of the class, and we take seriously our students' wellbeing and feelings. We hope you will come back again to practice with us. All the best for now by Island Yoga team

The food is delicious and always fresh and clean. The front desk staff are incredibly friendly — they feel like family. The restaurant team is just as warm and welcoming.

reviews.name: Stien Vermote
reviews.text:
We had such a peaceful and rejuvenating stay at Oasis Yoga Bungalows in Koh Lanta. It truly has everything you need to unwind and feel at home. Only a 2-minute walk to the beach, yet surrounded by calm and nature, it’s the perfect balance.

The food and coffee were absolutely delicious, and the swimming pool area was ideal for relaxing. The bedrooms are spacious, clean, and very comfortable, with a strong focus on sustainability throughout the property.

We especially loved the eco-friendly touches: reusable drink bottles are provided and can be refilled not just at Oasis, but around the whole island! Such a thoughtful initiative! They also recycle and give you the choice of whether you want your room refreshed during your stay, which we really appreciated.

A special thank you to Nok, who took incredible care of us. She knew everything, nothing was ever too much, and she made us feel truly welcome and looked after. An absolute gem of a person!

The yoga classes with Carina were amazing as well; grounding, energising, and the perfect addition to such a serene environment.

We would absolutely recommend Oasis Yoga Bungalows to anyone looking for a relaxing, conscious, and welcoming retreat. 🌿

reviews.name: Carly Noy
reviews.text: I stayed at Oasis Yoga Bungalows for one week and had a wonderful trip. The food was incredible (everything, including the yummy smoothies), the location was ideal (2 minute walk to the beach and close to town ie. 7/11, massages, pharmacy, convenience store etc). The rooms were spacious and comfortable, the staff were professional, friendly and incredibly helpful and the yoga space was perfect for those who want to participate in the yoga classes. The pool area was relaxing (the water could have been a bit colder but that’s okay!) and there were other areas around the property where guests could relax. Air conditioners were in all rooms which made the stay even more comfortable. The dining area was spacious and there were a lot of different options for the buffet breakfast. I would recommend staying here if you want somewhere close to the beach and a relaxing stay in Ko Lanta.

title: Similan Diving Safaris PADI 5* Dive Center
ownerDescription:
Similan Diving Safaris is an eco-friendly western/ Thai managed Dive Center in Khao Lak.
Our Liveaboard boat the M/V Dolphin Queen makes 3 day and 5 day trips to Similan Islands, Koh Bon, Koh Tachai, Surin Islands and the world-famous Richelieu Rock.
address: 9, 16 Phet Kasem Rd, Khao Lak, Takua Pa District, Phang Nga 82220, Thailand
plusCode: J7V2+QM Khuek Khak, Takua Pa District, Phang Nga, Thailand

reviews.name: lara ivk
reviews.text:
Worst Diving Trip Experience – Avoid at All Costs
I booked a 6 day liveaboard diving trip that turned into the worst experience of my life, entirely preventable if the staff had prioritized safety and respect. From the start, there was zero regard for diver safety, and the crew showed blatant disrespect toward women. I was yelled at constantly for no reason, treated poorly, and even trapped on the boat despite initially being told I could leave.

Five people were injured during the trip due to glaring lack of safety precautions. Alex, the French dive guide, refused to let me use my own dive computer for a conservative 5 minute safety stop. What harm could 2 extra minutes do? This not only ruined the trip but blocked my computer, preventing me from logging my dives properly. Alex complained nonstop about being assigned too many divers (5 of us) and was exhausted from back to back trips but that doesn't justify his hostile attitude, especially toward a female diver. I never felt safe. Other divers had equipment issues; mine was fine.

Luis handled situations just as poorly, amplifying the lack of respect. Dive sites were chosen based on traffic rather than quality most were empty (just us or one other boat), with nothing to see. The crowded Richelieu Rock was the highlight. we also skipped the famous Similan Islands they advertise and promise.
If you don't care about safety, being disrespected, or subpar sites, this might be for you. Otherwise, steer clear this could have been great without the staff's toxic attitude.

The best part was meeting wonderful divers from around the world who were super nice and sweet, plus the amazing food.

Update:
the 5 people that got injured are the photographer got hit with the weight belt on the head and had to go to the hospital when we got back to get stitches. The German woman cut her leg on the boat with the metal piece from the ladder on the rooftop. The Swiss girl couldn’t dive the last 4 days, and Mike couldn’t join of the dives on the last 2 days.

It was me who requested to leave on the day 3 and I even packed all my things super fast, then I was told that there are no speedboats to take me back despite them telling me before I started packing that they sent someone to pick me up. The only thing that kept me on that boat are the friends I made from around the world.

Be aware! The quality of service has drastically dropped for this place this year, this is coming from the people who had done this trip before, check the very recent reviews and good luck!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ahah I have been wondering when you would leave a review. You were honestly the worst guest we have had since I can remember - the negativity began straight away and it was clear nothing would ever be good enough for you - it is so rare to have someone join us that makes all our staff miserable & completely ruin the atmosphere for other guests - not even the other guests wanted you in their groups.

And then to make it worse you come on here and start lying about the trip to try and get some moral high ground. Hope it makes you happy whilst you sit at home inventing stories.

5 people injured in a trip, thats simply a ridiculous claim! 

Majority of our guests are women so pretty confident if we had some sort of misogynistic crew on board we would know about it, but nice try and making us try to sound bad.

I had a very specific phone call with you and I said are welcome to come back to land if you are not happy we have a speedboat arranged for you and I will return your money - which you said "no no I don't want to leave" - fair enough then you can stay and we will try our best as always - then to come on here and say you were trapped on board, wow oh wow.

We are having a competition at the end of the season for worst guest of the decade, we invite you to come and collect your trophy, but please don't come near the boat again or the staff might quit.

reviews.name: Simon Brix Justesen
reviews.text:
Everything was pretty good overall, except for my dive guide, whose behavior was very unprofessional and could potentially have led to a dangerous situation.

Before the dive, he emphasized that safety comes first and that he would be there for everyone, and so on. However, once we actually started diving, his attitude changed completely.

I experienced a panic attack because he didn’t listen to my needs (descending slowly and staying relatively close as a group, at least in the beginning). When I was struggling at around 10 meters deep, he made a gesture as if to say, “oh no, now what, come on.” I decided to end the dive and got out of the water, while he continued diving.

When he came back up, I explained how I had experienced the situation. His only response was: “I got you up and out of the water.” There was no apology or any sign of understanding, even though I had just gone through a very unpleasant experience.

Diving should be enjoyable, but only when everyone feels safe. A dive guide should never make someone feel like the weak link.

The dive guide’s name is Miklos. From what I understand, the divers - more experienced than me with 50 dives - didn’t have any issues with him. However, if you are less experienced or prefer a guide who shows empathy and support, I would recommend choosing someone else.

Apart from that, most things were pretty good. The boat was great, the rooms were nice, the local staff were friendly, the food was plentiful and good, the equipment was in good condition, and the trip was well organized.

Update after the response: In this case 1 star is 10 too many. You implying that good food and organization should add stars says a lot, really.

Normally I don't do negative reviews, but this case is so serious, potentially fatal, so your future guests deserves to know his name as well as his collegues shouldn't be suspected.

Well good, let me know what he tells ya - you have my number. My experience was not blurred by the panic attack, as the attack came from Miklos' poor reaction, so after. I remember very clearly what happened.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Simon, Thanks for the review, 1 star's seems a little harsh considering you claim everything was good except your relationship with your guide.

Shame to see you call him out personally like that when we have so many fantastic reviews and comments about Miklos including how accommodating he is to all guests and how incredibly safety conscious he is!

We will be sure to speak to Miklos and get his side of events regarding your panic attack - as we all know not to leave anyone alone in the water whether on the surface or during a dive. Perhaps your state of mind at the time clouded your judgement of reality.

Everyone has different dive styles and sometime people just don't vibe with each other - this is why we put you into a different group after the 2nd dive so everyone could have a better trip overall.

En résumé pas de problème juste des bulles ! (on etait prévenu)
reviews.textTranslated:
A 2-day cruise with 6 dives. The organization was top-notch. Jamie provided excellent online support and helpful advice.

reviews.textTranslated: I was worried because there were no reviews, but I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for scuba or freediving lessons in Bangkok!!! Classes are available in English. It looks far from downtown, but you can get there in 20 minutes by taxi, and the price is reasonable, so I was very satisfied👍 The best part was that the instructors were incredibly kind and treated me like a friend; it was even better because I felt like I made good friends while just coming for freediving! It’s great that it’s a PADI-certified institution, and even though I was worried since it was my first time, they were willing to give me extra time to practice and learn if I was lacking, which was fantastic! Places in downtown Bangkok try to finish everything in one day, but here they take 2-3 days to help me, which was so good. If you are interested in diving, please, please learn here!!

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your honest feedback ☺️

reviews.name: Sriprach Saetang
reviews.text:
One of the Top instructor in Thailand I completed both my Open Water and Advanced courses with Kru Sanya, Kru Rose, Kru Julia —my very first diving experience—and I couldn’t have asked for a better place to start.

From the beginning, I felt genuinely safe and well taken care of. The instructors maintain a very high standard of teaching, with strong attention to detail and professionalism throughout the course. There is also a dedicated support team assisting during training, ensuring everything runs smoothly and comfortably.

The equipment is clean, well-maintained, and fully prepared, which adds a lot of confidence, especially for beginners. As a dive shop, they also offer a great selection of quality gear at reasonable prices. What stands out is the personalized advice—they take the time to recommend equipment that truly fits your needs and diving style, rather than just selling products.

Overall, this is a highly reliable place for both learning how to dive and purchasing diving equipment. I would strongly recommend it to anyone looking to start or advance their diving journey.

reviews.name: John
reviews.text:
Sanya from Innovative Divers was my instructor for a GUE course I completed last week. While I can’t speak to his SSI classes, I can confidently share my experience with him as a GUE instructor.
Is Sanya’s teaching style for everyone? Probably not. But would I recommend him to any friend who genuinely wants to grow as a diver? Absolutely—without hesitation.
If you’re looking for a relaxed, easygoing class where simply attempting a skill earns you a pat on the back, or if your goal is just to “pay for a permit to dive,” this is not the place for you. Sanya takes training and mentorship extremely seriously. He challenges you—almost always pushes you well outside your comfort zone—and he does it with purpose: to help you identify weaknesses, refine your technique, and build solid, reliable diving habits.
With his ~20 years of experience, there wasn’t a single diving-related question he couldn’t answer. If you’re seeking deeper understanding, the “why” behind the “how,” or the theoretical framework that makes GUE’s approach so respected, you will absolutely get that from Sanya.
I’m not going to pretend it was an easy week; it wasn’t. But it was, without question, one of the most rewarding learning experiences I’ve ever had. If your goal is to truly master this sport and understand it at a foundational level, I believe you’ll walk away feeling the same.

reviews.text: I had an amazing experience learning with Kru Sanya.  Safety was always the top priority, and every step was explained clearly and thoroughly.  The instructor was patient, attentive, and very supportive, which made me feel confident and relaxed underwater. Thank you❤️♥️

reviews.name: M Burns
reviews.text:
I stayed at Atmanjai for almost three weeks and I couldn’t speak more positively of my experience. I was shown such incredible kindness, patience,
care and compassion. Every day, the staff brought happiness, positivity and warmth,
often in the smallest ways — a smile, a kind word, a helping hand, or simply being
there when I needed it.
This was a very meaningful and sometimes difficult journey for me. I had
been working through childhood trauma, physical pain and emotional pain, while
also completing a full detox and giving myself the time and space to heal.
I could not have asked for a more caring group of people to share this experience
with. Both staff and other guests participating in varying forms of wellness.
I was made to feel welcomed, safe and supported. The wellness team’s kindness has
touched me deeply, and I will carry the memories of their smiles, laughter and
generosity with me long after I leave Thailand.
I couldn’t be more thankful for everything they did for me — not only for the professional care they provided, but for the genuine warmth and humanity I was shown throughout my stay.
They each played a very important part in my journey, and I am
incredibly grateful.
I left feeling happier, more positive and hopeful about the future. I know
there is still work for me to do, but I leave with a renewed sense of strength and
gratitude.
My program.
Eat well
Juice cleanse
14 days ultra detox
Juice cleanse
3 days of eat well.
I completed all the groups sessions and did one on one sessions with Karn (what an extraordinary lady), Maria for trauma release breathwork and Aileen for Reiki (emotional release) and the Shaman.
I went expecting a better functioning digestive system and improve gut function. To confront, address and close so many painful chapters was something I didn’t think was possible.
Literally a life changing experience for me.

You are worth the investment. 🥰
Good luck.

Oh. And the raw vegan food 😋 “Arroy Mak”!

reviews.textTranslated: “After only 4 days of classes, my migraines are gone, and the abdominal and leg pain from menstruation is gone. I can walk and do normal activities again. It's so surprising how much yoga has helped me.” Let me share my experience: I usually suffer from migraines. Before my period, I get headaches for 3 days in advance and have to take Ponstan. reviews.text:
Das private Training war super und zudem individuell, motivierend und hat richtig viel Spaß gemacht. Ich bin Muay Thai Anfänger und obwohl die beiden mich die ganze Zeit super motiviert und genau richtig gefordert haben, habe ich die vollen zwei Stunden körperlich nicht geschafft.Obwohl ich immer weiter wollte. Das zeigt aber eher, wie effektiv das Training war. 😄

Vor allem waren die beiden menschlich einfach klasse und haben eine richtig angenehme Atmosphäre geschaffen.

Meine Freundin hat anfangs nur zugeschaut. Die beiden haben sie dann aber auf eine sympathische Art überzeugt, doch mitzumachen.
Genau so, wie ich es mir insgeheim erhofft hatte. 😄 Am Ende hatten wir beide eine großartige Zeit.

Insgesamt war es eine unvergessliche Erfahrung. Vielen Dank. Ich komme auf jeden Fall wieder!
reviews.textTranslated:
The private training was fantastic—personalized, motivating, and a lot of fun. I'm a Muay Thai beginner, and even though they kept me incredibly motivated and challenged me perfectly, I couldn't physically manage the full two hours, even though I wanted to keep going. But that just goes to show how effective the training was! 😄

Above all, they were both wonderful people and created a really pleasant atmosphere.

My girlfriend initially just watched, but they charmingly persuaded her to join in.

Just as I'd secretly hoped! 😄 In the end, we both had a great time.

Overall, it was an unforgettable experience. Thank you so much! I'll definitely be back!

reviews.name: Adrian
reviews.text: My wife and I just trained with Nick and Beau for 4 weeks every morning at 9am we were greeted by both with encouragement and one to one training focusing on learning the best technique and respecting the art of Muay Thai. We are both beginners but improved steadily over the weeks. We both feel we have made friends for life and really feel that our mental and physical health has improved. I urge everyone to give this a go. Strangely I have less aches and pains than before we started. Nick and beau are patient and very knowledgeable and go out of their way to encourage any efforts made. Give it a go whatever your age (I’m 62) you won’t regret it. Thanks to you both 🙏

reviews.name: Cameron Taylor
reviews.text:
Found this gem of a muay thai gym during my stay in yao noi and wish I found it earlier, had a couple of sessions with nick and have my final session is tomorrow.
Nick is a fantastically patient and enthusiastic Instructor, who will push you hard in the session, technique is everything here as nick explained, no point in speeding up if the technique is not right.
Having done over 35 years in martial arts it was awesome to be a student again and empty my cup and fill it with new ideas and concepts.
Thank you nick for your inspiration and motivation.
I hope we cross paths again.

reviews.name: Coastal57320682726
reviews.text: I am currently partway through a 10-day water fasting/detox program at Santosa and wanted to share my experience so far. I will update this review after completing my stay.||Unfortunately, the biggest issue has been the lack of organization, communication and structure. When booking a dedicated fasting retreat, particularly for 10 days, I expected a structured program where guests were guided through the process and knew what was happening each day. Instead, I have repeatedly found myself trying to locate staff, asking what is happening and requesting things that I expected would be routinely organized.||On several occasions I have walked from my accommodation to the wellness centre looking for someone and been unable to find staff. When you are several days into a water fast and your energy is limited, having to repeatedly walk back and forth simply to find assistance is frustrating.||Even drinking water became an issue. One afternoon I advised staff at approximately 3:00 p.m. that I needed more water. Adequate drinking water should be one of the most basic things available during a water-fast program.||I also experienced dizziness during the fast and had previously asked about electrolytes. I was initially told they did not use them and that coconut water was what they provided. I later discovered that electrolyte products were actually available at the facility, which was frustrating considering I had already been experiencing dizziness.||Other parts of the program have lacked follow-through. My pH testing, which was discussed as part of the program, had still not been completed several days into my stay. I asked about taking body measurements and staff were still looking into finding a tape measure. These aren’t major things individually, but collectively they contribute to the feeling that there isn’t a well-organized system behind the program.||There ARE positives. I have enjoyed some of the yoga, massages and wellness activities, and the other guests have spoken very highly about the food. My criticism isn’t directed at everything about the property or the individual staff members. The primary problem is how the program itself is being organized and delivered.||I became frustrated enough that I asked to shorten my stay and complete my fast at home, where I have reliable access to water, quieter surroundings and everything I need. I requested a partial refund for the unused portion but was told that once the program begins it cannot be shortened. I have therefore decided to complete the full 10 days and have now specifically requested a much more structured schedule so I can actually make use of everything included in the program.||For what I paid, I expected considerably more organization and proactive support from a specialist fasting retreat.||I genuinely hope the remainder of the program improves. I will update this review after checkout to reflect the complete experience.

reviews.name: Béa L.
reviews.text:
J'ai fait appel à Greg en e-coaching 5 mois avant de me lancer sur mon premier marathon, la course à pied n'étant absolument pas mon sport habituel. 😅
Même si ça semblait "mission impossible" dans de telles circonstances 😉, il a relevé ce défi mené à distance et s'est impliqué semaine après semaine à adapter les entraînements à mon emploi du temps personnel, professionnel, à mes résultats et à mon état physique et psychique.
La sincérité de l'échange est essentielle entre coach et élève et a fonctionné à merveille, même en cas d'avis différencié. 😁
Il a réussi à m'apprendre à courir à la sensation, à me faire progresser, à écouter encore mieux mon corps, savoir et sentir de quoi on est capable selon l'objectif recherché.
Le suivi des résultats est très clair.
La visio mensuelle permet de faire un bon point sur les runs et les sensations physiques du mois écoulé, tout en y ajoutant des exercices de yoga adaptés à soi et à ses besoins.
Il m'a accompagnée à distance, par messages, jusque pendant la course et ... j'ai fini mon premier marathon, fatiguée, fourbue, mais non blessée et tellement heureuse!! 🤩 🤩🤩
Alors je continue avec lui pour progresser sur des courses à venir de moindre distance, parce qu'on ne peut que continuer à s'améliorer!
Et parce que, même en étant à des milliers de kilomètres, Greg est super présent.
N'hésitez pas à lui faire confiance!
reviews.textTranslated:
I contacted Greg for online coaching five months before my first marathon, as running was definitely not my usual sport. 😅
Even though it seemed like "mission impossible" under those circumstances 😉, he took on this challenge remotely and dedicated himself week after week to adapting the training sessions to my personal and professional schedule, my results, and my physical and mental state.
The honest communication between coach and student is essential and worked wonderfully, even when we had differing opinions. 😁
He succeeded in teaching me to run by feel, helping me progress, listening to my body even better, and understanding and feeling what I'm capable of depending on my goal.
The progress tracking is very clear.
The monthly video call allows us to review the runs and physical sensations of the past month, while also incorporating yoga exercises tailored to each individual and their needs. He supported me remotely, through messages, right up until the race, and... I finished my first marathon, tired, exhausted, but uninjured and so happy!! 🤩🤩🤩 So I'm continuing to work with him to improve in upcoming shorter races, because there's no getting any better!

And because, even though he's thousands of kilometers away, Greg is incredibly supportive.
Don't hesitate to trust him!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Merci Béatrice pour ce retour très détaillé. Il est vrai que ta préparation marathon semblait "mission impossible" mais nous avons réussi à relever ce défi en adoptant et en innovant😉 ! Les autres défis running ne devraient être que de simples formalités 😊 !

reviews.text: Gregory is an exceptional running and yoga coach. He has transformed my breathing and stride technique, which has allowed me to run faster and longer with confidence and skill. I highly recommend him!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Caitlin! That’s because you chose the best combination — personal running and yoga sessions. It really makes a difference! This is just the beginning !

reviews.name: Manon S
reviews.text:
Feb 2025: I'm updating my review a year later, as I do know Greg better now, as a teacher and more personally.
He is a fantastic teacher. Very intuitive, very connected. I recently needed help with a particular issue, and he was able to help me so much, and to make me notice a few things I was doing with my body, that I was totally unaware of. He always tailors the classes to my needs and mood. He knows to push me, but also understands when I need modifications or a break! If I had time, I would take classes every day. I always feel great after.
I wouldn't hesitate to recommend Greg to anyone who wants to practise yoga to feel better, who wants to understand their body better, and who simply aspires to be more mindful. My classes with Greg are usually slow-paced, but it doesn't mean everything is easy! Far from it! I do feel the stretches for at least a couple of days after and classes always leave me in a good mood. I feel that Greg incarnates the true spirit of yoga!

End of 2023: I've been doing yoga with Greg for about 3 months now and I really enjoy his classes. They're less intense than some of the classes I took in the past, and it's exactly what I need now. There's always some breathing and meditation time, which I really appreciate. The asanas we do are different every time, which I also really like, as it doesn't get boring!
Greg is really nice and chill, the studio is bright and clean, and if you're lucky, you get to pet some cats on the way up and again on the way down 😁 I usually chat a bit with Nha after class, in French, and she's also very sweet and chill. They both are animal lovers, have rescued a few cats, take care of some soi dogs, and I believe it says a lot about them! Great little business in Koh Keaw, with very reasonable prices, run by kind people.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Manon for all these compliments!!!!

วิ่งทุกวัน ทำไมกล้ามเนื้อยังไม่กระชับสักที? ไขข้อข้องใจพร้อมวิธีสร้างหุ่นเฟิร์มอย่างยั่งยืน

หลายคนตั้งใจออกกำลังกายด้วยการวิ่งเป็นประจำเพราะอยากมีหุ่นเฟิร์มกระชับ แม้ว่า Cardio (การคาร์ดิโอ) จะช่วยเผาผลาญแคลอรี ลดไขมัน และ เสริมสร้างความแข็งแรงให้หัวใจและปอดได้ดีเยี่ยม

แต่รู้ไหมครับว่า... การวิ่งเพียงอย่างเดียวอาจไม่ได้ช่วยรักษามวลกล้ามเนื้อ และ บางครั้งยังสะสมอาการตึงตามข้อต่อ สะโพก หรือหลังด้านล่างอีกด้วย

💡 3 องค์ประกอบสำคัญเพื่อสุขภาพและการสร้างรูปร่างที่สมบูรณ์แบบ
หากคุณต้องการให้ร่างกายแข็งแรง รูปร่างสมส่วน สัดส่วนกระชับ และ เคลื่อนไหวได้ดีในระยะยาว ร่างกายต้องการการดูแลที่ครบ 3 ด้าน
1. Cardio (การวิ่ง / คาร์ดิโอ) เน้นเบิร์นแคลอรี ลดไขมัน เสริมความแข็งแรงให้หัวใจและปอด
2. Strength Training (การสร้างกล้ามเนื้อ) รักษามวลกล้ามเนื้อ กระชับสัดส่วน และเพิ่มการเผาผลาญ
3. Mobility & Flexibility (พิลาทิส / ยืดเหยียด) เพิ่มความยืดหยุ่น เพิ่มช่วงการเคลื่อนไหวของข้อต่อ และลดอาการตึงสะสม

START YOUR JOURNEY ✨ ปรับสรีระ และ บุคลิกภาพให้สง่างามด้วยความสม่ำเสมอ กับ SOL Pilates สตูดิโอพิลาทิส ดินแดง

เพราะการเปลี่ยนแปลงรูปร่าง และ สร้างบุคลิกภาพที่ดี ไม่ใช่เรื่องของความรวดเร็ว แต่คือผลลัพธ์ของ ‘ความสม่ำเสมอ’ ที่คุณมอบให้กับตัวเองในทุกๆ สัปดาห์
จัดเวลาให้ร่างกายเพียงสัปดาห์ละ 2 ครั้ง เพื่อรีเซตโครงสร้างร่างกาย และ ก้าวขึ้นสู่เวอร์ชันที่ดีที่สุดของคุณทีละสเต็ป ผ่านโปรแกรม Classical Pilates (คลาสสิก พิลาทิส) ที่เราตั้งใจดูแลแบบ Private Pilates เพื่อปรับให้เข้ากับสรีระของคุณโดยเฉพาะ

🌱 STEP 1 : 1 WEEK (The Awakening) ร่างกายเริ่มปรับตัว ระบบไหลเวียนดีขึ้น และ รู้สึกตัวเบา สบายตัวอย่างเห็นได้ชัด 
💃 STEP 2 : 1 MONTH (The Transformation) กล้ามเนื้อแกนกลางชั้นลึกเริ่มจดจำ บุคลิกภาพดีขึ้น แผ่นหลังตรงและสง่างามขึ้น ปรับ Alignment ของกระดูกสันหลังและสะโพกให้สมดุล 
💪 STEP 3 : 3 MONTHS (The Mastery) แกนกลางลำตัว (Core Muscle) แข็งแกร่งอย่างชัดเจน สรีระเฟิร์มกระชับ และ คล่องตัวในทุกท่วงท่า ลดอาการปวดหลัง และ อาการปวดเมื่อยเรื้อรัง (Office Syndrome)
ให้ SOL Pilates เป็น Routine ใหม่ของคุณ ยินดีต้อนรับผู้ที่กำลังมองหา ร้านพิลาทิส ใกล้ฉัน ในย่านดินแดง-อโศก

reviews.textTranslated:
🫶🏻I'm very impressed with the teachers, equipment, and the location. Most importantly, the teachers are incredibly dedicated. They constantly seek out new knowledge and training to share with their students, possessing extensive experience. They know our bodies better than we know our own! The equipment is top-notch and always up-to-date. I've been a student there since the studio was small until it expanded. They offer both Pilates and Yoga. I took classical yoga with Teacher Kao and loved it! I've been learning from pregnancy through childbirth and even now that my child is grown.

The location is excellent and very convenient, with easy access from multiple routes including behind Mega Bangna, Nam Daeng, and Bangna Road. There's parking and shower facilities.

ในเรื่องของความสะอาดและความสะดวกสบายในการจอดรถ ให้100/100 ทั้งสะอาด และจอดรถได้บริเวณสตู จะฝนตกแดดออกก้ไม่ต้องลำบากเดินไกล เข้าคลาสทันเวลาแน่นอนค่าาาา 😆😆
reviews.textTranslated:
From my personal experience, I started my first ever Pilates class here, initially choosing private lessons. After my first class, the instructor suggested I try a group class. My first impression was that the instructor assessed and advised me honestly, without hard-selling me courses. This made me feel comfortable and at ease. Since then, I've consistently taken group classes. For anyone looking to try a class or wanting a change of pace to a homey studio atmosphere, I highly recommend this place. You definitely won't feel uncomfortable after a class.

They have a good variety of classes and times to choose from. Each instructor has their own teaching style, but what they all have in common is their attentiveness and keen, observant gaze—like a hawk, surprisingly quick!

Because classes only have a maximum of 4 people, the instructors can provide thorough attention and adjust your posture. Another thing I love is that even if there are fewer than 4 people in a class, the instructors will still teach; they won't cancel or cancel the session. It feels just like a private lesson!

Regarding cleanliness and parking convenience, I give it 100/100. It's very clean, and there's parking right by the studio, so you don't have to walk far whether it's raining or sunny. I'll definitely be in class on time! 😆😆

reviews.textTranslated:
We rented an office at Workstories, and let me tell you, it was more than worth the price!
If you're looking for office space or workspace in the heart of the city, I highly recommend Workstories. It's truly excellent!
We were impressed from the start by the location. It's very convenient, close to the BTS Phloen Chit station, and they even have a golf cart shuttle service – super convenient, no need to walk in the sun or rain.
The main reasons we chose to rent here were the affordable price and the comprehensive free services:
Free use of meeting rooms – no extra charge for meetings with the team or clients.
Free printing – saving a lot on office expenses.
A shared co-working space – perfect for a change of scenery when you're tired of your own desk. The atmosphere is great for brainstorming.
In short, you pay a budget-friendly price but get all the amenities of a larger office. If you're looking for an office in the Phloen Chit area, I highly recommend Workstories – you won't be disappointed!

reviews.text:
It's a nice space with all the right equipment. However this one in particular has an issue with sound traveling up and down the stairs and permeating throughout the entire building.

The staff are very sensitive to it, to the point they told me to stop coughing (I had a cold but was trying my best) and later interrupted me during an important team meeting complaining it was too noisy.

So, great for travellers who work alone with headphones on, but if you need to interact with colleagues, find somewhere with more appropriate facilities and sound-proofing.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Harvey,

Thank you for your feedback, and we’re sorry that your experience didn’t meet your expectations.

As a relatively small coworking space, we do have to enforce strict noise policies to ensure all guests can work comfortably. Due to the layout of the building, sound can travel between floors more easily than we’d like, so our team occasionally needs to address noise issues when they affect other members.

We certainly didn’t intend to make you feel uncomfortable, and we appreciate that you were doing your best while unwell.

For phone calls, meetings, or conversations with colleagues, we provide phone booths and meeting rooms specifically designed for those situations, helping everyone balance collaboration with the quiet environment many of our members rely on.

Thank you again for visiting and for sharing your thoughts. Your feedback helps us continue improving the experience for all our guests.

They also provide complimentary snacks and beverages, including coffee, tea, and drinking water.

There is no free parking though.  They say we can park at Park Silom for 50 baht per hour.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Khun Sukawan,

Thank you for taking the time to share such a detailed review. We’re glad you found our location convenient, enjoyed the meeting room facilities, and appreciated the complimentary snacks and beverages.

We also appreciate your feedback regarding the airflow and will continue looking for ways to improve the comfort of our meeting spaces.

We apologize that we don’t have on-site parking available. As we’re located in the heart of Silom, next to BTS Sala Daeng, space is limited and parking costs in the area are quite high. By not maintaining dedicated parking facilities, we’re able to keep our meeting room rates affordable and continue offering great value, including high-speed Wi-Fi, complimentary refreshments, and fully equipped meeting spaces.

Thank you again for choosing us, and we hope to welcome you back for your next meeting.

Best regards,
The Work Loft Team

reviews.name: Mark Cossin
reviews.text:
I recently completed Remco's six-day Chi Nei Tsang (abdominal massage) certification course at Blue Garden Yoga Center in Chiang Mai, and I couldn't be happier with the experience.

The course consisted of approximately four hours of instruction each day, with plenty of hands-on practice. To earn my certification, I completed a full one-hour abdominal massage on a classmate, which was an excellent way to put everything I had learned into practice. (The full hour sequence took me more than an hour but I'll get better with practice.)

One of the biggest surprises for me was how much I learned about the anatomy of the abdomen and chest. Remco explained how working with specific abdominal zones can influence the flow of chi and correspond to different internal organs. It gave me a completely new appreciation for the connection between anatomy, energy, and therapeutic touch.

Remco is an outstanding instructor. His teaching style is engaging, approachable, and filled with humor, making everything easy to understand. He was generous with his knowledge, patient with questions, and genuinely invested in helping us succeed.

I would highly recommend this course to anyone interested in massage therapy, bodywork, or holistic health. Even if you never plan to work professionally and simply want to learn techniques to help your family, friends, or yourself, this course offers valuable knowledge and practical skills that you'll use for years to come.

ownerDescription: Nestled along the tranquil banks of Pai’s river, The Ark is a sanctuary for soulful living, where nature, wellness, and conscious community converge. Wake to birdsong and the gentle flow of water, then step into a day of yoga, healing therapies, and riverside coworking designed for clarity and connection. Our restaurant nourishes body and spirit with vibrant, seasonal dishes, while our thoughtfully crafted accommodations offer rest, renewal, and a deep sense of peace. reviews.text: ​I accompanied my wife to her very first Lagree session. The equipment they use is on another level; you genuinely need serious core strength to survive 45 minutes of this workout. ownerDescription:
Kata Hot Yoga is the original hot yoga, a combination of 26 Hatha Yoga asanas (physical postures) and 2 breathing exercises performed in a hot room (40 °C / 105 °F) for 90 minutes.

Choose from several daily classes and get strong, fit, and energized during your stay.

We work with different teachers from all over the world, ensuring an amazing Bikram Yoga experience each time you visit us. A lot of effort has been put into making our classes suitable for beginners as well as challenging for experienced practitioners.

Everybody is welcome!

reviews.name: Gary Burgess
reviews.text:
I recently completed the teacher training program at Kata Hot Yoga, and wow it was incredible - a life changing experience. Highly recommended for anyone who is thinking about teaching, or who just wants to deepen their practice.
Govert is for sure one of the best teachers in the world, and it is wonderful that he shares his knowledge, energy and passion with us. He goes all in during the training and works as hard as his students to help them be successful!
The training also includes truly world class teachers for asana theory, yoga anatomy, yoga history, and more.
All in all, unforgettable, and probably unique in the world for value delivered. And that’s not even to mention the absolutely stunning location and views!

reviews.text: Taught yoga here and couldn’t be more pleased with my experience, from the people (and animals!) to the atmosphere, it really is a magical place.

reviews.name: Lylie West
reviews.text:
I really enjoyed my stay at the cozy retreat and from the moment I arrived I was made to feel welcome and at home.

Each day included two yoga and meditation classes with a variety of different yoga styles. The sessions were easy to follow and there were options to increase or reduce the intensity, which made them accessible for everyone.

I also experienced two Reiki sessions and a sound healing session, which were incredibly relaxing and insightful. They added such a special and meaningful layer to the retreat.

The shala is beautifully authentic and the social areas are thoughtfully laid out. One of my favourite moments each day was watching the sunrise from the hammock listening to the birds.

I’m genuinely sad to be leaving and I would recommend it to anyone looking for tranquility, a chance to reconnect with themselves and others, while still having plenty of free time to explore Krabi.

Marina, Margriet, Jeremy and Owen are all such beautiful souls, thank you for such a special experience 🫶🏼

reviews.name: Marc Spierings
reviews.text:
I took some time to final write my review for my truly life changing experience at Phuket Cleanse. I had been suffering from extreme anxiety since several years, the last year 2025 being my worst of them all. It had become a suffocating feeling and I had no idea where it was coming from, what triggered it and more so how to treat it. I realized that calm music with a headset and mindful words on some YouTube channel (call it a sort of meditation) did make me feel better, so I decided that maybe a retreat was a what I needed. I used mostly Chat GPT and was very accurate on what I wanted. I asked for small scale (40-50 people), personal, no extreme luxury but more so basic amenities, clean housing, water and healthy food, no alcohol, no parties, international environment and a very clear focus on inner healing. Phuket Cleanse came as the most highly rated and after reading the reviews, I did feel that this would be a good place to start my inner self healing process. I booked for 3 weeks.
I could easily write a book about these 3 weeks. I never expected that they would so much better my life, my way of thinking and my way of living. I have to highlight that you must come prepared, as in open minded. Leave your doubts behind and let them open your mind. If you can do this, you will benefit 100%. The vibe is relaxed, yet days start as early as 05h00 am. You are not forced to attend any classes but the earlier you start the quicker you adapt to this culture and the more you will benefit. Don’t be scared of new experiences, like spending 45 minutes in 4 degree water. No one is there to hurt you and everyone one wishes your well being. I have been back from Phuket Cleanse now since 4.5 months and have NEVER had another panic attack. This does not mean that my anxiety is gone, but at least now I know where it came from, why it’s there, what it’s purpose is, how it’s triggered and how to calm it down, but never stop it or cure it. Just acknowledge it, understand it and give it room. I changed my complete way of breathing, I eat healthier, I drink 5% of the alcohol I used to and 20% of the coffee. I exercise, train, pilates etc. I meditate when I feel that my CNS (central nervous system) is a bit overloaded, and I feel great. The key to life is to understand who YOU are. Your authentic self, and once you have figured this out, you will know what to do in order to feel good. Phuket Cleanse and its wonderful team of genuinely friendly caring people are there and they can help you. They changed my life and I don’t have a doubt they can change you. I will be forever grateful for what they have done for me. Thank you. Marc.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Marc ... that is so incredibly kind and we are very happy that you responded in such detail to your time with us over here in Phuket. I have sent your wonderful review of your experience to all the staff members that were here during your 3-week dynamic adventure with us. Hurry and get back here and continue on your human upgrade experience. Cannot wait to see you ...
Thanks again,
Stanton

reviews.name: jarrodb632
reviews.text: Phuket Cleanse operates on a principle that's become increasingly rare: genuine personalization. I've returned for two consecutive years, and I'm booking again—not because it's a checkbox wellness retreat, but because Melanie and the team actually listen.|What distinguishes this place isn't the marketing narrative. It's the coherence. The programming is thoughtfully scaffolded—there's genuine benefit architecture whether you're here for physical detox, consciousness work, or something unnameable in between. The staff don't funnel everyone through identical experiences; they meet you where you are and design accordingly.|The density of returning guests speaks volumes. These aren't Instagram-day tourists. People come back year after year because something substantive happens here. The community element is organic, not engineered—the kind of shared intentionality that emerges when staff and guests actually care about the process rather than the outcome metrics.|It's one of the few places I've found where the esoteric and practical aren't in conflict—where a serious detox protocol coexists with actual consciousness engagement, and nobody has to choose between them.|Worth going back to. Worth going back to repeatedly. |Thank you so much Melanie, Dariush and ALL the team!

reviews.name: JenniferF649
reviews.text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ FOUR VISITS. FOUR TRANSFORMATIONS. A RITUAL I RETURN TO EVERY YEAR.|Some places change you once. Phuket Cleanse changes you every single time — and somehow goes deeper with each return.|I have just completed my fourth retreat here in four years, and I am writing this with a full heart and complete conviction: this place is not a wellness retreat in the conventional sense. It is a container for genuine, lasting transformation. Whatever version of yourself you arrive as, Phuket Cleanse creates the conditions to shed what no longer belongs — and to meet who you are becoming.|Each visit has marked a turning point in my life. Not just a rest or a reset — a real and irreversible shift in how I see myself and what I’m willing to create.|My fourth retreat was perhaps the most profound yet. The combination of cleansing protocols, exercise programs, wellness routines, breathwork, meditation, yoga , amongst the many options available.And the extraordinary community of practitioners here created space for a level of release and intentional visioning I didn’t expect — even after three previous visits. I arrived carrying the weight of a complex chapter and left with genuine clarity, groundedness, and a felt sense of new possibility that I carried home with me.|At the heart of Phuket Cleanse is its founder and owner, Melanie. She is quite simply extraordinary. Her knowledge of the body, the mind, and the intricate relationship between the two is vast and hard-won. What sets Melanie apart is not just her expertise — it is the quality of her wisdom. She has a rare gift for meeting each person exactly where they are, offering insights that land with precision and compassion in equal measure. More than once over my four visits, something she has shared has quietly shifted the way I see myself. That is not something you forget.|The breathwork sessions in particular are extraordinary. To be held through that depth of inner work in such a skilled, safe environment is genuinely rare. I came away having done some of the most meaningful personal work of my life — not in a therapist’s office, but in a room full of people also willing to go there.|What keeps me returning year after year is not just the physical cleanse — though that alone is remarkable — it is the cumulative effect. Each retreat builds on the last. Under Melanie’s stewardship, the team holds the space with such expertise and warmth that even familiar protocols feel fresh and purposeful. The food, the setting, the programme design — all of it reflects her vision and her genuine commitment to transformation that actually lasts. You feel that intention in every detail.|My spirit guide first made herself known to me here. That alone tells you the depth of what becomes possible when you truly let this place work on you.|If you are standing at a threshold — if you sense that something needs to change, that you are ready for a new chapter, or simply that you are long overdue for genuine rest and renewal — I cannot recommend Phuket Cleanse highly enough. Come once with an open heart. I promise: you will return.|To Melanie, Dariush and the entire Phuket Cleanse team — thank you. You have been part of some of the most important moments of my life. That is not a small thing to say, and I mean every word of it.|See you next year!|Jennifer|Northern rivers NSW|Australia. 4 x times guest

ปวดหลัง ปวดสะโพก ไม่หายสักที... ปัญหาอาจไม่ได้อยู่ที่จุดปวด แต่เป็นเพราะ "การเคลื่อนไหว" ของคุณ!

อาการปวดเรื้อรังหลายครั้ง ไม่ได้เกิดจากร่างกายอ่อนแอ แต่อาจเกิดจากการที่ร่างกายพยายาม "ชดเชย" การเคลื่อนไหวที่ผิดปกติมาเป็นเวลานาน

หลายครั้งอาการปวดไม่ได้เกิดขึ้นเพราะร่างกายอ่อนแอ แต่อาจเกิดจากการเคลื่อนไหวที่ร่างกายพยายามชดเชยมานานโดยไม่รู้ตัว 🧐

reviews.textTranslated:
I've been doing physical therapy here for about 4 years now. Both my mother and I have been coming here the whole time. I'm very impressed with the three staff members. ❤️💕

They give very detailed advice and consultations on exercise techniques. They design exercises suitable for each person, not using the same method for everyone. This makes us feel truly cared for and appreciated.

What I've noticed most is that after each physical therapy session, my mother, who had numbness and limited shoulder movement, feels her arm can move better and she has more strength to lift things. I myself feel that my overall posture and body shape have improved. I've learned to adjust my lifestyle and exercise habits to be more correct and suitable for myself. With continued treatment, I feel my body can straighten and move better.

Another thing I really like is that the three staff members are fun to talk to and very friendly. Every visit is stress-free. I gain knowledge, take care of my body, and get to chat! 😘😍

Come on over! 2/10… Just kidding 😂
10/10! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.text:
เป็นการทำกายภาพครั้งแรกในชีวิต เกิดจากการยกเวทแล้วกล้ามเนื้อแถวสะบักฉีกขาด

1.คือ พี่ๆกายภาพ วิเคราะห์ต้นตอของกล้ามเนื้อให้ ว่าสาเหตุที่เจ็บเพราะอะไร แล้ว มาสอนท่าออกกำลังกายเชิงกายภาพที่ถูกต้อง

2.สอนท่าบริหารกล้ามเนื้อ การโฟกัส หายใจ ให้ถูกจังหวะ เพื่อไม่ให้เกิดการบาดเจ็บซ้ำอีก

3.มีการ ultrasound ร่วมด้วยในแพ้คเกจ หลังการบริหาร เป็นช่วงที่ฟินมากๆ เพราะแค่นอนให้พี่ๆกานภาพทำ

4. มีนักกายภาพบำบัดทั้งผู้ชายและผู้หญิง สบายใจได้ทุกท่านเลยจ้า

5.ใส่ใจ เทคเเคร์ดีจนจบคอส

บอกได้เลยว่าคุ้ม มืออาชีพ และ ได้ความรุ้มากมายครับ
reviews.textTranslated:
This was my first ever physical therapy session. It stemmed from a tear in my shoulder blade muscles while lifting weights.

1. The physical therapists analyzed the root cause of the muscle injury and taught me the correct physical therapy exercises.

2. They taught me proper muscle exercises, focusing, and breathing techniques to prevent reinjury.

3. The package included ultrasound therapy after the workout, which was incredibly relaxing as I just lay there while the therapists worked on me.

4. There were both male and female physical therapists, so I felt completely at ease.

5. They were very caring and attentive throughout the course.

I can honestly say it was worth it – professional, and I gained a lot of knowledge.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: ขอขอบคุณมากนะคะ ยินดีที่ได้ดูแลค่า

After completing 5 sessions, I feel a significant improvement; I can walk more easily and for longer periods without pain. The instructor was very kind and friendly. Thank you for the valuable techniques that I can apply to my life.

reviews.text: มีปัญหาบริเวณรองช้ำ และสะโพก เข้าคอร์สกายภาพบำบัด 15 สัปดาห์ ได้รู้ว่ามีปัญหาหรือจุดอ่อนหรือจุดที่ควรต้องปรับปรุงในส่วนของสะโพก ก้น ซึ่งมีผลต่อการวิ่ง และแก้ไขรองช้ำ ทางทีมคลินิกสอนแนะนำตั้งแต่พื้นฐานต่างๆ เพื่อให้สะโพก ก้น ข้อต่อต่างๆ ทำงานได้ถูกต้อง ก็สามารถแก้ไขและป้องกันการบาดเจ็บได้. ขอบคุณทีมหมอหัวรั้วกายภาพที่ช่วยสอน ปรับท่า และแนะนำต่างๆ ที่ผ่านมาด้วยครับ 🙏
reviews.textTranslated: I had problems with plantar fasciitis and hips. After a 15-week physical therapy course, I learned about weaknesses and areas needing improvement in my hips and glutes, which affected my running and helped with plantar fasciitis. The clinic team taught me the basics, ensuring my hips, glutes, and other joints functioned correctly, thus preventing and correcting injuries. Thank you to the Huai Rua Physical Therapy team for their instruction, posture adjustments, and guidance. 🙏

reviews.name: Luana Bartsch
reviews.text: Unser Zimmer war eine ehemalige Garage. Wir hatten leider viele Insekten im Zimmer. Unser Fenster schliss nicht richtig und uns weckten morgens freilaufende Hähne. Leider gab es nur eine Holztür, die uns vom nächsten Zimmer trennte. Somit konnten wir jedes Gespräch hören. V.a. war dies um 4:30 Uhr morgens nervig, als unsere Nachbarn zurückkamen. Der Pool ist auch sehr klein. Die Location hat mir gut gefallen, da wir nur 1km vom Stadtzentrum entfernt waren. Sowolh zu Fuß, als auch prr Moped gut zugänglich.
reviews.textTranslated: Our room was a former garage. Unfortunately, we had a lot of insects in the room. Our window didn't close properly, and we were woken up in the mornings by free-roaming roosters. There was only a wooden door separating us from the next room, so we could hear every conversation. This was especially annoying at 4:30 a.m. when our neighbors returned. The pool was also very small. I liked the location, as we were only 1 km from the city center. It was easily accessible both on foot and by moped.

reviews.name: נור לנדאו
reviews.text: I highly recommend staying here! ❤️ The family who runs the place is absolutely lovely and makes you feel so welcome and at home. They organize really nice activities, and the food is delicious! The rooms are excellent, comfortable and very clean, and they are always happy to help with anything you need. It’s such a warm, friendly and cozy place, and I’m so happy I stayed here. Definitely a place I would recommend!

reviews.name: Allison Niesler
reviews.text:
Carla has created something truly special! 💗 Not only is she a wonderful yoga teacher, but she has built such a beautiful, welcoming community.
I've been lucky enough to experience her amazing retreats, magical full moon gong baths and regular Wednesday and Friday yoga classes followed by coffee and chats. ☕️✨
It's so much more than just yoga — it's about connection, friendship and feeling part of something special. Carla puts so much love into everything she does, and it truly shows. So grateful to be part of this beautiful community! Highly recommend! 💕
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Awww thank you so much Allison, that truly means so much to me. Very grateful for your continued support 🙏

reviews.name: S K
reviews.text: Carla is such a patient, warm, and caring instructor. Our group joined her Vinyasa yoga and sound healing session, and we thoroughly enjoyed the experience. She guided us with such calmness and care, making the whole session feel relaxing and restorative. A wonderful experience and much highly recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Serene it was so nice to meet your group, thank you so much for taking the time to review. Hope to host you again in Phuket. 🤍

reviews.name: Sarah Berry
reviews.text:
Amazing 🤩 is the only word to describe the retreat I’ve just experienced with The Yoga Lodge. The location, food, sessions and my fellow ladies were all above and beyond my expectations. I wanted to reset and recoup after a stressful couple of years and Carla and Debbie gave me just that and more. A new way of coping and reconnecting.
As busy women we don’t get to experience a time to only think of ourselves and this retreat allowed us to do just that.
Thank you Thank you Thank you ☺️
Namaste 🙏🏼 ❤️

reviews.name: Steph J
reviews.text: I have just returned from the most amazing retreat with Carla from the Yoga Lodge. A week in Ibiza, incredible accommodation, fantastic location, fabulous food and the loveliest group. Oh and of course the best yoga in a beautiful setting. It was so special. Loved every minute. Thank you! 🙏

reviews.name: Claire Pearson
reviews.text:
Home after a phenomenal week… relaxed, recharged and completely restored.

The accommodation was beautiful, the location absolutely perfect, and the yoga and food were next level.

A truly special retreat with an incredible energy from start to finish. Feeling very grateful for the reset. ✨

reviews.textTranslated:
I took prenatal yoga classes with Teacher Luknam from 3 months pregnant until close to delivery.
Teacher Luknam is an amazing teacher! She's strong, flexible, has a great personality, and understands her students' bodies very well.
In private classes, Teacher Luknam made sure I was doing the poses correctly and safely. 💕
Teacher Luknam is so lovely, which made yoga classes feel relaxed, fun, and allowed me to continuously improve my poses.
I continued taking classes even after giving birth. 😊😊

reviews.textTranslated: Practicing yoga here with Teacher Luknam is amazing! The classes aren't too difficult, suitable for both beginners and those new to yoga. The classes are small, allowing the teacher to see and guide everyone thoroughly. The atmosphere is warm and fun, and my classmates are lovely and friendly. Of all the yoga classes I've taken, this is my favorite! 🥰

reviews.responseFromOwnerText: HI Ameenah, we are sorry to hear about the misunderstanding about our pool as it is open 24/7 and all our guests have all meals included in their package, except your program. Also your remarks about the schedule is not applicable nor arranged by us. So may I suggest you to remark this to Nomuhub and their agent. With love from Phuket, Team Lan Sabai & Lisa

reviews.name: Julia Vovk
reviews.text:
The place itself is absolutely beautiful — the rooms are stylish and tastefully designed, and the indoor area feels cozy and welcoming. The staff at the center were incredibly kind and attentive, and we are especially grateful to them. A special thanks also to the chef for the delicious and well-balanced meals — the food was truly a highlight.

However, we had chosen this location specifically for a retreat, as the name and concept suggested it was designed for such purposes. Unfortunately, from the first day, it became clear that the environment was not conducive to holding our practices. The owner frequently interrupted or restricted our sessions due to noise concerns (in a day time!) — looks like only whispering is allowed there —something that had not been communicated beforehand.

Additionally, the location is surrounded by neighbors who regularly complain about sound, and there’s noticeable street noise, including tourists and motorbikes, which made it difficult to maintain focus during our sessions.

It would be very helpful if, before confirming a booking and taking the payment, the owner clearly communicated the limitations regarding sound and the types of activities allowed. That way, guests can make an informed decision about whether the space meets their needs. Unfortunately, in our case, these important details were only shared after our arrival.

reviews.name: Omar El-Naggar
reviews.text: My wife was going to this detox retreat and I wanted to join her but the place she was going to did not allow me to join her since I am a diabetic patient and that retreat does not cater food for diabetics. Just a bit of background: I went through quite the challenging and rough year at work, lots of pressure and work-related issues. I am self-employed and co-manage a company with my business partners.  Decided to travel with my wife anyway where I had to take some time off to destress and recharge my battery.  Problem is I read about almost every single retreat in Phuket and sent questions and couldn't find something that suits my needs until I stumbled upon Lan Sabai, and it was the best thing I have done to my physical and mental health in a very long time.  From the second you start communicating with them inquiring about the place you will feel genuinely welcomed.  Lisa and her team are not only kind and passionate about their place and their job, they invest so much energy in getting to know your needs and going the extra mile that others don't have the time and energy for.  The place is built and designed in a way that fits all of the above description.  The food was so good, that as a diabetic Type 1 patient for 33 years I can assure you that it does not get better than that, it was healthy, delicious, wholesome, tasty and using the finest and freshest local ingredients. The program was designed in a way that you will not need to worry about planning any activity for yourself, they think of every little detail that I did not think of.  I strongly recommend that if you want to take care of your health and wellbeing that you book at least a week there, it is truly a very special place and I am back from my holidays very refreshed and energized after this wonderful retreat.  Thank you, Lisa and the Lan Sabai team.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much, Omar. You make our heart sing. We are truly touched by your lovely compliments and hope to see you again 🙏

reviewContext.Rooms: Probably one of the best I have seen in Phuket in that line of business. When my wife and I compared it to her room in her well known detox retreat we both agreed that Lan Sabai’s room was way better with amazing design, space and very well thought of when built.
