reviews.name: Miad
reviews.text:
Lan Sabi in Phuket provided me with a retreat experience that surpassed all expectations and left an enduring mark on my soul. From the moment I arrived, I was immediately struck by the beauty and tranquility of the location. Tucked away in a quiet neighborhood.The environment set the stage for a truly immersive and rejuvenating retreat experience.

The accommodations at Lan Sabi are nothing short of remarkable. The rooms are perfectly designed, offering a harmonious blend of sophistication and comfort that would rival the finest 5-star hotels. Stepping into my room, I was greeted by a spacious space, thoughtfully equipped with every amenity I could desire during my retreat. The views from my room, whether of the mountains or the pool, provided a captivating and relaxing stay.

One of the most exceptional aspects of my retreat was the warm and genuine hospitality extended by Lisa, the great host and owner of Lan Sabi. Her dedication to ensuring that every detail of my visit was flawlessly executed was evident in every interaction and experience. Whether it was her meticulous attention to personalized meals or her thoughtful accommodation of individual needs, Lisa's commitment to creating an unforgettable retreat experience was unparalleled.

Speaking of meals, I must take a moment to celebrate the culinary journey at Lan Sabi. The chef's expertise shone through in every dish, and Lisa's dedication to accommodating dietary requirements only served to elevate the already exceptional dining experience.

The personalized schedule offered at Lan Sabi was another hallmark of my retreat experience. It was tailored to my preferences, ensuring a perfect balance of rest, relaxation, and physical activities.

My desire to return for an extended stay is a testament to the profound impact that Lan Sabi had on me.

In conclusion, every aspect of my retreat at Lan Sabi in Phuket exceeded my expectations, leaving me with cherished memories and a profound sense of renewal. I strongly encourage anyone in search of a truly exceptional retreat to experience the magic of Lan Sabi .
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for your lovely feedback and we can’t wait to serve you here again 🙏🙏🙏

I’ve been coming to this wellness center for a while now and really love the atmosphere here. It’s such a nice place for both training and relaxation, with a great variety of classes and a very welcoming environment.

hotelDescription:
Surrounded by mountains, and close to restaurants and shops, this laid-back resort with traditional Thai architecture is a 14-minute walk from bustling Patong Beach and 35 km from Phuket International Airport.
 Unfussy rooms come with Wi-Fi, flat-screens and minifridges, as well as tea and coffeemakers. Some have living areas, mountain views, and furnished patios with access to an outdoor pool.
 There's an outdoor pool with a bar. Other amenities include a Thai boxing stadium, a gym and a spa, which offers Thai massage. Breakfast is served in an open-air restaurant that prepares Western food. Motorbike rentals are offered.

reviews.name: Melli
reviews.text:
Während meines 3-wöchigen Aufenthalts hier habe ich 6mal an den Yogaklassen teilgenommen, und ich freue mich jetzt schon auf's Wiederkommen im nächsten Jahr. Caroline macht einen sehr guten und qualitativ hochwertigen Unterricht, bietet immer Optionen für mehr oder weniger Anspruch/Können an. Durch ihre immer sehr freundliche und ruhige Art bringt sie immer eine gute und ausgeglichene Energie in die Klasse.
Der Platz ist zudem sehr schön, ruhig und inmitten von Natur gelegen. Last but not least: der Preis von 300THB ist mehr als fair, und im Gegensatz zu einer teureren Adresse hier, bei der ich 500THB für 60min. bezahlt habe, mehr als gerechtfertigt  Danke & Namaste!
reviews.textTranslated:
During my three-week stay here, I participated in six yoga classes, and I'm already looking forward to coming back next year. Caroline teaches excellent, high-quality classes, always offering options for different levels of experience. Her consistently friendly and calm demeanor always brings a positive and balanced energy to the class.

The studio is also beautiful, peaceful, and surrounded by nature. Last but not least, the price of 300 THB is more than fair and, compared to a more expensive studio in the area where I paid 500 THB for 60 minutes, more than justified. Thank you & Namaste!

reviews.name: YogaMitViki
reviews.text: Ich habe hier insgesamt zweimal yoga praktiziert und fand die Stunden super. Die Atmosphäre ist der Hammer , ein offener Space im grünen . Die yoga Lehrerin sehr sympathisch und professionell. Die Stunde ist herausfordernd da die Asanas anfangs bevor es in den Flow geht länger gehalten werden. Aber sie bietet Optionen an die man sehr gut nutzen kann und die helfen langsam in den Flow zu kommen. Super Stunde. Kann ich empfehlen !
reviews.textTranslated: I've practiced yoga here twice and loved the classes. The atmosphere is fantastic, an open space surrounded by greenery. The yoga teacher is very friendly and professional. The class is challenging because the asanas are held for longer periods at the beginning before the flow starts. But she offers options that are very useful and help you gradually get into the flow. Great class. I highly recommend it!

reviews.name: Martina K
reviews.text: A serene place. Even though the yoga shed is actually just a few steps away from the main road, it feels secluded, as if you were far in the jungle. The yoga flow was a challenge for me, especially in the hot Thai climate, but the teacher will make sure all levels are accommodated, you can use props and are welcome to modify your practice. Both Caroline, the teacher, and her place are awesome, highly recommended.

reviews.text: เจ้าของร้านบริการดีมาก ทาร์ตไข่อร่อยมาก ไม่หวานจนเกินไป กาแฟกับโกโก้ใส่แก้วลดโลกร้อน ที่สำคัญสามารถสะสมแต้มได้  วันหลังจะไปอุดหนุนอีกค่ะ

reviews.text:
Lovely little cafe with great service and really good drinks. The pastel de nata was delicious! A nice, quiet place to sit and relax, and also comfortable if you want to work a bit on your computer.
There’s also a yoga and event space next door, if that’s something you’re looking for.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much for your lovely review, Viki! 
We’re delighted you enjoyed the drinks and especially our pastel de nata! 😊 It’s wonderful to hear that you found Sacred Grounds a peaceful and comfortable place to relax or get a little work done. 
And yes, our yoga and event space is just next door, so we love being able to bring coffee, community, and mindful practices together in one place.
Thank you for stopping by, and we hope to welcome you back again soon! ☺️🙏🏽

reviews.name: Gennady Gram
reviews.text: Apart from the cute coffee place, this place offers amazing activities and workshops! I found great value in the Men circle, it was done very professionally 👌
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much Gennady, for your kind review! We're delighted that you enjoyed both the café and the men's circle. It means a great deal to hear that you found the experience valuable and professionally held.
Our intention is to create a space where people can not only enjoy soul food and great coffee, but also find meaningful opportunities for connection, reflection, and personal growth.
Thank you for your recommendation, and we hope to welcome you back soon, whether it's for a coffee, another circle, or one of our upcoming workshops. 🙏

reviews.name: Luc
reviews.text:
Visited the men's circle every chance I got since nearly the very beginning. If I was still in Chiang Mai I would be going every opportunity.

It is located in the back of the shop. Grab a nice coffee on your way in!

Gonçalo is a kind, thoughtful facilitator capable of creating a sacred space for men to sit down for an hour to find support with their burdens. Every time I left, I felt at least a little transformed.

Him, his wife & employee are all very welcoming and friendly. Strongly recommend popping by at least once to make lasting connections.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you so much Luc, for your heartfelt review. It truly means a lot to hear that the Men's Circle became such a meaningful part of your time in Chiang Mai. Knowing that you left each circle feeling even a little transformed is one of the greatest compliments we could receive.
Thank you as well for your kind words about our whole team. Together, we're doing our best to create a welcoming space where people can enjoy good coffee, build genuine connections, and find a little more peace and support in their lives.
We miss having you at the circles already, and hope our paths cross again one day. You'll always have a place here at Sacred Grounds. ☺️🙏🏽

title: Ban Dalah Pai Resort/Retreat
subTitle: Ban Dalah Pai Resort
ownerDescription:
Ban Dalah Pai Retreat is a meditative environment set within a Zen garden. It is an immersive, safe and tranquil space for yoga, aloneness, contemplation, reflection, restoration or recovery. The resort is near Pai township, within a rich, diverse rural setting, surrounded by mountains, streams, and the very green serenity of rice fields. It is private and exclusive, for singles and couples only and is not open to the public. Airbnb is its only access. It is absolutely LGBTQ+ friendly.
The back balcony is large, as is the view. Sunrise can be viewed from there, or from your pillow, and sunsets from the front porch of each studio. The room is very comfortable with high ceilings for coolness, and large sliding doors to maximise the panorama
address: 404 Wiang Tai, Pai District, Mae Hong Son 58130, Thailand

reviews.name: Oliver Schati
reviews.text:
Wir hatten eine unvergessliche Woche von Weihnachten in Neujahr in diesem Resort. Der Gastgeber ist ein herzlicher Mann mit zahlreichen tollen Tipps für die Umgebung, in der es Vieles zu entdecken gibt. Leicht abgelegen bietet der Ort Ruhe vom Ortskern, der per Taxi oder Roller dennoch schnell zu erreichen ist. Die Anlage ist sehr gepflegt, zauberhaft und lädt zum Durchatmen ein. Die Bungalows sind in einem sehr guten Zustand und der Ausblick von den Terrassen auf die gegenüberliegende Bergkette atemberaubend.
„They always come back“, war einer der letzten Sätze bei unserer Verabschiedung und die Wahrscheinlichkeit ist groß.
reviews.textTranslated:
We had an unforgettable week from Christmas to New Year's at this resort. The host is a warm and welcoming man with plenty of great tips for exploring the surrounding area, which has so much to offer. Slightly secluded, the resort offers peace and quiet away from the town center, which is still easily accessible by taxi or scooter. The grounds are beautifully maintained, enchanting, and perfect for unwinding. The bungalows are in excellent condition, and the view from the terraces of the opposite mountain range is breathtaking.

"They always come back," was one of the last things we heard as we said goodbye, and the chances are high.

reviews.name: Early Retirement Abroad
reviews.text:
I am trying to write a summary of our short stay at this mesmerizing place. It is so difficult to put in writing the feelings of the peace and comfort that overwhelms you as soon as you step inside the premises. So I will skip this attempt and start with the practical stuff.

Garry is a wonderful host! He arranged a car to bring us from and to Chiang Mai. He helped us to rent a motorbike here in Pai and took a lot of time from his busy schedule to introduce us to Pai and his favorite areas.

The room is tastefully decorated, like everything else on the property, and has everything needed for a comfortable stay, including mini fridge, a kitchen sink and the most important - the balcony with the stunning view of the rice fields and the mountains. The hot water in shower is running momentarily.

The common area is designed in the such way, that the guests could fell into meditative and rejuvenative state without any extra effort.  Useful to mention, that the guests are allowed to use the kitchen, kitchenware and cooking stove, the washer, sauna and many other things that can be found in the common area.

Please note, that the place is completely renovated and is under the new management since November 2023. All reviews before November 2023 (positive or negative are irrelevant as of now and all information is not applicable)

We fell in love with this place and would love to come next year and stay much-much longer. (Do I still need to recommend this oasis? If yes, then it is highly recommend it!)

reviews.name: CAN
reviews.text: Ban Dalah is indescribably beautiful and there is a powerful energy here. Sunrises, sunsets, and mist, mountains and the constant flow of water surrounding the property. Each day seems to draw you in closer. leaving was quite sad. The water features and sounds were amazing, as was the Zen garden. Walking around the perimeter was an experience in itself. Garry was a great host. Ban Dalah is on my radar for a return in 2024 to further investigate kundalini yoga. The room itself was large, comfortable with a high ceiling and a sliding insect door which allows breathing the mountain air all night There is a beautiful white temple on the next corner. There is just something about Ban Dalah. Surreal

ตลอด 200 ชั่วโมงของการเรียนที่นี่ ป๊อบรู้สึกดีและมีความสุขมากกับการตัดสินใจเลือกมาเรียนที่นี่จริง ๆ ได้ทั้งความรู้ ประสบการณ์ และการเติบโตทั้งในด้านร่างกายและจิตใจ

reviews.textTranslated:
Pop was very impressed with her experience completing the 200-hour Yoga Teacher Training here. The atmosphere and location were very peaceful, surrounded by nature and green spaces, making her feel relaxed and at ease – perfect for practicing yoga. Throughout her time here, Pop felt positive energy and tranquility every day.

Another thing she loved was being able to swim in the sea anytime. The atmosphere was amazing. She could learn, relax, and fully connect with nature, making the experience even more special.

Throughout the 200 hours of training here, Pop feels very good and happy with her decision to choose to study here. She gained knowledge, experience, and growth both physically and mentally.

Most importantly, Teacher Ben and Teacher Pop were excellent teachers. They provided solid knowledge, explained things in detail, made it easy to understand, and shared their experience fully. This made the learning intensive yet fun and very memorable. It's another place Pop would highly recommend for anyone looking for a great yoga studio in a calm, warm, and positive atmosphere. 🤍🥰

不过，对于这条评价，我们确实有些意外。您到店期间，我们的工作人员曾主动向您询问体验是否满意、是否有任何需要调整的地方，您当时都表示没有问题。在服务过程中，您也没有向我们提出任何具体的不满或需要改进的地方。

我们一直非常重视客人的意见，也希望在客人提出问题时能够及时沟通并解决。如果当时您有任何不满意的地方，我们很乐意现场为您调整和处理。

但目前这条评价没有提供任何具体情况，我们也无法了解究竟是哪一方面让您感到不满意，因此很难针对性地改进。

如果您愿意，也欢迎您联系我们，告诉我们具体的情况。我们始终愿意听取客人的真实反馈，并持续改善我们的服务。

Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to see that you were not satisfied with your experience.

That said, we are a little surprised by this review as our staff checked with you during your visit to make sure everything was okay, and you confirmed that you were fine with the service. At no point during the session did you raise any concern or indicate that you were unhappy.

We are always happy to listen and address any genuine concerns, but without any details about what went wrong, it is difficult for us to understand what we could have done differently or to improve.

If there was something specific about the massage or your experience that you felt was unsatisfactory, we would genuinely appreciate it if you could let us know. We take constructive feedback seriously and would much rather have the opportunity to address an issue directly than discover it only through a review.

reviews.name: Martina Pacovská
reviews.text:
One of the most inspiring places to practice Ashtanga yoga in the world.

The teachers here are truly exceptional. Their knowledge of the body, anatomy and traditional Ashtanga practice is incredible, and they guide each student with great care, attention and respect for the individual body.

But what makes this place truly special is the atmosphere. There is something very authentic and conscious about the way yoga is taught and lived here. You can feel that yoga is not just something they teach — it is something they truly embody.

It is also beautiful to see how they raise their young son in this environment, sharing yoga and an active, mindful life with him. They are not only amazing teachers, but also wonderful human beings.

People travel from all over the world to practice here — and once you experience it, you understand why.

If you love Ashtanga yoga, this is a place you should absolutely visit at least once in your life.

ชอบสตูดิโอมากค่ะ สถานที่สวย บรรยากาศดี แอดมินบริการดีและพูดจาน่ารัก คุณครูสอนเข้าใจง่ายและมีเทคนิคการสอนที่ดี เคยมาเรียนที่นี่หลายครั้งและโดยรวมประทับใจมากค่ะ

จึงค่อนข้างสงสัยว่าเกิดจากสาเหตุอะไร หรือเป็นเพราะไม่ได้มาเรียนกับคุณครูท่านนี้บ่อยหรือไม่ หากคุณครูไม่ประสงค์จะติดตามกันแล้ว ส่วนตัวคิดว่าน่าจะลบผู้ติดตามออกด้วย เพื่อไม่ให้เกิดความรู้สึกว่าเป็นการเลือกปฏิบัติระหว่างนักเรียนหรือลูกค้าแต่ละคนค่ะ

นอกเหนือจากเรื่องนี้ ประสบการณ์ที่ได้รับจากสตูดิโอโดยรวมถือว่าดีมาก และประทับใจในการบริการและการสอนทุกครั้งค่ะ เพียงแต่อยากฝากเรื่องนี้ไว้ให้ทางสตูดิโอพิจารณาและชี้แจง เพื่อให้ผู้เรียนรู้สึกสบายใจมากขึ้นค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
I really like the studio. The place is beautiful, the atmosphere is great, the admin is helpful and friendly. The teachers explain things clearly and have good teaching techniques. I've taken classes here several times and overall I'm very impressed.

However, there's one issue that's making me a little uneasy. Previously, I followed one teacher on Instagram, but later noticed the teacher unfollowed me while still allowing me to follow them. Upon further observation, I found the teacher continues to follow other students as usual.

I'm wondering why this happened. Could it be because I haven't been attending classes with this teacher as often? If the teacher no longer wishes to follow, I think they should have unfollowed as well to avoid the feeling of discrimination against individual students or clients.

Aside from this issue, my overall experience with the studio has been excellent, and I've been impressed with the service and teaching every time. I just wanted to bring this matter to the studio's attention for consideration and clarification, so that students feel more comfortable with the situation.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
ขอบพระคุณคุณลูกค้ามากนะคะ ที่สละเวลาเขียนรีวิวและให้คำแนะนำกับทางสตูดิโออย่างละเอียด รวมถึงขอบพระคุณสำหรับคำชื่นชมในส่วนของการบริการและการสอนด้วยนะคะ 🙏🏻
สำหรับเรื่องที่เกิดขึ้นเกี่ยวกับการติดตาม Instagram ทางสตูดิโอต้องขออภัยคุณลูกค้าเป็นอย่างสูงและจากใจจริงค่ะ หากการกระทำดังกล่าวทำให้คุณลูกค้ารู้สึกไม่สบายใจ รู้สึกไม่ดี หรือรู้สึกว่าไม่ได้รับความเป็นส่วนตัวและความสบายใจอย่างที่ควรจะเป็น ทางเราต้องขอน้อมรับคำแนะนำและความรู้สึกของคุณลูกค้าไว้ค่ะ

ทางเรายอมรับว่าเรื่องนี้เป็นสิ่งที่ควรระมัดระวังและใส่ใจให้มากกว่านี้ และต้องขอโทษจริง ๆ ค่ะที่ทำให้คุณลูกค้าต้องเกิดความสงสัยและไม่สบายใจจากเหตุการณ์ที่เกิดขึ้น ทั้งที่ความตั้งใจของทางสตูดิโอควรเป็นการทำให้ผู้เรียนรู้สึกสบายใจและได้รับประสบการณ์ที่ดีตลอดการเรียนค่ะ

ทางสตูดิโออยากมีโอกาสพูดคุยและชี้แจงเรื่องนี้กับคุณลูกค้าโดยตรง รวมถึงรับฟังความรู้สึกและรายละเอียดเพิ่มเติม เพื่อที่ทางเราจะได้นำไปปรับปรุงและไม่ให้เกิดเหตุการณ์ในลักษณะนี้ขึ้นอีกค่ะ

หากคุณลูกค้าสะดวก ทางสตูดิโอขออนุญาตรบกวนขอช่องทางติดต่อกลับที่สะดวก หรือสามารถส่งข้อความส่วนตัวเข้ามาหาทางสตูดิโอได้เลยนะคะ 

ต้องขอโทษคุณลูกค้าอีกครั้งจริง ๆ นะคะ สำหรับความรู้สึกไม่สบายใจที่เกิดขึ้น และขอบพระคุณมาก ๆ ที่แจ้งเรื่องนี้ให้ทางเราทราบค่ะ 🙏🏻

แถมยังมีคาเฟ่ในฟิตเนส จิบกาแฟไปเทรนด์ไป บางครั้งก็มัทฉะ คือดี อร่อยมาก กาแฟดี มัทฉะดี ฮีลใจหลังเทรนด์เสร็จสุดๆ

ดีไปหมดดด ใครสนใจอยู่ ไม่ต้องลังเลเลยค่ะ มาลองดูก่อน ไม่ผิดหวังแน่นอน เค้ามีโปรโมชั่น กิจกรรมเรื่อยๆ ด้วยนะคะ :)))
reviews.textTranslated:
I've been a customer at Glow Fitness for over a year now. It's a really warm and welcoming gym, and I always want to go back again.
When I work out, time flies by; it's not at all grueling! 😆 It's so enjoyable and fun.
Before, I hated exercising and had no knowledge of weight training or muscle building.
But this gym has made me love exercising (including stretching!). It's made me healthier, I rarely get sick, I feel proud of my health, my physique has improved, and I've gained muscle effortlessly without stress.

The trainers are lovely, great, and very dedicated. They have excellent plans, collect data, monitor client progress, and design plans that fit me perfectly. They're fun, varied, and deliver great results. The trainers are friendly and treat you like family; you can always ask for advice.
Plus, there's a cafe in the gym where you can enjoy coffee while training, sometimes matcha – it's delicious! The coffee and matcha are great, perfect for healing after a workout.

Everything's great! If you're interested, don't hesitate. Try it out; you won't be disappointed. They also have promotions and events regularly. :)))

reviews.name: Panjie Kitt
reviews.text:
I’ve really enjoyed learning Pilates with Kru Tookta. What I appreciate most is how personalized every session feels. Rather than rushing into advanced movements, there’s a strong focus on building the right foundations first—understanding how the body moves, proper alignment, breathing, and form. She has made Pilates feel much more sustainable and something I can genuinely integrate into my daily life for the long term.

Kru Tookta pays close attention to details and is incredibly knowledgeable about the body. She can quickly spot compensations or habits I didn’t even realize I had, and her corrections are always clear and easy to apply. I also love that she uses a variety of equipment and props to help ease into positions safely and comfortably, instead of forcing the body into a shape it’s not ready for.

Every session feels thoughtfully tailored to where my body is on that day, which has helped me build strength and confidence gradually. If you’re looking for someone who truly understands movement, teaches with patience, and focuses on long-term progress rather than quick results, I would highly recommend her.

reviews.text:
เรียนพิลาทิสที่นี่มาเกิน 1 ปีแล้ว เป็นคลาสไพรเวทที่รู้สึกว่าคุ้มค่ามากกับคุณภาพการสอนและผลลัพธ์ที่ได้ จุดเด่นคือคุณครูละเอียด ใจเย็น และใส่ใจร่างกายของเราจริงๆ ในแต่ละครั้งจะมีการปรับท่าให้เหมาะกับสภาพร่างกายในวันนั้น ทำให้เราเข้าใจการเคลื่อนไหวของตัวเองดีขึ้นแบบชัดเจน ไม่ใช่แค่ทำตามท่าไปเรื่อยๆ

เราเป็นสายโยคะมาก่อน หลายอย่างที่เคยรู้สึกไม่พัฒนา พอมาเรียนพิลาทิสแล้วเหมือน “ถึงบางอ้อ” ว่าต้องใช้ร่างกายยังไงให้ถูก อุปกรณ์ต่างๆ ก็ช่วยซัพพอร์ตการเรียนรู้ได้ดี ทำให้เห็นเลยว่าพิลาทิสเป็นศาสตร์ที่มีระบบและช่วยพัฒนาได้จริง

บรรยากาศโดยรวมดีมาก สถานที่สะอาด สงบ คุณครูเป็นกันเอง คุยดี และมีมุมของ mindfulness ทำให้การเรียนไม่ใช่แค่การออกกำลังกาย แต่เหมือนได้กลับมาเชื่อมกับร่างกายตัวเองอีกครั้ง
reviews.textTranslated:
I've been taking Pilates classes here for over a year. The private classes have been incredibly worthwhile, considering the quality of the teaching and the results I've seen. The highlight is that the instructor is meticulous, patient, and truly attentive to my body. Each session adjusts the poses to suit my physical condition, leading to a clearer understanding of my own movements – not just blindly following poses.

I used to be a yoga practitioner, and many areas where I felt I wasn't improving have become clearer after taking Pilates. It's like having an "aha" moment understanding how to use my body correctly. The equipment is also very supportive of the learning process, showing me that Pilates is a systematic discipline that truly helps with development.

The overall atmosphere is great. The place is clean and peaceful. The instructor is friendly and easy to talk to, and there's a mindfulness corner, making learning more than just exercise; it's like reconnecting with my body.

reviews.text:
RUXX Pilates สถานที่เรียนพิลาทิสในหมู่บ้านเสนานิเวศน์ เป็นสตูดิโอเรียน private แบบ 1:1 ที่เต็มเปี่ยมไปด้วยคุณภาพ ห้องเรียนขนาดกำลังดี สะอาดมาก โปร่งสบาย มีเครื่องพิลาทิส และอุปกรณ์ต่างๆมากมายครบครัน และที่สำคัญคือพี่ตุ๊กหรือคุณครูตุ๊กตา เป็นครูที่เก่งมากและละเอียดมากๆที่จะพาเราไปยังเป้าหมาย ไม่ว่าเป้าหมายจะเป็นเพื่อสร้างความแข็งแรง เพื่อปรับ posture เพื่อแก้ไขข้อจำกัดต่างๆของร่าง
ส่วนเรามาเรียนด้วยเป้าหมายเพื่อปรับ posture พี่ตุ๊กจะคอยสังเกตุจุดอ่อนที่เรายังต้องพัฒนา พยามหา exercise หลายๆรูปแบบมาให้ฝึก และพยามดึงศักยภาพในตัวเราออกมา แบบให้เราค่อยๆได้ก้าวผ่านข้อจำกัดของร่างกายไปได้แบบค่อยเป็นค่อยไป ไปได้ในแบบที่ถูกต้องทุกอย่าง connect กัน ไปได้ในแบบที่จะเป็นพื้นฐานที่ดีในการออกกำลังกายอื่นๆหรือใช้ในชีวิตประจำวันต่อไป ช่วยทำให้ posture ดีขึ้น และในวันที่เราอาจจะทำบางอย่างไม่ได้ พี่ตุ๊กก็จะคอยปรับเปลี่ยนการฝึกพิลาทิสในวันนั้นๆให้เข้ากับผู้เรียน เป็น authentic pilates ที่ไม่น่าเบื่อเลย แต่กลับมีอะไรให้ challenge ร่างกายตัวเองทุกครั้ง อันไหนที่ยังทำได้ไม่ค่อยดี พี่ตุ๊กก็จะพาฝึกไปให้เข้าใจฟีล 🩷 พิมมายาวมาก อยากจะมารีวิวบอกว่าโชคดีที่ได้มาเรียนกับพี่ตุ๊กค่ะ🙏 และแนะนำสำหรับใครที่สนใจ pilates เพราะ style การสอน ความตั้งใจและความละเอียดของพี่ตุ๊กไม่เหมือนครูคนไหนจริงๆ ถ้าคุณอยากจะเห็นตัวเองใน version ที่ดีขึ้น มาเรียนที่นี่รับรองว่าไม่ผิดหวังค่ะ🥰🤟
reviews.textTranslated:
RUXX Pilates, located in Senanives Village, is a high-quality private 1:1 Pilates studio. The room is a good size, very clean, spacious, and equipped with a wide range of Pilates equipment and supplies. Most importantly, Teacher Tuk (or Kru Tukata) is an incredibly skilled and meticulous instructor who guides you towards your goals, whether it's building strength, improving posture, or overcoming physical limitations.
I came with the goal of improving my posture. Teacher Tuk carefully observed my weaknesses, provided diverse exercises, and worked to bring out my potential, gradually helping me overcome my physical limitations in a correct and interconnected way. This built a strong foundation for future exercise and daily life, improving my posture significantly. On days when I struggled with certain tasks, Teacher Tuk adjusted the Pilates routine to suit me. It's authentic Pilates that's never boring, but instead challenging and improving every aspect of my abilities. Teacher Tuk will guide you through the training to help you understand the feeling 🩷. I've written a very long review because I wanted to say how lucky I was to learn with Teacher Tuk 🙏 and to recommend her to anyone interested in Pilates. Teacher Tuk's teaching style, dedication, and attention to detail are unlike any other teacher. If you want to see a better version of yourself, come learn here; you won't be disappointed! 🥰🤟

reviews.textTranslated:
I want to express my heartfelt appreciation to my yoga teacher! 🧘🏻‍♀️💖

The teacher was excellent. She explained things clearly, provided precise and effective poses, and offered patient guidance without rushing or pressuring. She was kind, friendly, and even had jokes throughout the class 😂 making yoga more than just stretching; it was a wonderful way to relax both body and mind.

The teacher was skilled, patient, and cheerful. I enjoyed the classes and want to keep coming back! ❤️🙏🏻 Thank you for caring for all your students.

reviews.textTranslated: I was very impressed with Teacher Dao's teaching. 🤍 She's a great teacher, patient, attentive to detail, and constantly guides and corrects postures to ensure they're correct according to yoga principles. This made me feel confident and able to practice safely. The class atmosphere is friendly and relaxed, and she's able to adapt her teaching to each individual perfectly. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced yoga practitioner, everyone can learn and improve. Every class leaves me feeling relaxed, stronger, and happy. I highly recommend Teacher Dao! If you're looking for a skilled, attentive, and understanding yoga teacher, you absolutely must try her classes!

reviews.name: Natty Somsawtdiwatt
reviews.text: เล่นโยคะมาประมาณ 3 ปี เล่นไปท้อไป เพราะทำท่าไหนก็ไม่ได้ จนได้มาเจอครูหนู ชญาดา บ้านโยคะ ครูหนูน่ารักมากเลย ค่อยๆแก้ท่าพื้นฐานที่เราผิด แล้วเพิ่งรู้สึกว่าแขนแอ่น เข่าบิด คุณครูก็คอยแก้ ปรับให้ คอยเชฟให้ มาเรียนกับครูหนูประมาณ 3 เดือน รู้สึกเลยว่าตัวเองแข็งแรงขึ้น ทำท่าต่างๆก็เบาขึ้น เหมือนปลดล็อกตัวเอง สนุกทุกครั้งที่มาเล่นโยคะ คุณครูหนูมีของเล่นเยอะมาก คอยเติมความแข็งแรงให้ทุกส่วนของร่างกาย ทำให้เรียนในคลาสไม่น่าเบื่อเลย ออกกำลังกายให้สนุกแถมได้สุขภาพที่ดีขึ้นด้วย แนะนำที่นี่เลย โคตรดี ถ้าใครเล่นโยคะมานาน ท้อ บาดเจ็บ ลองมาที่นี่เลย แนะนำมาก ราคาดี คุณครูคุยง่าย แบบมีความครูสูงมากก กันเอง ยืดหยุ่นตามร่างกายผู้เรียน  สอนแบบไม่กักเลย ทุกเทคนิคให้หมด ลองเปิดมากับที่นี่ ให้ the best of yoga mobility and flexiblity place
reviews.textTranslated: I've been practicing yoga for about 3 years, and I often felt discouraged because I couldn't do any of the poses. Then I met Teacher Nu, Chayada, at Baan Yoga. Teacher Nu is so lovely! She patiently corrected my basic poses that I was doing wrong. When I realized my arms were too arched and my knees were twisted, she would fix and adjust them for me, shaping me perfectly. After about 3 months of classes with Teacher Nu, I feel so much stronger, and the poses feel easier. It's like I've unlocked something within myself. Every class is fun! Teacher Nu has so many toys and exercises to help strengthen every part of my body, making classes anything but boring. It's a fun way to exercise and improve your health. I highly recommend this place! It's amazing. If you've been practicing yoga for a long time, feeling discouraged or injured, try this place. The price is good, the teacher is easy to talk to, and has a really strong teaching spirit. She's friendly, flexible, and teaches without holding back any techniques. Try it – it's the best yoga mobility and flexibility place!

reviews.textTranslated: I've been practicing yoga for 4 years without much progress, so I changed studios. After only 3 months of training with Teacher Nu, my body is much stronger, my core is much stronger, and I can even play golf better. Teacher Nu focuses on building strength and helping me understand my body better. Thank you so much, Teacher Nu! If you want long-term strength, I highly recommend training with Teacher Nu. You'll see that yoga can really make you strong. Importantly, Teacher Nu's classes are fun, she has lots of equipment to use, and she shares all her knowledge generously – it's like a private class! She dedicates a lot of time to each lesson. I highly recommend training here!

😊니티선생님과 센터의 직원분들께 진심으로 감사의 마음을 전합니다.
저는 한국에서 신경성 위경련으로 몸과 마음이 많이 지쳐 있는 상태였습니다. 그래서 단순히 요가 수업만을 찾기보다는, 조용한 공간에서 사람들을 만나고 긴장을 풀며 편안하게 회복할 수 있는 장소가 필요했습니다.
한국에서 우연히 구글을 통해 여러 곳을 찾아보던 중 니티 선생님의 요가센터를 알게 되었고, 첫 번째로 직접 걸어서 방문하게 되었습니다. 니티 선생님과 잠시 이야기를 나누는 순간, 이곳이 제게 편안함을 줄 수 있는 곳이라는 확신이 들었습니다.
첫 수업을 받고 나서는 프로그램의 흐름이 동작 분석적인 측면에서 매우 매끄럽게 진행된다는 점에 감탄했습니다. 선생님께서는 몸을 깊이 이해하고 계셨고, 각 사람의 상태를 세심하게 살펴보며 한 사람 한 사람에게 맞게 지도해 주셨습니다.
센터의 조용한 분위기는 자연스럽게 편안함을 주었고, 얇지만 깊이 있는 에너지가 느껴지는 공간이었습니다. 고요하게 수업을 따라가다 보니 자연스럽게 제 안으로 집중하게 되었고, 흩어져 있던 에너지가 조금씩 모이는 것을 느낄 수 있었습니다.
이번 여행에서 니티 로컬 센터는 저에게 꼭 필요했던 충분한 휴식과 치유, 그리고 영적인 영감을 주었습니다.
요일마다 진행되는 다른 선생님들의 수업도 모두 추천합니다.
Sophia, Meng, Millie 선생님께도 감사의 마음을 전하고싶습니다.

After my first class, I was truly impressed by how smoothly the program flowed from a movement-analysis perspective. Teacher Niti has a deep understanding of the body and carefully considers each person’s physical condition. She checked each student attentively and guided us according to our individual needs.
The quiet atmosphere of the center felt very comforting, and the space carried a gentle yet deep energy. As I calmly followed the classes, I found myself naturally turning inward and focusing more deeply. I could feel my scattered energy slowly gathering again.
During this journey, Niti’s local center gave me exactly what I needed — true rest, healing, and spiritual inspiration.
I would also highly recommend the classes offered by the other teachers throughout the week.
My sincere thanks as well to Sophia, Meng, and Millie for their wonderful guidance.😊

Living in Phuket and dealing with back or neck pain? A postural assessment might be your next step.

If you're living or spending extended time in Phuket, you're probably not short of wellness options — massages, yoga studios, and gyms.

But if you're dealing with persistent back pain, neck tension, shoulder stiffness, or that general feeling that your body is just not moving right, a massage or a yoga class is unlikely to get to the root of it.

At Abbysan in Ko Kaew, and  we specialise in exactly this. We work with expats and long-term residents who want real answers about why their body feels the way it does, and a structured plan to actually fix it.

Our process starts with a full postural and movement assessment. We look at how your body is aligned, where the restrictions are, and why they're there. 

Then we build a corrective programme tailored to you.

No generic classes. No guesswork. A structured pathway from where you are now to how you want to feel.

If you've been putting up with pain or stiffness and just managing it — this is your sign to address it properly.

📍 Abbysan Yoga & Wellness Center — Ko Kaew, Phuket and Cherngtalay (Choeng Thale) Phuket |

We don't put new clients straight into classes. Here's our process, and why it matters.

Most yoga and Pilates studios will sign you up for a class on day one.

We don't. And here's exactly why.

Everybody is different. Every client who walks through our door has a different history, different injuries, different habits, different areas of tension and restriction. Putting everyone into the same class from day one ignores all of that.

Our process starts with a private 1-on-1 assessment. We look at your posture, your movement patterns, and identify the root causes of any pain, stiffness, or imbalance you're experiencing.

From there, we build a programme that's structured around what your body actually needs not a generic routine.

Only when you have the right foundation do we introduce group sessions.

It takes more commitment upfront. But it's why our clients see lasting results instead of temporary relief.

If you want a structured, personalised approach to how your body moves and feels, we'd love to start with your assessment.

📍 Ko Kaew, Phuket and Cherngtalay (Choeng Thale) Phuket | Private sessions by appointment | info@abbysan.com

Still in pain after months of yoga or gym? Your posture might be the reason.

Most people dealing with chronic back pain, neck tension, or joint stiffness have already tried something; yoga, physiotherapy, the gym, stretching routines. And yet the pain keeps coming back.

Here's what most fitness and wellness approaches miss: they work the muscles, but they don't address why your body is holding itself the way it is.
Poor posture and misalignment are the silent root cause behind most recurring pain. If your body is structurally out of balance, no amount of exercise will fix it — it may even make it worse.

At Abbysan, we start differently.
Before any class or programme, every new client goes through a private postural and movement assessment. We identify exactly where your body is out of alignment and why — then build a corrective plan specific to you.

reviews.name: Malika Nurmatova
reviews.text:
We stayed here for almost two months and truly fell in love with the place. Vasucha and Joshua are warm, kind-hearted hosts who make you feel right at home. Their beautiful space is filled with soul - every detail, every corner is thoughtfully designed, and the many sweet cats add so much warmth and joy 🐾

Here, our days followed a peaceful rhythm. Mornings began with breakfast on the rooftop, enjoying the breathtaking view of the Big Buddha 🌄 The kitchen upstairs has everything you need - comfortable, clean, and cozy. Then we’d head to the gym, and come back to find our room freshly cleaned thanks to the wonderful: Soraya, Snow White, and their little helper Si - who made our stay even more amazing 💛

In the afternoons, we worked downstairs in the quiet, welcoming coworking space. Cats would curl up next to us or play nearby - the perfect companions. Evenings were our favorite: dinner with sunset views from the rooftop, followed by relaxing Yin Yoga and sound healing sessions on the ground floor. I was deeply moved by the practices - led by gentle, kind instructors. The space and energy here invite deep peace and connection.

We also met amazing long-term residents and felt a real sense of community. This place is not just a stay - it’s a feeling. A retreat. A home full of care and quiet magic ✨

We can't wait to return.

ข้อเสีย

-อยากให้มีผ้าทำความสะอาดส่วนกลางค่ะ คือทุกท่านที่มาเล่นก็ต้องมีเหงื่ออกติดเครื่องบ้าง ถ้ามีผ้าพร้อมน้ำยาทำความสะอาดวางไว้ส่วนกลางให้เช็ดได้เอง จะดีมากเลยค่ะ

*ฝากไว้ให้ทางเจ้าของพิจารณานะคะ ราคาที่จ่ายไปสำหรับเราว่าสูงพอสมควร แทบจะเทียบแบรนด์ในห้างได้แล้ว รบกวนปรับปรุงให้ดีขึ้นๆไปนะคะ
reviews.textTranslated:
This is my first time using the facility.
Pros:
- The equipment is genuinely new. There are separate rooms and zones for air conditioning and non-air-conditioned areas, with separate rooms for cardio and weight training.
- There's a good selection of weight training equipment, which I appreciated. The time I went (7-8 PM) wasn't too crowded, allowing me to use all the equipment thoroughly.
- The restrooms are clean, but they don't have separate wet and dry areas. The showers aren't very convenient for changing clothes as the floor gets wet.
- The fitness area uses fingerprint scanning for entry and exit, which I think is good and makes me feel safe.

Cons:
- The air conditioning is too hot in all the rooms. The weight training room is spacious but only has one air conditioner. It's bearable, though, as it's not crowded, and there are wall fans. I'm not sure if this is to reduce electricity costs, but I would recommend installing more. People using the equipment will feel unwell otherwise.

- The cardio room with treadmills has two air conditioners, but only one is on. As a serious runner, I find it unbearable to breathe while competing with other users. I couldn't concentrate. I really want this room improved; please, make the air conditioning much cooler.

- I wish there were communal cleaning towels. Everyone who uses the equipment will sweat on their machines. It would be great if there were cleaning cloths and solution available in the center for self-service.

*Please consider this, owner. We felt the price was quite high, comparable to brands in department stores. We hope these aspects can be improved.*

reviews.name: Ken Clark
reviews.text:
We visited the “Yoga Rooftop” studio in Phuket, Thailand, eager to attend their “Beach Yoga” class scheduled for 5:30 pm. The website instructed us to arrive 15 minutes early at the address provided for “CC,” which we did—arriving 20 minutes early. After snapping a few photos outside the location, we walked in, only to be told that the group had already left for the beach. The staff on-site seemed confused about the beach location and eventually provided a Google Maps pin using my phone. We left immediately, drove to the location indicated on the map, parked, and searched the beach but found no one.

The website stated that advance payment wasn’t necessary, so we planned to pay in Thai Baht upon arrival, which seemed reasonable at the time. However, the lack of clear communication and incorrect or contradictory information completely derailed the experience. While we later discovered that once you click on the class details there’s a note to arrive at 5 pm, this information was buried and not clearly reflected in the primary instructions.

We drove from Patong Beach on our scooter and carefully planned our day around this class, only to be met with poor coordination and misinformation. The studio staff had no contingency in place for people arriving at the listed time or location, as instructed on their website.

It’s unfortunate because the studio itself looked beautiful, and this could have been an incredible experience. However, the failure to provide accurate and consistent details made the whole situation disappointing. I’ve also noticed other reviews highlighting the same issue, and it’s clear this feedback has not been addressed.

This review will remain as is—a one-star rating—as we expect the studio to acknowledge this issue, comments on this post, and updates their website to ensure accurate information for future visitors. Accountability matters, and this is an opportunity for improvement.

reviews.name: Olena Tsulun
reviews.text:

I’ve booked a beach yoga class online, booking confirmation stated that meeting point should be at the Club Med Phuket at Kata beach. I’ve arrived 15 min in advance and could not find the group, when I’ve called the number mentioned in the booking to check if the location has changed, lady has failed to explain anything and just dropped the phone, when I’ve tried to recall no one picked up the phone.
If you are planning to book yoga class online, do double check the location, not to waste money and time as in my case.

reviews.textTranslated:
I highly recommend Kamphu Yoga! I took classes here for two months and the overall experience was fantastic! The teachers are incredibly professional and patient, adjusting each pose to my individual needs and explaining everything in detail. Plus, they speak English, so communication was no problem at all, making the classes very comfortable and relaxing!

When I first started, my body was very tense and my flexibility was poor. But after two months of practice, I can clearly feel my body relaxing a lot, and my flexibility has improved significantly.

They also offer different types of yoga classes to try. The teachers are very experienced and even help film videos during classes. After each class, they offer meditation sessions, and I always feel so much more relaxed afterward!

The environment is very comfortable, and the atmosphere is great. Every class is very relaxing. I've gained so much in these two months, and if I have the chance again, I will definitely come back to take classes!

I thoroughly enjoyed my experience with Teacher Kamphu. Taking private lessons with her has greatly enhanced my yoga practice. I had put off practicing for almost two years because of chronic pain in my left shoulder.
Teacher Kamphu is very attentive and caring. She helps correct and adjust your base poses so you don't risk injury later on. When I told her about my shoulder problem, she took it seriously and kept it in mind throughout the session: for any pose that involved the left shoulder, she made sure to guide me through an alternative posture.
By the end of my private lessons with her, I had regained both my confidence and my love of yoga. Thank you, Teacher Kamphu — khob khun mak mak ka. 🙏

title: Sansoen yoga Chiangmai

reviews.text: Samsoen has been a very lovely teacher.

reviews.name: Karen Ley
reviews.text:
Warning for first-time Iyengar students.
If you have never taken an Iyengar class before, I would not recommend starting here. I reached out two days before my class and was very clear that I had never taken this style of yoga, though I understood the general concept. I was offered the morning class.
When I arrived, the instructor’s tone was dismissive and he almost did not let me join even though I had confirmed my assistance. Once inside, I felt uncomfortable and unwelcome. The other students were kind and helped me get set up, which I appreciated. Unfortunately, in front of the class, the instructor asked if I had never done yoga before and said, “This is not going to work.” I felt embarrassed and singled out.
This experience was completely different from any yoga class I have taken before and very different from every other interaction I have had in Thailand. I am sure he is a knowledgeable and skilled teacher, and I truly wanted to learn. However a student with zero classes should not be offered a spot if that level is not appropriate.
One of my goals this year was to take a class like this, and I was really looking forward to it being a highlight of my trip. I adjusted my entire day around this class, so being treated this way and effectively turned away was heartbreaking. Sadly, this was the worst and only negative experience I have had in Thailand.

reviews.name: Alma
reviews.text: Surprised with this teacher’s nasty attitude to the new student. Judgement, disrespect and impatience should not be tolerated!!!!!!!!!  Especially to a woman!!!!!!!!!

reviews.name: Amy DancerChen
reviews.text:
非常好的瑜伽老師，這是我第一次嘗試艾揚格瑜伽，這次的旅程原來沒有規劃瑜伽課程體驗，但是三天的逛街吃喝旅程後，我很期待屬於自己的訓練。
離我住的附近有不少的瑜伽教室，但要配合行程的關係，我希望在主行程之前練習瑜珈，於是選了Sansoen Iyengar yoga Chiangmai. 老師能準確的引導動作，隨時注意我的狀態，並且給予輔助，手引導都很溫柔且穩定，我沒有預期到旅行中的瑜伽練習，能進入到肘倒立的體式，很順利也很讓人驚喜的體驗，有時間的話希望能在旅程結束前再來練習！
reviews.textTranslated:
A wonderful yoga teacher! This was my first time trying Iyengar yoga. I hadn't originally planned a yoga class for this trip, but after three days of shopping and eating, I was really looking forward to a workout.

There are quite a few yoga studios near my accommodation, but to fit the itinerary, I wanted to practice yoga before the main activities, so I chose Sansoen Iyengar yoga Chiangmai. The teacher guided the movements accurately, paid close attention to my posture, and provided assistance. Her hand gestures were gentle and steady. I didn't expect to be able to reach an elbow stand pose during my yoga practice while traveling; it was a very smooth and surprising experience. I hope to practice again before the end of my trip if I have the time!

reviews.name: Sam Webster
reviews.text:
Highly, highly recommend. Especially if you're someone who spends most of their day sitting down like me!

Yoga here was life-changing. I do pilates and lift weights often but I learnt so much about my body and what true strength is from Sansoen. These classes aren't like your standard yoga class and I'd come out of them feeling WORKED.

I had originally planned on only staying in Chaing Mai for a week, but after coming to class 5 days in a row I decided to extend my stay another month to keep on coming—that's how much I loved it.

(I also attended class at Sansoen's other location near Tha Phae Gate, Tadasan Iyengar Yoga Chiangmai)

reviews.textTranslated: When you feel powerless in life, can't sleep, and feel overwhelmed, definitely try this! If you can do this, there's nothing you can't do. reviews.text:
Сама студия не функционирует, но благодаря ей на пляже родилась прекрасная традиция. Приходите сюда строго к рассвету. Вы не встретите инструкторов, но обязательно найдете такого же случайного любителя йоги. Совместная практика на берегу в лучах восходящего солнца — это бесплатно, искренне и чудесно.
А если после йоги захочется на массаж, загляните в традиционную тайскую салу, которая находится сразу за волейбольной сеткой. Обязательно найдите там мастера — женщину с прядью седых волос. У неё потрясающая энергетика и очень хорошие, золотые руки!
reviews.textTranslated:
The studio itself isn't open, but thanks to it, a wonderful tradition has been born on the beach. Arrive just before sunrise. You won't meet any instructors, but you're sure to find a fellow yoga enthusiast. Practicing together on the beach in the rays of the rising sun is free, sincere, and wonderful.
And if you're in the mood for a massage after yoga, stop by the traditional Thai sala, located just behind the volleyball net. Be sure to find the therapist there—a woman with a streak of gray hair. She has incredible energy and very good, golden hands!

Özellikle ayak masajı gerçekten rahatlatıcıydı; Thai masajında da uygulanan baskı ve tekniklerden memnun kaldım. Bangkok’ta günün yorgunluğunu atmak ve dinlenmek için güzel, samimi bir yer. Fiyat-performans açısından da gayet başarılı. Tekrar Bangkok’a gelirsem yeniden uğramayı düşünüyorum. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviews.textTranslated: I had both a Thai massage and a foot massage at Massage in Garden. The atmosphere was very calm and peaceful, and the staff were attentive and friendly. The foot massage, in particular, was truly relaxing; I was also pleased with the pressure and techniques used in the Thai massage. It's a nice, friendly place to unwind and relax after a long day in Bangkok. It's also very good value for money. I plan to visit again if I come back to Bangkok. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.name: Alexander Panhans
reviews.text:
Ich hab diesen Massageladen schon von zuhause aus rausgesucht, weil ich für meinen Ankunftstag nach einem entspannten Ort gesucht habe, um meinen Jetlag und die Rückenschmerzen vom langen Flug loszuwerden. Der schöne Garten war mein Hauptgrund für die Wahl und auch mit der Qualität und Preis-Leistung der Massage war ich sehr zufrieden. 450THB für das Paket 1h Thai Massage + 30 min Flußmassage sind mehr als fair. Dazu gab's davor und danach einen Tee.
Der einzige Verbesserungsgrund, der aber keinen Sternabzug begründet, wäre, dass man, wenn noch viele freie Liegen verfügbar sind, die Kunden nicht alle nebeneinander massiert. Etwas mehr Privatsphäre hätte ich da schöner gefunden. Ist was anderes wenn der Laden voll ist, aber heute waren gerade nur 3 Massagen parallel. Ich komme aber sicher nochmal wieder und probiere die Ölmassage aus. ☺️
reviews.textTranslated:
I researched this massage parlor from home because I was looking for a relaxing place to get rid of my jet lag and back pain from the long flight on my arrival day. The beautiful garden was my main reason for choosing it, and I was also very satisfied with the quality and value of the massage. 450 THB for the package of a 1-hour Thai massage + 30-minute river massage is more than fair. Tea was also provided before and after.

The only thing I could improve, but it doesn't warrant deducting a star, would be if they didn't massage all the clients next to each other when there are plenty of free massage tables. I would have preferred a bit more privacy. It's different when the place is full, but today there were only three massages happening simultaneously. I'll definitely come back again and try the oil massage. ☺️

reviews.name: Itziar Mendibe
reviews.text: Precio inmejorable respecto al servicio que ofrecen y la zona en la que está. Las instalaciones muy cuidadas y con mucho gusto, se diferencian del resto porque no es un simple masaje a pie de calle. Nos hicimos masaje de pies y masaje con aceite, y los dos increíbles. reviews.textTranslated: Unbeatable price considering the service and location. reviews.text:
⭐ 1/5 – Extremely disappointing. Overpriced, unprofessional, and not family-friendly.
After three weeks in Thailand and dozens of massages, this was one of my worst experiences.
We arrived with our toddler and baby but were refused because the children might make noise. The first time this has happened to us anywhere in Thailand.
Despite that, I gave the place a chance. The beautiful interior and exceptionally high ratings suggested a premium experience. I requested a strong massage and was persuaded to pay extra for deep tissue.
The first therapist was so weak and unprofessional that, for the first time in Thailand, I asked to switch. The second was slightly stronger but equally disappointing. Both lacked proper technique, and I couldn't wait for the massage to end.

650 THB for one hour – one of my most expensive massages here, yet among the worst.
The extremely high ratings are difficult to reconcile with my experience. I believe Google should examine their authenticity.
I regret coming here. Definitely not recommended.

reviews.text:
Terrible experience. The service was disappointing from start to finish.

First, the receptionist was extremely rude and impatient. When I asked about payment methods, she completely ignored me and wouldn't even give a straight answer.

Second, the foot-washing step was very sloppy—the soapy foam wasn't even rinsed off properly before they just wiped my feet with a towel.

Finally, the massage itself was awful. They assigned a heavily tattooed, middle-aged man who used way too much force. When I asked him to ease up, he just brushed it off by saying "relax and don't resist," which is completely unprofessional. I had to tense up the entire time to cope with the pain and got zero relaxation.

I definitely won't be coming back and do not recommend this place.

reviews.name: ly c
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing experience! Avoid this place.
1. Rude Reception: The front desk staff had a terrible attitude and looked totally unwelcoming.
2. Zero Privacy: The massage area is an open-plan room with mattresses side by side, not private rooms. They didn't even bother to pull the privacy curtains, leaving me surrounded by strangers.
3. Uncomfortable Setup:The massage bed did not have a face hole—just a regular pillow. I had to turn my neck completely to the left or right the entire time. When they worked on my neck and shoulders, I felt like I was almost suffocating.
4. Careless Technique:The masseuse pulled and pulled so hard that quite a lot of my hair was ripped out during the session.
5. Unskilled & Rushed:The therapist seemed completely inexperienced—just using brute force without any proper technique. The whole process felt extremely rushed and chaotic.
6. Dismissive Service: I told them multiple times that the air conditioning was freezing, but they completely ignored my request to adjust the temperature or pull the curtain. They just brushed me off with a half-hearted reply.
Overall, terrible service, uncomfortable environment, and zero customer care. Highly NOT！recommended!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We are truly sorry to hear about your experience and sincerely apologize that your visit left you feeling uncomfortable and disappointed. The experience you described is certainly not the level of service we aim to provide.  
We take your concerns very seriously, particularly regarding privacy, the massage technique, room temperature, and the way your requests were handled by our staff. We will be reviewing these matters with our team to understand what happened and to ensure that our service standards are properly followed.  
We would really appreciate the opportunity to look into your experience in more detail and address your concerns personally. If possible, could you please contact us directly and provide the date and approximate time of your visit, along with any other details that may help us identify the booking? This will allow us to investigate the situation with the staff members involved and follow up with you appropriately. you can send your detail directly to our email : arundamassage99@gmail.com or call us directly +66824656969
Your feedback is important to us, and we do not want any customer to leave feeling that their concerns were ignored. We sincerely apologize again for your experience and hope you will give us the opportunity to speak with you directly and make this right.

reviews.textTranslated: I visited on the last day of our trip with my picky mother, and she absolutely loved it. There was a promotion offering a discount on the 90-minute course, so we received a massage in the 1,200 baht range. We were truly satisfied with the service provided by therapists Fern and Tubtim! Since my mother has joint issues, they gave her a refreshing massage with a gentle intensity, while I requested a stronger massage, and the intensity remained consistent from start to finish. All our travel fatigue melted away, and I thought getting a massage was the right decision right up until our flight back home. The shop had a lovely scent and was well-branded, making for a truly wonderful experience. It was even better to receive the service in a private room. This is a place I definitely want to recommend to others!!! If you can afford it, I highly recommend trying the 90-minute course.

reviews.name: Sanj
reviews.text:
Rest and Relax Health Massage is a small local massage shop in central Khon Kaen. The place is clean, quiet, and comfortable, so it’s a nice option after walking around the city all day.

They have quite a few treatments, including traditional Thai massage, foot massage, coconut oil and aromatherapy massage, herbal compress, hot stone massage, and a head, neck and shoulder option.

The therapists are mostly experienced local ladies, and the massage feels properly firm rather than just relaxing. They’re good at finding the tight spots, especially if your shoulders, back, or legs are sore.

Thai massage is 320 THB for one hour or 600 THB for two hours, which is pretty reasonable for this kind of place. They also have longer 2–3 hour packages combining things like herbal steam, body scrub, facial treatment, and massage.

Overall, a good choice if you want a clean, straightforward massage place with fair prices and experienced therapists. If you’re planning to go in the evening, booking ahead is probably a good idea.

reviews.text: ที่นี่ค่อนข้างน่าสนใจมากมีบ่อ ออนเซนให้เลือกหลายบ่อแล้วอยู่ท่ามกลางธรรมชาติที่ทำให้รู้สึกว่าได้พักผ่อนหรือว่าผ่อนคลายจริงๆแต่ว่าทางโรงแรมไม่มีมาตรการที่ชัดเจนสำหรับผู้ที่เข้ามาใช้บริการวันที่เข้าใช้บริการตรงกับวันที่น่าจะมีกรุ๊ปทัวร์ลงมาพอดีแล้วคณะกรุ๊ปทัวร์ค่อนข้างเสียงดังมากไม่มีความเป็นส่วนตัวเลย และยังไม่มีความรู้เรื่องของกฎกติกาการแช่ออนเซน ทั้งตะโกนโวยวายเสียงดัง และนำผง Scrubb ไปขัดในบ่อน้ำร้อนที่สองซึ่งทำให้บ่อไม่สะอาด และคณะลูกค้าทัวร์มีการถ่ายทั้งไลฟ์สดถ่ายวิดีโอกันภายในออนเซ็นตลอดเวลาซึ่งเราไม่มีความประสงค์ที่จะให้รูปเราติดอยู่ในกล้องของคนอื่นในตอนที่เราไปออนเซ็นซึ่งตรงนี้ไม่โอเคมากๆ ทางโรงแรมควรมี staff ที่จะไปคอยไปเฝ้าดูความเรียบร้อยบ้าง แล้วคอยเตือนลูกค้าที่ไม่รู้พวกนี้และโรงแรมก็ควรจะมีป้ายว่าห้ามเสียงดัง และป้ายห้ามถ่ายวิดีโอภายในออนเซ็น ไม่ใช่ว่าเค้าแค่คุยเสียงดังแต่เค้าตะโกนกรี๊ดไม่เหมือนไปผ่อนคลายเหมือนไปตลาด ในราคาคนละ 750 บาทที่เสียไปควรได้อะไรมากกว่านี้บริการที่มากกว่านี้และระบบที่ดีกว่านี้ หรือถ้ามีกรุ๊ปทัวร์เข้าวันไหนก็ควรแจ้งลูกค้าว่าวันนี้มีกรุ๊ปทัวร์จะได้ไม่เข้าไป แต่โรงแรมไม่มีแจ้งเลย รู้สึกผิดหวังกับการไปผ่อนคลายครั้งนี้มาก ถ้าโรงแรมสามารถปรับปรุงเรื่องพวกนี้ได้จะเป็นเซนต์ที่ค่อนข้างน่าน่าสนใจมาก
reviews.textTranslated: This place is quite interesting, with many onsen baths to choose from, surrounded by nature that truly makes you feel relaxed. However, the hotel lacks clear rules for users. The day we visited coincided with a tour group, and they were extremely noisy, offering no privacy. They also seemed unaware of the onsen rules, shouting and making a lot of noise, and even used scrubbing powder in the second hot spring pool, making it unclean. Furthermore, the tour group continuously live-streamed and filmed inside the onsen, which was unacceptable for us. The hotel should have staff to monitor the situation and remind unsuspecting guests about the noise and filming inside the onsen. They should also have signs prohibiting loud noise and video recording inside the onsen. It wasn't just loud talking; they were screaming and shouting, making it feel more like a market than a relaxing place. For 750 baht per person, we should have received more – better service and better management. The hotel should also inform guests about tour groups on specific days so they can avoid the onsen. We were very disappointed with our relaxing experience. If the hotel can improve these aspects, it will be a much more attractive place.

เรียน คุณ Chantana Thongprapha

ทาง Rock Valley Hot Spring ขอขอบพระคุณที่สละเวลาแบ่งปันประสบการณ์และความคิดเห็นอย่างละเอียด รวมถึงขอขอบพระคุณที่ชื่นชมบรรยากาศธรรมชาติและบ่อออนเซ็นของเรา ซึ่งเป็นสิ่งที่เราตั้งใจมอบให้แก่ผู้มาใช้บริการทุกท่าน

อย่างไรก็ตาม ทางเราต้องขออภัยอย่างจริงใจต่อเหตุการณ์ที่เกิดขึ้น ซึ่งทำให้การมาใช้บริการในครั้งนี้ไม่เป็นไปตามความคาดหวังของท่าน

เราตระหนักดีว่าความสงบ ความเป็นส่วนตัว ความสะอาด และบรรยากาศที่เหมาะสมต่อการพักผ่อน เป็นสิ่งสำคัญอย่างยิ่งสำหรับการใช้บริการออนเซ็น และเป็นมาตรฐานที่เราควรดูแลให้ลูกค้าทุกท่านได้รับอย่างเท่าเทียมกัน

ทางเราขอน้อมรับข้อบกพร่องที่ท่านได้แจ้งมา ทั้งในเรื่องการบริหารจัดการกรุ๊ปทัวร์ การดูแลความเรียบร้อยภายในพื้นที่ การสื่อสารกฎระเบียบในการใช้บริการ ตลอดจนการดูแลรักษาความสะอาดของบ่อน้ำร้อน โดยจะนำทุกข้อคิดเห็นไปทบทวนและปรับปรุงการดำเนินงานอย่างจริงจัง เพื่อป้องกันไม่ให้เกิดเหตุการณ์ในลักษณะเดียวกันอีก

เราต้องขออภัยอีกครั้งที่ไม่สามารถมอบประสบการณ์การพักผ่อนที่ดีให้แก่ท่านได้ในครั้งนี้ และขอขอบพระคุณสำหรับคำแนะนำที่มีคุณค่า ซึ่งเป็นส่วนสำคัญที่ช่วยให้เราพัฒนาคุณภาพการบริการให้ดียิ่งขึ้น

หากมีโอกาส ทางเราหวังเป็นอย่างยิ่งว่าจะได้รับเกียรติต้อนรับท่านอีกครั้ง เพื่อให้ท่านได้กลับมาสัมผัสบรรยากาศแห่งการพักผ่อนที่สงบ ผ่อนคลาย และได้รับประสบการณ์ที่ดียิ่งขึ้นจากเรา

reviews.textTranslated:
It was truly the worst massage experience.

I have received massages at many places, but this one often involved repetitive movements and lacked a professional feel overall. In particular, the arm massage was performed not with hands, but by scratching with fingernails; as a result, clear fingernail marks were left on my arm after the massage, and it turned red.

The pressure was not applied skillfully to provide a refreshing massage; instead, it felt like they were just pressing down with brute force, which was very uncomfortable. Personally, I do not want to visit again.

reviews.textTranslated:
Dream Package 90-minute massage (received for free via credit card).

The location is near BTS Phaya Thai. The common areas were clean, but the elevator had a musty smell. The restroom wasn't dirty, but could have been cleaner. The masseuse was okay; nothing to complain about, but I wasn't impressed enough to ask her name or want a repeat visit. During the massage, I could hear motorcycle and train noises intermittently. Instead of mango sticky rice after the massage, I received a Thai crispy roll (Thong Muan).

In summary, if you have free time and want a massage to kill time, the price is reasonable, and you don't mind the noise. This branch is similar to others; you won't be disappointed if you don't have high expectations.

reviews.name: mp
reviews.text:
マッサージは良かったのに
シャワーの排水口が詰まっていて
本当に最悪でした。
体洗っても足元汚いし。

以前から口コミに書いてあるのに
改善されてないあたり
普通に案内されたことに憤りを感じます。

いくらマッサージが上手くても
締めが最悪だと本当に残念です。
reviews.textTranslated:
The massage was good, but the shower drain was clogged, which was absolutely terrible.
Even after washing my body, my feet were still dirty.

I'm furious that they haven't fixed this issue despite it being mentioned in previous reviews, and that I was just shown in without any explanation.

No matter how good the massage is, a terrible ending really ruins the experience.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
この度は、コランブティックスパをご利用頂きまして誠にありがとうございました。マッサージの技術にご満足いただけた一方で、シャワーブースの排水口の詰まりにより、大変不快な思いをさせてしまいましたことを心よりお詫び申し上げます。せっかくのリラックスしたお時間が、最後のシャワーで台無しになってしまい、お客様が憤りを感じられるのも当然のことでございます。
当店のシャワーはブース式という構造上、どうしても排水の流れが滞りやすい設計になっております。そのため、日頃からオイルの付着を定期的に除去するなど、排水口の清掃や改善には特に気を遣って参りました。しかしながら、お客様の仰る通り、以前からのご指摘を活かしきれず、このような状態でご案内してしまったことは私どもの管理不足であり、深く反省しております。
今後は、施術後のチェックだけでなく、より頻度の高い点検と根本的な改善策の模索を続け、どのお客様にも最後まで気持ちよくお過ごしいただけるよう徹底いたします。貴重なご指摘をいただき、誠にありがとうございました。

reviews.name: Mark Wilson
reviews.text: A fantastic experience from start to finish! My wife and I just finished up getting the scrub/massage package. Absolute bliss, thank you ladies 💆😘
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: What a joy to read this after your visit! It sounds like the scrub and massage package truly hit the spot for both of you, and our team will be so pleased to know their care turned your time together into pure bliss. Moments like these, shared by couples looking to unwind, are exactly what we hope to create at CORAN. We're already looking forward to welcoming you and your wife back for another round of relaxation whenever you're next in Bangkok.

reviews.name: moe
reviews.text: 女子旅3人で、深夜便で日本に帰国する前に3時間コースをお願いしました。丁寧な施術でとても心地よく、暑さで体調を崩していた友人も体が楽になったと絶賛でした。日本よりお安い価格でスパが受けられたので大満足です。またタイに行くことがあったらリピートしたいです。最後に出していただいた、レモングラスとバタフライピーのドリンクもとても美味しかったです。
reviews.textTranslated: Three of us girls on a trip booked a 3-hour spa treatment before our late-night flight back to Japan. The treatment was very thorough and relaxing, and my friend, who had been feeling unwell due to the heat, raved about how much better she felt. We were very satisfied because we were able to enjoy a spa treatment at a lower price than in Japan. If I ever go to Thailand again, I would definitely like to come back. The lemongrass and butterfly pea drink they served at the end was also delicious.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: 深夜便前のお忙しい中、女子旅の最後にご来店いただき嬉しく思います。体調を崩されていたご友人が楽になったとのお言葉、担当スタッフも励みになります。レモングラスとバタフライピーのドリンクも喜んでいただけて何よりです。またタイへお越しの際はぜひスタッフ一同お待ちしております。ご来店誠にありがとうございました。

reviews.name: Kiki Word
reviews.text: Very relaxing experience for me and my boyfriend, we would definitely come back again!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hello, and what a joy it is to picture you and your boyfriend sharing such a relaxing time together at CORAN Boutique Spa. Moments like these, spent unwinding side by side, are exactly what we hope every couple experiences here. We're delighted the atmosphere and care from our therapists left such a positive impression on you both. Knowing you'd like to return means so much to us. Until your next visit, we send our warmest wishes for continued relaxation.

reviews.text: The best massage I’ve ever had
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: What a wonderful thing to hear! Thank you for taking the time to share this with us. Our therapist will be delighted to know the treatment left such a lasting impression, as that kind of deep, attentive care is exactly what we strive for at CORAN Boutqiue Spa. It means a great deal to know your experience stood out so clearly. We hope you'll return before long to enjoy another session of calm within our spa, and to continue discovering more of what CORAN has to offer.

Wir haben hier nebeneinander gelegen, meine Frau das Relaxing Heaven mit 100 Minuten, ich Deep Tissue und danach Gua Sha. Beides hat gesessen.

Die Kommunikation vorab lief per WhatsApp einwandfrei, alle Preise kamen schriftlich und am Ende stimmte die Rechnung auf den Baht genau. Das ist leider nicht selbstverständlich. Dazu gab es einen ordentlichen Rabatt.

Ein Punkt zur Planung: Einen Shuttle gibt es nicht, man muss selbst mit dem Grab kommen. Von Kamala sind das knapp 30 Minuten.

Sehr zufrieden, gerne wieder.
reviews.textTranslated:
We had a massage next to each other; my wife had the Relaxing Heaven treatment (100 minutes), and I had Deep Tissue followed by Gua Sha. Both treatments were very effective.

Communication beforehand via WhatsApp was flawless, all prices were provided in writing, and the final bill was accurate down to the last baht. Unfortunately, that's not always the case. We also received a generous discount.

One thing to note for planning purposes: there's no shuttle service; you have to take a Grab yourself. It's just under 30 minutes from Kamala.

Very satisfied, would gladly return.

reviews.text: 我和丈夫买了4100元3小时的套餐，总价8200泰铢。结果告诉我们这是一个错误的决定。套餐包含body wrap, oil massage and facial massage. 结果body wrap 实际就半小时，其余时间都是让你裹着身体油然后最后服务员进来让你冲洗掉。这个项目就算完成了。第二个是oil massage，这个很糟糕，前台让我们勾选重点的部位技师完全就不看的，到最后只能用翻译软件跟他们沟通，因为他们也不懂英文。整个按摩过程，手法凌乱没有章法，就像赶着早早了事，非常不舒服。最后就是面部massage，就像美容院那样给你敷了面膜再给你揉揉就结束了。非常草率，很水，这个价格不便宜，获得的体验却极差。最后就是楼下宁曼路唱歌吵的不行，你能想象做spa的时候音乐是外面的摇滚乐吗？还let’s relax, 更像let’s crazy 差不多。总之这个价格可以选择的太多了，绝对不推荐这家。
reviews.textTranslated: My husband and I bought a 3-hour package for 4100 baht, totaling 8200 baht. It turned out to be a mistake. The package included a body wrap, oil massage, and facial massage. The body wrap only lasted half an hour; the rest of the time, you were just wrapped in body oil, and then a staff member came in to rinse it off. That was it. The second was the oil massage, which was terrible. The receptionist told us to select the areas we wanted the massage to focus on, but the masseuse didn't even look at them. In the end, we had to use a translation app to communicate with them because they didn't understand English. The entire massage was haphazard and disorganized, like they were rushing to finish quickly, and it was very uncomfortable. Finally, the facial massage was like a beauty salon: they applied a mask and massaged you, and that was it. Very rushed and superficial. For this price, the experience was extremely poor. And to top it off, there was loud music from Nimman Road downstairs. Can you imagine having rock music playing while you're getting a spa treatment? "Let's relax" sounded more like "Let's crazy." In short, there are far too many other options at this price point, and I absolutely do not recommend this place.

reviews.textTranslated:
This is my go-to massage parlor every time I visit Chiang Mai. The prices are reasonable (180 baht per hour for a Thai massage), and the therapists are quite skilled.

The two therapists I had two years ago are still there. However, this time I happened to get a massage from a therapist named La Ti. His oil massage was incredibly comfortable because his hands were warm from start to finish. Although he washes his hands before the head massage, they might be a few seconds warmer at the end, but only for a few seconds (they're still warm, not cold, don't worry). I, who easily get cold hands and feet, am so envious!

The oil used here has a strong coconut oil aroma, with a subtle floral finish that isn't cloying. The masseuse is very generous with the amount of oil she uses. The light oil is absorbed into the skin by her warm hands – I felt so happy!

The only limitation here is that there are only two oil massage beds. Since there were three of us, we couldn't get an oil massage at the same time.

There are far fewer tourists now, so there are only a few masseuses available in the morning, and even fewer when it rains. If you're planning to come, remember to make a reservation. Although it says they open at 9 am, if you have an appointment with a masseuse, you can come in as early as 8:30 am.

reviews.textTranslated:
I've been to a Vietnamese spa before and it was very relaxing. This time, I came for an aromatherapy body massage, scheduled for 1.5 hours.

It started with me lying face down. The masseuse massaged my back for 50 minutes. Then she told me to turn over onto my back.

After I turned over, she continued to reach down to massage my shoulder blades (even though she had just massaged them). She didn't massage any other parts of my body. I lay there, not keeping track of the time, thinking she was trying to allocate the time for a full-body massage.

In short, the remaining 40 minutes after I turned over were almost entirely spent massaging my shoulder blades. She didn't massage any other parts of my body, not even a little. Towards the end of the massage, she put oil on her hands and used them to massage my face. Her hands were rough and not suitable for facial massage at all. This is supposed to be an aromatherapy body massage; a head massage is understandable, but a face massage is enough.

I opened my eyes and saw there were only 10 minutes left, so I told her to stop. It was a complete waste of time. She massaged my back excessively and didn't massage the front at all. I ended up going home with a sore back.

앞으로도 치앙마이에 여행 오면 마사지는 여기서 받을 예정입니다.
👍👍👍😊😊

타이+오일 코스 추천합니다. 1시간에 350바트. 1시간 30분에 500바트.
엎드려 누워서 어깨부터 척추 주변 등근육들만 오일로 마사지해주고, 타월로 오일들 잘 닦아내고 타이 마사지로 나머지 잘 풀어주고 스트레칭 진행됩니다.

전체적으로 템포가 느린 마시지 스타일입니다.
첫 손길부터 엎드린 몸의 발목과 매트리스 사이에 수건패드를 받쳐주는 섬세함, 정성스레 관리해주신다는 느낌을 받게해줍니다.

장소가 후미진 골목 안에 위치해있지만 그래서 그만큼 가격에 거품이 없습니다.
reviews.textTranslated:
While staying in Chiang Mai for over a year until 2022, I received massages here dozens of times whenever I stayed at a nearby condo. For me, it was the best massage shop in Chiang Mai. 👍

And when I visited again in 2025, the shop had expanded by another block, taking over the space on the right.

I continued to revisit in 2026 and was very satisfied after receiving a massage from a female therapist.

I plan to get massages here whenever I travel to Chiang Mai in the future.

👍👍👍😊😊

I recommend the Thai + Oil course. 350 baht for 1 hour. 500 baht for 1 hour and 30 minutes.

You lie face down, and they massage only the back muscles from your shoulders to the spine with oil. After thoroughly wiping off the oil with a towel, they loosen up the rest of your body with a Thai massage and proceed with stretching.

Overall, it is a slow-paced massage style.

From the very first touch, the delicate touch of placing a towel pad between your ankles and the mattress while you are lying face down makes you feel that they are caring for you with great attention and care.

Although the place is located in a secluded alley, the prices are not inflated because of that.

reviews.name: Tita Ganda
reviews.text:
We had such a relaxing experience at Let’s Relax MBK Branch, and we actually visited twice during our Bangkok trip with my mom.

We got the Dream Package for THB 1,100 per person, and we really enjoyed it!

First visit: We went on a weekday and booked the 8:30 PM slot. There weren’t many people, so the atmosphere was quiet and relaxing. We chose **moderate pressure**, which was really comfortable. The pressure was definitely moderate, but compared to the “moderate” pressure we’re used to, it felt softer and gentler. Since it was only the second day of our trip, it was exactly what we needed to relax and recharge.

Second visit: We came back on a weekend, after walking around 20,000 steps a day for several days. This time, we decided to try **hard pressure**. It was definitely painful at times 😂, but honestly, it was exactly what our tired feet needed after all that walking!

The back massage, even though it was a dry massage, was really the bomb!🔥 It was one of the highlights of the whole treatment. Definitely **highly recommended**, especially if your back and body are already tired from walking around Bangkok all day.

Another little detail we loved was their **Noirberry hand cream**. It smells **so good**! 😍 And the best part is that it’s not sticky or greasy at all, which I really appreciated.

Overall, we really enjoyed both visits. I liked that we could choose a different pressure depending on what our bodies needed that day — moderate and relaxing on our first visit, then hard and therapeutic after days of walking.

Definitely a massage place we’d come back to on our next Bangkok trip! 💆🏻‍♀️💆🏻‍♀️🇹🇭

reviews.name: Saparod Aroi
reviews.text:
Absolutely stunning place! I have rarely experienced a massage of such high quality. The forearm massage was extraordinary, and the arm massage was simply outstanding — incredibly relaxing. I actually fell asleep for an entire hour, and I’m being completely serious!

A special mention to Rati, who was absolutely extraordinary! Her massage was exceptional, and her professionalism and attention made the experience even more memorable.

The service was also exceptionally attentive, with 100% dedication from the entire team. Everyone works together seamlessly and communicates extremely well. Everything is handled quickly and efficiently, from changing the towels and cleaning the tables to clearing everything away. The place is spotless, almost clinical in its cleanliness.

Honestly, the whole experience was perfectly executed, almost like a surgical operation in terms of precision and efficiency. Everything was just perfect.

I wholeheartedly recommend this place 100%! Thank you to Rati and the entire team for such an incredible experience. I will definitely be coming back!

reviews.name: Deus Revelatus
reviews.text:
Schönes Hotel: Pool-Anlage ist top, Aussicht aufs Meer, Hotelrestaurant/-bar waren gut und Service auch. Hotelzimmer hatte soweit alles was man braucht.

Mir hat das Hotel sehr gefallen und der Preis wäre es mir auch fast wert gewesen, jedoch fand ich die Sauberkeit des Zimmers (besonders des Bettes) für ein 4-Sterne Hotel unangemessen. Flecken auf der Bettwäsche und nach 3 Tagen Bescheid sagen, dass es bitte gewechselt werden soll, schlafen wir immer noch in den gleichen sheets. Unerklärlicherweise haben wir hin und wieder (nachdem der Room Service da war) neue Flecken entdeckt… Man arrangiert sich; aber mit unwohl sein.

Auch wenn ein großes, ist das unser einziges Manko. Wir grüßen hier noch einmal Nong Thong!
reviews.textTranslated:
Beautiful hotel: The pool area is fantastic, the sea view is great, the hotel restaurant/bar was good, and the service was excellent. The hotel room had everything you could need.

I really liked the hotel, and the price was almost worth it. However, I found the cleanliness of the room (especially the bed) unacceptable for a 4-star hotel. There were stains on the sheets, and after requesting a change three days later, we were still sleeping on the same sheets. Inexplicably, we occasionally discovered new stains (after room service had been)... You get used to it, but it's uncomfortable.

Although it's a major drawback, this is our only complaint. Greetings again to Nong Thong!

reviews.name: Alexander Shutov
reviews.text:
Сотрудники отеля не стремятся помочь. Были проблемы с заселением (тут вина не отеля). Просто предложили сесть и разбираться самим с проблемами, не предложили даже воды на жаре. Помочь никак не вызвались, просто не обращали внимание. При том что отель позиционирует себя как 5 звёзд, считаю что он не соответствует этой оценки.
В итоге в результате трёх часовых разбирательств выяснилось, что забронированного номера у них нет, и вместо номера с видом на море, был предложен номер с видом в стену.
Справедливости ради спустя три часа до менеджера отеля дошло, что можно предложить воду.
reviews.textTranslated:
The hotel staff are unwilling to help. We had problems checking in (not the hotel's fault). They simply told us to sit down and sort things out ourselves, not even offering water in the heat. They didn't offer any assistance; they simply ignored us. Even though the hotel bills itself as a 5-star hotel, I don't think it lives up to that standard.
Ultimately, after three hours of discussion, it turned out they didn't have the room we'd booked, and instead of a sea view, they offered us a room with a view of a wall.
To be fair, it took three hours for the hotel manager to realize they could offer us water.

reviews.textTranslated:
This seems to be the only legitimate massage parlor in the area. The other shops nearby all seem to be gay massage parlors. My friend and I weren't familiar with the area and even had to turn back at one point. Luckily, we didn't miss this one.

I was a little scared at first because it was in a rather dimly lit alley.

But this is the best massage I've ever had in all my years in Thailand. The technique is impeccable.

The staff at the counter speaks some Chinese, explaining the treatments clearly and concisely. The prices are also very reasonable. This time, I had a 90-minute oil massage. The process was very comfortable, and the pressure was just right.

The price is reasonable, the environment is comfortable, and the masseuse frequently checks on me during the massage. Even after 90 minutes, I felt it wasn't enough. If it weren't a bit far from here, I probably would have come every day.

I highly recommend it to anyone in this area. Give it a try!
