reviews.name: Kulineryan
reviews.text:
I visited Let's Relax Spa at Grande Centre Point Ploenchit with my colleagues after an entire week of workshops and meetings in Bangkok. We desperately needed something to help us relax and release all that accumulated stress, and this place turned out to be a really good choice.

Now, when it comes to the massage itself, I have to admit that I've had better massages back home in Indonesia. The techniques and pressure weren't necessarily better than what I'm used to, so I wouldn't say this was the best massage I've ever had.

But what really sets Let's Relax Spa apart is the overall experience.

The atmosphere, comfort, and relaxing environment made the entire visit feel more special. It's not just about getting a massage, but also about enjoying the whole experience of being pampered and having some proper downtime.

And honestly, after spending an entire week attending workshops, sitting through meetings, and dealing with a packed schedule, that kind of experience matters a lot.

Overall, while the massage itself wasn't necessarily better than what I can find in Indonesia, the experience was excellent. Sometimes a good spa isn't just about how well someone massages your muscles, but how relaxed and refreshed you feel afterward.

And Let's Relax Spa definitely delivered on that.

reviews.textTranslated: I used their Thai massage service. The place was clean and the service was good, but the massage technique was strange and didn't seem to hit the right spots. It might be because they cater to foreigners; the pressure was inconsistent, sometimes too heavy, sometimes too light. The massage positions were also a bit unusual, having me turn and lie on my side to massage my hips. Importantly, while they seemed to offer a tablet to select areas to focus on and areas not to be massaged, they didn't focus on my requests and even massaged areas I didn't want massaged. I'm not sure if the therapists are properly briefed, because at first I thought it was just my mistake, but friends who went to other branches experienced the same problem.

reviews.textTranslated:
The exterior looked average. Walking in on the first floor, it seemed okay (though the lighting was a bit dim). I was led to a private area on the second floor. Going up to the second floor felt a bit scary; there was barely any light, and the equipment was incredibly basic!

But I figured I'd give it a try since the price wasn't too high, so I gritted my teeth and went for it.

The $300 head, shoulder, neck, and back massage was absolutely amazing! Authentic Thai massage. The masseur did a back-stretching and relaxation session, and his technique and pressure were very skillful. It was incredibly comfortable! 👏👍

Unlike typical massage parlors, they didn't offer tea or snacks when I left, but the massage was truly wonderful. I highly recommend it! 👍

#CashOnly

reviews.name: yue su
reviews.text: 这是我第一次去泰国，8月30日那天傍晚，逛完夜市下起了小雨，于是我搜了最近的一家按摩，接待的应该是女老板吧，很亲切。我和丈夫在二楼一起做了全身按摩，给我按的是一个戴眼镜的年轻妹妹，给他按的是一个年纪稍大的姐姐。按的过程非常温馨，偶尔我丈夫发出疼痛的怪叫，大家都在笑。最后我给了20铢小费，然后收获了眼镜妹妹的一个香香软软的拥抱，哎呀，说不出有多可爱，她太可爱了，当时是到泰国第二天，不懂小费文化，现在觉得有点给少了，但是她还是很开心的样子。我很少被女生这样抱，有点害羞，但是感觉真的非常幸福，啊，开心，所以导致都回国半个月了常常还是会想起她，特意来这里写条评论，希望她一切都好呀，希望以后还能有缘分再见到她。
reviews.textTranslated: This was my first trip to Thailand. On the evening of August 30th, after strolling through the night market, it started to drizzle, so I searched for the nearest massage parlor. The person who greeted me was probably a woman; she was very friendly. My husband and I got full-body massages together on the second floor. I was massaged by a young woman wearing glasses, and he was massaged by an older woman. The massage was very warm and comforting. Occasionally, my husband would let out a strange cry of pain, which made everyone laugh. At the end, I gave her a 20 baht tip and received a soft, sweet hug from the woman with glasses. Oh, she was so adorable! It was my second day in Thailand, and I didn't know about tipping culture, so now I feel like I gave her too little, but she seemed very happy. I rarely get hugged like that by a woman, and I was a little shy, but I felt incredibly happy. Even now, two weeks after returning home, I still often think of her, so I'm writing this review here. I hope she's doing well, and I hope we'll have the chance to see each other again someday.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for your review and feedback…🙏🏻….see you next time…😊

reviews.name: jeongyeon
reviews.text: 여기서 무림고수를 만났어요. 강한 마사지를 좋아했는데 그분을 만나고 바뀌었어요. 깃털처럼 살살 마사지하는데 긴장이 풀리고 스르륵 잠들면서 피로가 싹 풀였어요. 도착 첫날이라 무거운 트렁크 들고 어깨가 많이 뭉쳤는데 그분을 다시 만나고 싶어요.성함을 못 물어봤어요. 월요일 밤11시에 계신 좀 나이 있으시고 마르고 짧은 머리스타일을 하신 치앙마이에 있는 동안 그분을 꼭 다시 뵙고싶어요..!!! 사장님 이 후기를 보신다면 알려주세요
reviews.textTranslated: I met a martial arts master here. I used to like strong massages, but that changed after meeting him. He massaged me as gently as a feather; my tension melted away, and I drifted off to sleep as all my fatigue vanished. It was my first day, so my shoulders were really stiff from carrying a heavy suitcase, and I want to see him again. I didn't get his name, though. He is a bit older, thin, and has short hair, and he works at 11 PM on Mondays. I really want to see him again while I'm in Chiang Mai...!!! Owner, if you see this review, please let me know.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for your view.
The person who serve you, her name is M.

Hope we can serve you again.

title: Le Lanna Massage เลอร์ลานนา นวดเพื่อสุขภาพ
ownerDescription:
เลอร์ลานนา ร้านนวดเพื่อสุขภาพสไตล์มินิมอลล้านนา ที่ผสมผสานความเรียบง่ายร่วมสมัยเข้ากับเสน่ห์ความอบอุ่นแบบเหนือได้อย่างลงตัว ภายในร้านถูกออกแบบให้สงบ เรียบง่าย สะอาด และอบอวลด้วยกลิ่นสมุนไพรหอมอ่อน ๆ เพื่อให้ทุกการมาถึงเป็นช่วงเวลาแห่งการพักผ่อนอย่างแท้จริง
ซึ่งเรามุ่งเน้นการนวดเพื่อฟื้นฟูสุขภาพกายและใจ โดยหมอนวดมืออาชีพที่เข้าใจศาสตร์การนวดแผนไทยแท้ ผสมผสานเทคนิคสมัยใหม่อย่างนุ่มนวล ช่วยคลายความเมื่อยล้า กระตุ้นการไหลเวียนของเลือด และคืนสมดุลให้ร่างกาย
ไม่ว่าคุณจะเป็นคนไทยหรือชาวต่างชาติ “เลอร์ลานนา” พร้อมต้อนรับด้วยความอบอุ่น ให้คุณได้สัมผัสประสบการณ์แห่งการพักผ่อนที่เรียบง่าย…แต่ลึกซึ้งและมีความหมาย 🌾

reviews.text:
Very good shoulder and back massage.
It apparently also includes the legs, butt and head. Unfortunately there was no way to mark that you don't want to be massaged in either of those additional zones, so you'd have to communicate that during the massage, which can be awkward. It was also pretty cold, especially for the feet, because they were not covered by a towel.

reviews.name: KY
reviews.text:
This is my second time experiencing the Four-Hands Thai Massage + Thai Herbal Compresses (120 mins) at Let's Relax Spa. My first time was at a branch near Asoke in Bangkok, and the experience was so good that I decided to book a second time.

However, the experience at this Chiang Mai branch was very poor. The four therapists kept chatting with each other during the session, stopping their movements every time they talked. On top of that, one of them even scratched my wife because her fingernails were too long.

The takeaway is that the quality of high-end brands is still inconsistent; you might as well opt for budget massages, as both ultimately depend on luck. Of course, the environment and atmosphere at Let's Relax Spa are undeniable, but the main point of a massage is the massage itself. Given this value for money, I cannot recommend it.

ฉันและแฟนของฉันไปนวดเมื่อวานในห้อง 202 นัดเวลาไว้ตอน 7 ทุ้ม
ฉันไม่แน่ใจว่าทางร้านมีการอบรมพนักงานอย่างไร
พนักงานผญ ที่นวดให้ฉัน ค่อนข้างหยาบคาย ฉันรู้ดีว่าการทำงานบริการมันเหนื่อยเพราะเจอลูกค้าหลายคนต่อวัน เพราะตัวฉันเองก็ทำงานโรงแรมเช่นกัน แต่ฉันอึ้งกับการกระทำของพนักงานผญ คนนี้
ฉันแค่อยากจะย้ำว่าแฟนฉันไม่นวดหัว เน้นนวดหนักที่หลังเนื่องจาก เขาถักผม ค่อนข้างดูแลยาก และด้วยการที่เขาเปนคนเยอรมันค่อนข้างเข้มงวด ฉันไม่อยากให้เกิดปัญหาตามมาทีหลัง แต่คำตอบที่ได้จากพนักงานที่นวดให้ฉัน ไม่แน่ใจว่าเขาเข้าใจผิดรึป่าวว่าฉันบอกเขา แต่ฉันบอกพนักงานอีกคนที่นวดให้แฟนฉัน
"นวดหนักเท่าที่หนักได้นั้นแหละค่ะ เห็นแล้วว่าติ้กหนักมา"
ด้วยน้ำเสียงประชดประชันแดกดัน ถอนหายใจ ทำของล้ม เสียงดัง
ฉันถามความเห็นของแฟนฉัน แฟนฉันบอกว่า คนที่นวดให้เขานวดดีมาก ลงรายละเอียดดี แต่ติดที่บางครั้งมีเสียงดัง ทำให้รู้สึกไม่ผ่อนคลาย

ฉันเลยอยากให้สถานบริการตรวจสอบมาตราฐานการดูแลลูกค้าให้ไปในทิศทางเดียวกันค่ะ
reviews.textTranslated:
My boyfriend and I went for a massage yesterday in room 202, scheduled for 7 PM.
I'm not sure how the establishment trains its staff.
The female masseuse who massaged me was quite rude. I understand that working in the service industry is tiring because you deal with many customers every day, as I also work in a hotel, but I was shocked by the behavior of this female employee.
I just want to emphasize that my boyfriend didn't want a head massage; he wanted a strong back massage because he has braided hair, which is difficult to manage, and because he's German and quite strict, I didn't want any problems later. But the response I got from the masseuse—I'm not sure if she misunderstood what I told her, but I told the other employee who massaged my boyfriend—was:
"Massage as hard as you can. I can see you ticked the box for heavy pressure."
She said it sarcastically, sighing, dropping something, and making loud noises.
I asked my boyfriend for his opinion. He said the masseuse was very good and detailed, but the noise sometimes made it less relaxing.

Therefore, I would like the establishment to review its customer service standards to ensure consistency.

Very disappointing experience, especially after just arriving in Bangkok and hoping for a relaxing massage.

I booked an oil massage, but the treatment room was extremely cold. With oil being applied directly to the skin, the cold air conditioning made the entire massage very uncomfortable. I told the therapist three times that I was too cold, but nothing was really done to improve the situation.

Toward the end, when the oil was wiped off with a towel. My whole body felt freezing afterward, and even when the massage was finished, I was still extremely cold. Instead of leaving relaxed and refreshed, I left feeling uncomfortable and genuinely concerned that I might get sick from being so cold throughout the treatment.

The massage itself was also disappointing. At check-in, there was an iPad where I could select the areas where I wanted stronger pressure, so I clearly indicated my preferences. However, the pressure was still far too light and did not match what I had requested.

What disappointed me most was that I communicated the temperature issue multiple times during the session, yet it was never properly addressed. If a customer says two or three times that they are freezing, I would expect some effort to adjust the air conditioning or make them more comfortable.

Unfortunately, this was not the relaxing massage experience I was expecting, and I left feeling cold and unsatisfied.

I don't usually write reviews, but I paid for this myself and am writing one because I was satisfied!

This shop is run by a Korean owner, who is very kind and generous. If you are Korean and have a specific style you'd like, just let the owner know, and they will convey it well. I also gained a lot of information about Chiang Mai.

I felt that massages at other places were strangely weak, but I liked that the basic pressure here was quite strong.

I received a neck and shoulder massage from masseuse 'Mon,' and she massaged my entire body, including my legs, arms, and back. She applied Ya Mong balm while massaging, and I really felt like she paid meticulous attention to every detail. 👍🏽

It isn't too far from the Old Town and is right near Khlong Mae Kha, so if you're visiting Khlong Mae Kha anyway, I think it would be great to stop by here before heading to Toe Dim Sum.

reviews.textTranslated:
I went there on a friend's recommendation, and it completely relieved my fatigue. I got the 600 baht full-body massage, and it was amazing.

The masseuse I received said she was in her 70s. She had strong hand pressure and paid extra attention to loosening up the areas that were more painful! I heard that she is a masseuse frequently sought out by locals as well. There are some massages that just hurt, but the pressure here was just right!!

It was much better than the more expensive massage I got on the first day. If I had gotten it on the first day, I think I would have gotten it again on the last day too. I was so sad to leave.

Since the owner is Korean, I made a reservation via KakaoTalk. She told me to leave my luggage right away after check-in, and she even told me to take a shower before leaving, so I arrived at the airport feeling refreshed.

Oh, and the restaurant she recommended was cheap and delicious, so I ate until I was stuffed. If I go to Chiang Mai again, I plan to get massages here every time! The owner was so incredibly kind, and the staff were friendly too, so my memories of Chiang Mai remain fond ones.

reviews.name: Tracy Chen
reviews.text:
Absolute worst massage experience of my life. I booked a 2 hr Thai massage and added on the hot herbal compress. The lobby and reception were good but the problems started when I went to the massage room.

First of all, the pajamas were like a size 5XL and could have fit 2 large men inside of them. Second, the sheets+pillowcase on the bed were disposable plastic/paper which felt cheap and uncomfortable. I didn’t expect luxury but this was far from relaxing.

I put on the form that I wanted medium pressure but it felt like the masseuse was just barely putting any pressure, not even enough to kill a fly. The masseuse had zero technique whatsoever. The room was also freezing cold, even after asking her to turn up the temperature. She then suddenly put a lot of pressure on my lower back, which hurt so I told her to stop. 10 minutes later, she proceeded to put pressure on the exact same spot. In the middle of the massage, she told me she’s going to the washroom and left me for five minutes. After the hot herbal compress, she spent five minutes, cleaning up the machine when it could’ve been done after the massage was finished. Instead, I witnessed her wiping down the machine and making loud noises by putting the machine away.

reviews.text:
I chose their 90-minute promotional package combining a foot massage and an oil massage for 450 THB. After washing my feet, I was taken to a private room on the second floor to change. I was simply told to undress, but no disposable underwear was provided, so I was left wearing only my own underwear.

About a minute after lying face down, I felt something irritating my left foot. After leaving the shop, I noticed what appeared to be mite bite on my left foot and another on my right.

As for the massage itself, I was surprised that the foot massage was skipped entirely. Instead, I received 90 minutes of oil massage. The therapist seemed to have a reasonable understanding of the massage sequence and pressure points, but the pressure was far too light, and the overall experience was not very satisfying.

When I saw the therapist leaving, I noticed that she was a very petite, elderly-looking woman. In my experience, a satisfying massage requires a therapist who can adjust the pressure adequately, and I felt that this was lacking in this case.

Although the price was cheap, the missing foot massage, the disappointing treatment, and the itchy bites on my feet mean I would not return.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We re sorry for what is happened. Our housemaid’s cleaning the shop daily. If the course of massage is missing , customer can inform our cashier and we will take responsible for that. We will improve our service.

Benefits of Neck & Shoulder Massage

✅ Relieves Muscle Tension
Helps reduce tightness and stiffness in the neck, shoulders, and upper back.

✅ Reduces Neck Pain

✅ Improves Blood Circulation
Enhances blood flow, delivering oxygen and nutrients to muscles.

✅ Reduces Stress & Promotes Relaxation
Calms the nervous system and helps reduce stress and anxiety.

✅ Improves Flexibility & Range of Motion
Helps the neck and shoulders move more freely and comfortably.

✅ May Help Reduce Tension Headaches
Can ease headaches related to muscle tension in the neck and shoulders.

⸻

Possible Drawbacks

⚠️ Temporary Muscle Soreness
Some people may experience mild soreness after a deep massage.

⚠️ Bruising or Tenderness
Deep pressure may cause bruising, especially for people with sensitive skin.

⚠️ Not Suitable for Certain Conditions
People with recent injuries, fractures, severe osteoporosis, infections, or acute inflammation should avoid massage unless approved by a healthcare professional.

⚠️ May Cause Dizziness
Some people may feel lightheaded immediately after treatment. Drinking water and resting can help.

⚠️ Results May Be Temporary
If poor posture or repetitive strain continues, pain may return without lifestyle changes or exercise.

* Office workers
* People with neck and shoulder stiffness
* Computer users
* Drivers
* People experiencing stress or tension

I came to this massage shop at around 9:00 PM on September 18. I chose a package that included a 60-minute foot massage and a 60-minute full-body coconut oil massage.

At first, I was attended to by a female therapist. From the beginning, I felt that her massage technique was far too light. It felt more like she was gently touching my skin rather than actually giving me a proper massage. So I used a translator to explain to her that I preferred stronger pressure.

She did increase the pressure afterward, but I felt that she was applying stronger pressure to areas that did not really need it, while the areas where I actually wanted stronger pressure were still being treated quite lightly. Therefore, after about 45 minutes of the foot massage, I decided to stop the session.

Although I did not complete the full 60-minute foot massage, I was still willing to pay the full price for the 60-minute foot massage. I then asked the manager if I could change to another female therapist to continue with the 60-minute coconut oil full-body massage.

I spoke with a male staff member wearing a white shirt who looked very professional and energetic. What really surprised and impressed me was that, after understanding my situation, the manager did not simply pass my complaint on to another employee. Instead, he personally came over and completed the remaining 15 minutes of my foot massage.

After that, he arranged another female therapist for my coconut oil full-body massage, and I was very satisfied with the rest of the experience.

Actually, what impressed me the most was not just the massage itself, but the way this manager handled the situation.

When I explained that the first therapist's technique did not meet my needs, he did not treat me like a difficult customer who was simply complaining. Instead, he genuinely listened to what I was saying, took the time to understand what I actually needed, and personally stepped in to resolve the situation.

I really appreciate his attitude and the way he handled the situation. Being willing to truly listen to a customer's needs and personally get involved in solving the problem shows a very professional and responsible approach to customer service.

This experience left a very positive impression on me, and I would especially like to thank the manager for his understanding, patience, and help throughout the entire experience.

ownerUpdates.text:
A Different Way to Experience Bangkok. Chidlom is known for luxury shopping destinations such as Central Embassy, Central Chidlom, and Gaysorn Village. Others visit the area for business meetings, five-star hotels, or cultural landmarks such as the Erawan Shrine. 

A full day often means hours spent on your feet. Visitors walk between shopping centres, navigate the city's bustling streets, and spend long periods standing, sightseeing, or travelling between destinations. By evening, tired legs, sore shoulders, and general fatigue are common companions.

For some, a traditional Thai massage provides the perfect way to relieve muscle tension after a day of walking. Others prefer an aromatherapy massage, where calming essential oils and gentle techniques create a deeply relaxing experience. Business travellers often seek treatments that focus on the neck, shoulders, and lower back, while shoppers frequently appreciate a restorative foot massage that helps soothe tired feet. 

The best spas create a space where recovery feels effortless. Private treatment rooms, experienced therapists, premium massage oils, and thoughtful hospitality all contribute to an experience that lingers long after the treatment has ended.

Located just moments from Chidlom BTS, Vanarin Spa offers a tranquil retreat in the heart of Bangkok. Book a treatment with us with a few simple steps, just LINE us at @vanarinspa or call us +66 9 8 415 4545.

Thai Massage in a Premium Spa in Bangkok
If you opt for a Thai massage at Vanarin spa, know that Thai massage is one of Thailand’s most well-known wellness traditions, valued for its ability to restore balance, improve flexibility, and release deep tension.

But when combined with the comfort and refinement of a modern luxury premium spa, the experience becomes something more, an experience that is elevated, personalised, and deeply restorative. 

Originating in Thailand, the art of traditional Thai massage is a unique practice that blends acupressure, assisted stretching, and rhythmic movement.

Unlike oil-based treatments, it is performed without oils and works along the body’s energy lines to release blockages and improve circulation.

The result is a treatment that feels both energising and grounding, leaving the body lighter, more flexible, and rebalanced. 

While the technique remains rooted in tradition, the environment in which it is delivered plays an equally important role.

At Vanarin Spa in the Chidlom area, Thai massage is experienced within a calm, private, and thoughtfully designed space, allowing you to fully relax throughout your treatment.

Private rooms, clean modern interiors, and en-suite facilities ensure that your experience is not only effective, but comfortable from beginning to end.

Choosing the right treatment can transform your entire spa experience. Two of the most popular options, Thai massage and aromatherapy massage, offer very different benefits, each suited to different needs and preferences.

Understanding the difference can help you choose the treatment that your body truly needs.

Traditional Thai Massage: Deep, Restorative, Energising -- Rooted in centuries-old healing practices, traditional Thai massage focuses on stretching, pressure, and movement. Unlike oil-based treatments, it is performed fully clothed and works along the body’s energy lines.

Aromatherapy Massage: Calm, Soothing, Therapeutic -- Aromatherapy massage uses warm oils blended with essential extracts to calm the mind and relax the body. The movements are slower and more fluid, allowing tension to gently melt away.

We believe that a truly exceptional spa and massage experience in Bangkok comes from a combination of experience, training, and genuine care—brought together in every session. 

Experienced and Highly Trained - Our therapists are professionally trained in a range of wellness and massage techniques, including Thai massage, deep tissue, and aromatherapy. With a deep understanding of the body, they are able to work with precision, whether applying targeted pressure to release tension or using gentle, flowing movements to encourage relaxation. 

Personalised to You - Before each session, take the time to let our therapists understand your needs, whether you are experiencing tightness in specific areas, prefer a certain pressure, or simply wish to unwind. From there, every movement is adapted to suit you, creating a treatment that feels intuitive and completely personal.

Attentive and Reassuring - Beyond technique, it is the level of care that defines the experience. Our therapists are attentive without being intrusive, ensuring your comfort at every stage. Feel assured that you are in capable and caring hands.

A Commitment to Excellence - Consistency is at the heart of what we do. Every therapist at Vanarin Spa is committed to delivering the same high standard of service, so that each visit meets the expectations of a premium spa and massage in Bangkok, Thailand.

Highly recommended. ☺️

reviews.text: 타패게이트 앞 마사지거리에 있는 맛사지샆.물론 케바게지만 관광객을 상대로 한 맛사지샆은 안 좋을 것이라는 예상을 깬 집.환전을 위해서 오가다 많은 맛사지사가 있어 5일만에 우리부부외 딸 3명이서 갔는데  미리 왔으면 한번 더 갔었을 맛사지 샾.일단 타패게이트 바로 앞에 있어서 접근성이 좋고  에어컨도 나오고 진짜 좋은 것은 맛사지사가 진심이었다.(물론 우리가 운이 좋은 것 인지 모르겠지만^^) 90분 동안 맛사지사 3명이서  수다도 안 떨고 쉬지않고 최선을 다해줘서 맛사지후 우리가족 3명 모두 만족. 단,타이맛사지 1시간이 프로모션 280B, 인데 90분이 정상가격 적용 450B인건 지금도 이해가 안됨. 그리고 중요한 것 하나 다른 곳은 카드가 안되는데  이곳은 트래블로그 카드가 된다~~~
reviews.textTranslated: A massage shop located on the massage street in front of Tha Phae Gate. Of course, it varies from place to place, but this place defied my expectation that massage shops catering to tourists would be bad. We visited five days later with my husband, our daughter, and me because we saw many masseurs while passing by to exchange money; it is a shop we would have visited again if we had come earlier. First of all, it is easily accessible as it is right in front of Tha Phae Gate, and it has air conditioning. The best part, however, was that the masseurs were sincere. (Of course, I don't know if we were just lucky, though.) For 90 minutes, three masseurs did their best without chatting or taking a break, so all three of our family members were satisfied after the massage. However, I still don't understand why a 1-hour Thai massage is 280B on promotion, while the 90-minute session is charged at the regular price of 450B. And one important thing: other places don't accept cards, but this place accepts the Travelogue card!

reviews.name: Jack Jiang
reviews.text:
我本身不是爱给差评的人，如果仅仅只是按摩手法一般，这个亏我也就认了，但后续的处理态度实在让人难以接受。花800多人民币买了这家三小时按摩套餐，本来冲着高价和装修预期能有对应服务，结果全程体验拉胯。

套餐流程自带45分钟泡澡，正常人泡15分钟就够，久泡甚至会晕，没泡够时长换成普通古法按摩，技师还是原本的人但手法普通没亮点，真正上手认真按摩的时间也就1小时出头，性价比低得离谱。更糟的是最后一小时按摩时，店里水管坏了飘出浓烈恶臭，我们硬扛20多分钟才被安排换房，这种低级设施问题根本不该出现在这个价位的高端店。

找前台反馈后主管虽然露面，但全程心不在焉忙着处理别的事，没拿出半点认真回应的态度，只拿总价120块的小护手霜敷衍（我们没有要，因为觉得有点搞笑）。明知道我们后天就要坐飞机离开，还空口说白话让我们隔天再来、说下次给折扣，连句发自内心的真诚道歉都没有。全程还能明显感觉到，他们对欧洲面孔顾客态度更热情客气，对中国顾客就轻慢敷衍。

同行的伙伴和我感受一致，同样十分气愤，所以我们分别留下真实体验。花高价买了一肚子气，绝对不推荐大家踩坑。
reviews.textTranslated:
I'm not one to give bad reviews, and if it were just a mediocre massage, I could accept the loss. However, the subsequent handling of the situation was unacceptable. I paid over 800 RMB for a three-hour massage package, expecting corresponding service based on the high price and the decor, but the entire experience was a disaster.

The package included a 45-minute bath, but for most people, 15 minutes is enough; soaking for too long can even cause dizziness. Before that, we were switched to a standard traditional massage. The masseuse was the same one, but her technique was mediocre and unremarkable. The actual time spent on a proper massage was only a little over an hour, making it ridiculously overpriced. To make matters worse, during the last hour of the massage, the water pipes broke, emitting a strong, foul odor. We endured it for over 20 minutes before being moved to a different room. Such basic facility issues shouldn't exist in a high-end establishment at this price.

After reporting the problem to the front desk, the manager did appear, but was distracted and busy with other matters, showing no seriousness whatsoever. They only offered a small hand cream worth 120 RMB as a perfunctory response (which we refused because we found it ridiculous). Knowing we were flying out the day after tomorrow, they offered no real apology, only empty promises about coming back the following day and a discount. Throughout the entire visit, it was clear they were much warmer and more courteous to European customers, while treating Chinese customers with disdain and indifference.

My travel companion and I shared the same sentiment and were equally furious, so we each left our honest experiences. We paid a high price and ended up feeling incredibly angry; I absolutely do not recommend anyone try this.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We sincerely apologize for the disappointing experience you had with us. We completely understand your frustration, especially after choosing our three-hour package and expecting a level of service that matched your expectations.

We are particularly sorry that the facility issue, the disruption during your treatment, and the way your concerns were handled made the experience even more disappointing. You deserved to feel heard and properly taken care of, and we regret that we failed to do so.

Thank you for sharing such detailed feedback. We will take your comments seriously and review both our service and the way we handle guest concerns to ensure we do better in the future.

reviews.name: Patricia Faust
reviews.text:
I had a very good experience at Supattra. There were five therapists available, and I was paired with a female therapist. Although she did not speak English, another therapist welcomed me and helped with payment, and Mr. Nat spoke excellent English. I explained my injuries to him, and he made sure my therapist understood where she needed to be careful. He also helped communicate that I needed to change, and she provided massage pants and showed me the changing area.

The facility was clean and cool, the massage bed was comfortable, and my therapist did a wonderful job. I felt well cared for throughout my massage.

My only negative was that another customer began talking very loudly, which was distracting. Otherwise, this was a wonderful, no-frills, authentic experience. I also feel very good about supporting a local establishment that provides work for blind and visually impaired massage therapists.

I was impressed enough with Mr. Nat that I made an appointment to return the very next day specifically for a massage with him.

Professional, relaxed and friendly.

Came here on our first day Phuket and went back for two more times! Yes, there are more “cheaper” places on the streets, but we valued non-rushed massages. You get quality and personalised massages here and we are willing to pay that little bit extra. (total ~750-1000 baht for 60min)

What we really liked is the peace at the reception from the beginning. It is a clean shop and quite big. There are packages or single options, and often discount if you are with two persons. You can pick your oil scent and recieve a welcome drink. There is a form to fill in for personalisation. 2/3 we could just go in straight away, depending on the kind of massage and authorised staff. The spa feeling continued when you needed a change of clothes. The massages were very good, problem areas targeted, and we felt relaxed after. Complimenting tea at the end. For us really a deserved 5 star.

reviews.name: Chris
reviews.text:
⭐ 1/5 — Extremely disappointing and completely overpriced.
This is honestly the worst massage experience I have ever had, in Thailand or anywhere else.
I paid for a 90-minute traditional Thai massage. The therapist was awake and properly performing the treatment for only about the first 15 minutes. For the rest of the session, she was repeatedly sleeping while she was supposed to be providing the massage. Three out of the four people in our group witnessed this.
The treatment itself was also far from what we paid for. The therapist did not follow the expected Thai massage routine, and many of the usual steps were completely skipped. The service was nowhere near the standard we expected from a well-known massage shop.
The worst part was how our complaint was handled.
When I reported the issue to the manager, instead of seriously addressing the complaint, she asked me to provide evidence that the therapist was sleeping.
How exactly was I supposed to do that? I was lying face down on the massage mat during the treatment. Am I supposed to get up, take out my phone and photograph the therapist while she is sleeping? I even explained that if I told her, “You are sleeping, please don’t move, I need to take a photo,” obviously she could simply wake up and pose for the photo. The fact that I didn’t have a photograph does not mean it didn’t happen.
The front desk simply apologized without offering any meaningful solution. When I escalated the complaint to the manager, her response was essentially that there was nothing she could do because we started more than 15 minutes.
Started more than 15 minutes does NOT justify a therapist sleeping through most of a 90-minute treatment. If there was a problem with the remaining treatment time because we were late, that should have been clearly explained to us before the massage started.
What makes this even more unacceptable is the price.
This was the most expensive massage we had during our entire trip — roughly three times the price of other places — yet the quality was not even one-tenth of what we received elsewhere.
I have had massages in many different countries, and this was genuinely the worst value and worst service I have experienced.
Paying a premium price is one thing. Paying a premium price for a therapist who sleeps through the treatment, receiving an incomplete massage, and then being told to “provide evidence” when you complain is completely unacceptable.
Very disappointing experience. I would strongly recommend thinking twice before spending your money here.

reviews.name: Queenie
reviews.text:
Extremely disappointing experience.
This was, without a doubt, the worst massage experience I have ever had.
My friend booked and paid for a 90-minute Thai massage. The therapist was awake and actually performing the massage for roughly the first 15 minutes. After that, she spent most of the remaining session sleeping.
There were four of us in total, and three of us clearly witnessed the therapist sleeping during the treatment. This wasn’t a misunderstanding or a minor issue — it was extremely obvious.
What was even more disappointing was that my friend’s treatment was completely different from ours. Several of the usual steps of a Thai massage were simply skipped, and the therapist did not provide anything close to the same level of service that the rest of us received.
We reported the situation to the manager afterwards. Instead of apologising or properly investigating the complaint, the manager asked us to provide evidence that the therapist was sleeping.
Seriously? What exactly were we supposed to do — take photos or videos of our friend during a massage while she was barely dressed? Of course we weren’t going to violate our friend’s privacy just to prove something that happened inside a private treatment room.
The attitude towards our complaint was almost as disappointing as the massage itself.
We paid around three times the price of a normal local massage, yet the quality of the service was nowhere near what we expected. Honestly, the service was not even one-tenth of the quality we have received elsewhere.
If you charge premium prices, customers have every right to expect professional service. A therapist sleeping through a large portion of a customer’s paid 90-minute treatment is simply unacceptable.
Based on this experience, I would absolutely not recommend this place and will never come back.

Были здесь в конце 2024 начале 2025 года несколько раз у разных массажистов.
Рекомендации перед посещением
1. Берите с собой сменную одежду, пижаму, например, с длинными рукавами и штанинами. Так как достаточно прохладно внутри, то вещи с длинными рукавами и штаны вам помогут, к тому же могут помазать мазью.

3.Не опаздывайте.
4. Записываться лучше по телефону и бронировать определённого массажиста/ку.
5 В первый раз можно взять на час, для ознакомления с обстановкой, массажистом, силой.

reviews.textTranslated:
We visited here several times in late 2024 and early 2025, with different massage therapists.
Recommendations before visiting
1. Bring a change of clothes, such as pajamas, for example, with long sleeves and pants. Since it's quite cool inside, long sleeves and pants will help, and they can also apply ointment.
2. Bringing your own large towel is a good idea, either to cover yourself or to lay on your mattress and pillow.
3. Don't be late.
4. It's best to book by phone and reserve a specific massage therapist.
5. For your first time, you can book an hour to get acquainted with the atmosphere, the massage therapist, and the strength.
I liked the atmosphere; yes, there's no "grooming" here; everything is quite austere and simple, but if you find your massage therapist, it's worth it!
No matter where I've been, I like this place more than anywhere else. The most important thing is to find your massage therapist! This is crucial.
I found the very best, who helped me a lot and eliminated my problems.

После проверки записей с камер видеонаблюдения мы увидели, что наш сотрудник подробно объяснил Вам стоимость массажа — 350 бат за 1 час — ещё на стойке регистрации перед началом процедуры. Однако, как мы понимаем, произошло недопонимание, и Вы поняли, что 350 бат — это стоимость массажа продолжительностью 90 минут.

После окончания массажа Вы сообщили, что готовы оплатить 350 бат, но хотели получить массаж продолжительностью 90 минут. Вчера менеджера салона не было на месте, поэтому сотрудник не мог самостоятельно предоставить дополнительные 30 минут массажа за 350 бат.

Сотрудник объяснил Вам, что если Вы хотите продлить массаж ещё на 30 минут, необходимо доплатить, и общая стоимость составит 500 бат. Однако Вы отказались оплачивать 500 бат и настаивали на оплате 350 бат за массаж продолжительностью 90 минут.

После дополнительной проверки мы подтвердили, что в системе была оформлена только одна запись на массаж шеи и плеч продолжительностью 1 час, а с Вас была взята оплата только 350 бат.

Тем не менее, от имени нашего сотрудника мы искренне приносим Вам свои извинения за возникшее недопонимание. Возможно, сотрудник недостаточно хорошо владеет английским и русским языками, что могло привести к недоразумению при объяснении продолжительности и стоимости процедуры.

Мы благодарим Вас за понимание и ещё раз приносим свои искренние извинения за доставленные неудобства.

reviews.name: Mai Kaleta
reviews.text:
今回RSMインターナショナルマッサージスクールにて、トリガーポイント&スポーツマッサージのコースを5日間受講させて頂来ました🙏タイのチェンマイには何度も足を運び、タイ古式マッサージ、オイルマッサージなどを学んで来ましたが、今回の学びは自分にとってとても核となる講座でした。

一番はアナトミー=解剖学。講義は英語で進められます。予めある程度は筋肉の名前、起始と停止、筋繊維の方向は頭に入れておく必要性がありますが、日本語でも筋肉の図と名前を理解してれば、スライドを見たときに「あっ、多分この筋肉だな」というのはわかるかと思います。出来たら日本人の方は、筋肉名が英語でも書かれた解剖学の本を一冊お持ち頂くと良いかと思います。

しかしながら、講義もありつつ、とにかくすぐ実践に入ります。講義と実戦の繰り返しです。そのテンポが非常に良く、毎日時間が経つのがあっという間でした。

トリガーポイントの見つけ方、通常のマッサージとスポーツマッサージの違い…リラクゼーションの世界でやってきた私には目から鱗でした。

そして何より今回の講座で改めて知った一番大事なこと、それは「ゆっくり動かすこと」です。更に言うと「ゆっくり、そして深く」です。大切なのは手技の多さではなく、触診術なのです。

SNS、特にインスタグラムで良く流れてくる見栄えの良いマッサージは…時に本当のマッサージではないかもしれません（笑）そのことが、この講座を受けることで理解することが出来ると思います。

私は英語が得意ではなく、他の生徒達と深いコミュニケーションをとることは難しいなと最初は感じていましたが、やはりボディワークですので、お互いの身体を触ってるとシンプルな英語で十分フィードバックは出来るかと思います。

私はせっかく学んだこの技術を日本で使用し、次回チェンマイに来る際はRSMの他のコースも是非受けたいと考えています。それまでに実戦だけではなく、引き続き解剖学と英語も頑張りたいと思いました💪
reviews.textTranslated:
I recently attended a 5-day Trigger Point & Sports Massage course at RSM International Massage School. I've traveled to Chiang Mai, Thailand many times to study Thai massage and oil massage, but this course was truly fundamental for me.

The most important aspect was anatomy. The lectures were conducted in English. While some prior knowledge of muscle names, origins and insertions, and muscle fiber direction is necessary, understanding muscle diagrams and names in Japanese will help you recognize the muscles in the slides. Ideally, Japanese students should bring an anatomy textbook with English muscle names.

However, despite the lectures, the course quickly moved into practical application. It was a constant cycle of lectures and hands-on practice. The pace was excellent, and each day flew by.

Learning how to find trigger points, the differences between regular massage and sports massage…it was eye-opening for someone like me who has worked in the relaxation field.

And most importantly, the most crucial lesson I learned in this course was the importance of "moving slowly." Furthermore, it's about being "slow and deep." What's important isn't the number of techniques, but the art of palpation.

The visually appealing massages you often see on social media, especially Instagram, might not always be real massages (lol). I think you'll understand this after taking this course.

I'm not very good at English, and at first I felt it would be difficult to communicate deeply with the other students. However, since it's bodywork, I think simple English is sufficient for giving feedback while touching each other's bodies.

I want to use the techniques I've learned in Japan, and the next time I come to Chiang Mai, I definitely want to take other RSM courses. Until then, I want to continue working hard not only on practical application, but also on anatomy and English! 💪
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
このたびは、RSM International AcademyのTrigger Point Therapy & Sports Massage Courseを5日間受講していただき、本当にありがとうございました。
今回のトレーニングでは、すでにホテルやリラクゼーション環境で高いレベルのマッサージ経験をお持ちのあなたに対して、その豊富な経験をさらに発展させるために、スポーツ医学、機能解剖学、キネティックチェーン、そして臨床的な触診技術という新しい視点を加えることを意識して指導しました。
もともと非常に優れたアドバンステクニックをお持ちでしたが、今回特にフォーカスしたのは、単に多くの手技を使うことではなく、筋肉の位置、筋線維の方向、起始停止、動きとの関係を理解しながら、正確に触れて評価する力です。スポーツ医学ベースのマッサージでは、この「触診して理解する力」が非常に重要になります。
今回お伝えした内容は、RSMで普段、医療関係者、理学療法士、5スターホテルのセラピスト、スポーツ分野で活動する専門家、ヨーロッパのトップレベルで働くマッサージセラピストにも指導している考え方や技術を、あなたの経験やバックグラウンドに合わせて分かりやすく調整したものです。
また、英語での授業環境の中でも、他国の生徒としっかりコミュニケーションを取りながら、非常に真剣に練習されていた姿勢も素晴らしかったです。実技の吸収も早く、今回の5日間で触診、Trigger Point Therapy、Sports Massage、Functional Anatomy、Kinetic Chainの理解をかなり高いレベルまで深めることができたと思います。
ぜひ今回学んだ技術を日本で実際のお客様に使ってみてください。これまでの素晴らしいマッサージ技術に、今回学んだスポーツ医学的な評価、触診、動きの分析を加えることで、これまでとは違った、より具体的な反応をお客様から感じられるはずです。
自信を持って続けてください。今回の経験は、あなたのプロフェッショナルとしての技術をさらに一段上へ進めるための、とても良いベースになったと思います。
また近い将来チェンマイでお会いし、次のレベルのトレーニングをご一緒できることを楽しみにしています。

Hironori Ikeda : MSc Sports Medicine 
RSM International Academy

reviews.textTranslated:
I went there today based on a recommendation from an acquaintance that it was excellent, the best.
But I was disappointed. Inside the massage room, it smelled strongly of food. I went with a friend.
The masseuses on both our beds and my friend's were talking nonsense the whole time, not focusing on the massage at all. It felt like they were just squeezing and pressing, stopping the massage to talk loudly. The worst part was that the older masseuse wasn't wearing a mask and was sneezing, wetting my legs with mucus and saliva.
Even though the price was cheaper than other places, I think it was a waste of time and unhygienic.

reviews.name: ICIC
reviews.text:
真的很喜歡這間按摩店的老泰式風情，如果你經過，別被暗暗的門戶嚇到了，裡面的按摩師都是很有經驗的阿姨、甚至是阿嬤，手法純熟，可以梳理全身筋膜，讓僵硬的軀體，逐漸放鬆而獲得充分休息。價錢是一小時300泰銖，物超所值，強烈建議起碼要90分鐘才能按到位。
其他泰式按摩，大部分一到都會請客人面朝下趴著按背，可是對我這種肩頸僵硬且趴著容易鼻塞的人士來說，要趴著一段時間對肩頸負擔很大、呼吸也不順暢，此店不是，會讓客人面朝上躺下，按完正面接著兩邊側躺，最後才是面朝下，我非常喜歡這個安排。
按摩時店內還會一邊播放泰式老情歌，整個人都沉浸在復古的氛圍中.
我平常在台灣按摩是喜歡力道很大的師傅，這家店完全正中下懷，來了幾次都很滿意。
reviews.textTranslated:
I really loved the old-fashioned Thai ambiance of this massage parlor. If you happen to pass by, don't be intimidated by the dimly lit entrance; the masseuses inside are all very experienced aunties or even grandmothers. Their techniques are skillful, able to massage the entire body's fascia, gradually relaxing stiff bodies and allowing for a full rest. The price is 300 baht per hour, excellent value for money, and I highly recommend at least 90 minutes for a proper massage.

Most other Thai massages ask customers to lie face down for a back massage, but for someone like me with stiff shoulders and neck and prone to nasal congestion when lying face down, it's very stressful and makes breathing difficult. This parlor is different; they have customers lie face up, massage their front, then their sides, and finally face down. I really loved this arrangement.

During the massage, they play old Thai love songs, immersing you in a retro atmosphere.

I usually prefer masseuses with strong pressure in Taiwanese massages, and this parlor is exactly what I'm looking for. I've been very satisfied with my several visits.

reviews.text:
2泊3日のタイ旅行で2回利用しました。

I used this place twice during my 2-night, 3-day trip to Thailand.

I will definitely go back when I return to Bangkok.

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
感谢您分享您的反馈。对于此次按摩体验未能达到您的期望，我们深表歉意。

我们一直致力于为每一位顾客提供舒适、满意的按摩体验。如果您觉得按摩师的力度或手法不适合您，建议您在按摩开始后的 5–10 分钟内及时告知前台，我们很乐意为您更换其他按摩师，希望能让您获得更满意的体验。

您的意见对我们非常重要，我们也会不断改进服务质量。希望未来还有机会再次为您服务，为您带来更好的按摩体验。

reviews.name: Tina -
reviews.text:
价格一般，技术也一般。整体体验感不如其他家。
1. 店里客人都是说中文的，这种情况下支付宝和微信还要加收3%，昨天去的其他家就没加。
2. 技师一直在聊天，和左边聊完和右边聊，然后还和帘子外边的聊。90分钟没停过，中间她忽然不按了，睁眼看到她在聊手机，很不专业。
3. 做的herb热敷，热敷的蒸锅离躺着的位置太远了，导致刚热敷个30秒左右技师就要去换。身上的热蒸汽就会瞬间冷下来，导致后来不但没热没舒缓反而更紧绷了。根本没有站在客户角度考虑。
reviews.textTranslated:
The price and the technique were both mediocre. The overall experience was inferior to other salons.

1. The customers in the salon all spoke Chinese, yet Alipay and WeChat payments incurred an extra 3% charge. Other salons I visited yesterday didn't charge this.

2. The technician was constantly chatting, talking to the person on the left, then the person on the right, and then even talking to someone outside the curtain. She didn't stop for 90 minutes. Suddenly, she stopped massaging, and when I opened my eyes, I saw her talking on her phone – very unprofessional.

3. During the herb hot compress treatment, the steamer was too far from where I was lying, forcing the technician to change it after only about 30 seconds. The steam cooled down instantly, leaving me feeling even tighter instead of warmer or more soothed. She clearly didn't consider the customer's needs.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
非常感谢您愿意花时间留下这么详细的反馈，也很抱歉这次的服务没有给您带来满意的体验。

关于您提到的几个问题，我们都已经认真了解并会进一步检查和改进。特别是按摩过程中员工聊天、使用手机，以及草药热敷过程中温度和操作的问题，这些确实会影响客人的放松体验，我们会提醒并加强员工的培训，避免类似情况再次发生。

关于使用支付宝和微信支付所产生的3%手续费，我们也很抱歉当时没有让您感受到足够清楚的说明。我们会更加注意在客人付款前提前说明相关费用。

感谢您的意见，这些反馈对我们来说非常重要。我们会认真改进服务，希望以后还有机会再次为您服务，并给您带来更好的体验。

再次向您表示歉意，也谢谢您的理解与建议。🙏

reviews.text:
Ho provato per la prima volta il massaggio thailandese in questa spa del resort e ne sono rimasta davvero entusiasta! ✨
Sono rimasta piacevolmente colpita dalla professionalità del personale, dalla pulizia impeccabile degli ambienti e dall’atmosfera rilassante che si respira.
Un ringraziamento speciale va alla terapista V, davvero eccezionale: bravissima, attenta, delicata e allo stesso tempo molto competente. Ha saputo mettermi subito a mio agio, dimostrando grande cura, sensibilità e professionalità in ogni momento del trattamento.
È stata un’esperienza meravigliosa, rigenerante e molto al di sopra delle mie aspettative, soprattutto considerando che era la mia prima volta con un massaggio thailandese.
Consiglio assolutamente questa spa a chiunque soggiorni nel resort e desideri concedersi un momento di vero benessere. Ci tornerei sicuramente! ❤️🌺

She operates from a small but beautiful corner of her home. The setting is lovely, with great views of the beach and her pool area, creating a relaxing atmosphere. Since she works with only one client at a time, the experience feels quite private and personal.

The home is located inside a residential locality, so it can be a little difficult to find, especially if you’re traveling alone by cab. She also has a dog, which may be something to keep in mind if you’re uncomfortable around dogs.

As for the facial, I personally didn’t find it as impressive as the reviews had led me to expect, especially considering the price. On the positive side, she communicates well in English and is easy to interact with.

Overall, it was a decent one-time experience, but I probably wouldn’t return. I also wouldn’t particularly recommend it to tourists, as I felt it was relatively expensive compared to other facial and spa options available in Phuket that offer similar or better results.

reviews.name: Chakumi
reviews.text:
プーケット・オールドタウンを歩いている途中に立ち寄りました。プーケット発のブランドで、タイのハーブなどを使ったナチュラル系のスキンケア用品やスパ製品が並んでいます。プーケットならではのお土産を探している方にもぴったりのお店です。

オイルが「2個購入すると1個無料」だったので、全部で3個購入しました。瓶ではなく軽い容器に入っているため、割れる心配が少なく、スーツケースに入れて日本へ持ち帰りやすいのも旅行者には嬉しいポイントです。

そして何より素晴らしかったのが、店員さんの接客でした。商品のことを一つひとつ丁寧に教えてくださいますが、決して押しつけがましくありません。こちらがゆっくり見たいときには静かに待ち、必要なときには自然に声をかけてくれる、その距離感が本当に絶妙でした。

旅行中はいろいろなお店に入りましたが、今までで一番心地良いと感じるほどの接客でした。自分用にはもちろん、プーケット土産を探している方にもおすすめです。
reviews.textTranslated:
I stopped by this shop while walking around Phuket Old Town. It's a Phuket-based brand, offering natural skincare and spa products made with Thai herbs and other ingredients. It's a perfect shop for anyone looking for unique Phuket souvenirs.

I bought three oils because they had a "buy two, get one free" promotion. The oils come in lightweight containers rather than glass bottles, making them less likely to break and easy to pack in a suitcase for travel back to Japan – a great advantage for travelers.

But what was truly wonderful was the customer service. They explained each product carefully, without being pushy. They patiently waited when I wanted to browse, and offered assistance naturally when needed – their sense of distance was absolutely perfect.

I visited many shops during my trip, but this was the most pleasant customer service I experienced. I highly recommend it, not only for personal use but also for anyone looking for Phuket souvenirs.

reviews.name: David Rana
reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience – would not recommend

Unfortunately, my stay at this hotel was extremely disappointing, and I would not recommend it based on my experience.

First of all, the cleanliness was unacceptable. The showers and toilets were dirty, and when I raised the issue with the staff, there was no proper response or meaningful explanation. I was not offered any solution, compensation, or even a genuine apology.

The fitness center was an even more serious issue. There was an extremely strong smell of fresh paint or other chemical substances inside the gym. The odor was so intense that after only around five minutes I started feeling sick and dizzy. This is especially concerning in a fitness room, where people are breathing heavily during exercise. I genuinely believe the air quality in that room could pose a health risk.

When I complained about this, the staff member told me that the gym is checked every day and that the owner apparently uses the treadmill there every day as well. In my opinion, that is not a reasonable response to a health and safety concern. The fact that someone uses the gym does not prove that the air is safe. I found the response very unprofessional and dismissive.

The smoking policy was also very strange. We were clearly informed that this is a non-smoking hotel, and I completely respect a rule that prohibits smoking on the balcony. However, the designated smoking area is located directly in a corridor near the entrance, where other guests have to walk past on their way to their rooms.

When I pointed out to the staff member that other guests have to walk directly through the smoking area and therefore have to pass through cigarette smoke, her response was honestly one of the most unreasonable answers I have ever received from hotel staff. She told me that people generally smoke at this hotel anyway, so it is not a problem, because the guests walking past would probably smoke as well.

I find this argument completely unacceptable. The fact that some guests smoke does not mean that every guest wants to be exposed to cigarette smoke, nor does it justify placing a smoking area directly in a passageway used by other guests. A designated smoking area should be positioned in a way that does not unnecessarily expose non-smoking guests to secondhand smoke.

Another issue was the overall atmosphere and the way we were treated as guests. In the evenings, several large buses with Chinese tour groups arrived at the hotel, sometimes with dozens of people in each group. As guests who booked independently through Booking.com, we felt that our concerns were simply not taken seriously. The staff seemed much more focused on handling the large tour groups than on addressing individual guests’ problems.

What disappointed me most was the complete lack of accountability. When I raised the issues with the cleanliness, the staff did not properly acknowledge the condition of the toilets or showers. There was no meaningful apology, no attempt to resolve the problems, and no indication that the hotel took the complaints seriously.

I had originally booked two nights, but after experiencing these conditions, I checked out after only one night because I did not want to spend another night there.

I have stayed in many hotels, and this was honestly one of the most disappointing experiences I have had. The combination of poor cleanliness, the unacceptable condition of the fitness center, the poorly located smoking area, and the dismissive attitude of the staff made the stay completely unacceptable for me.

I would strongly recommend that management take these issues seriously and improve both the cleanliness of the hotel and the way guest complaints are handled.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear David Rana

Thank you for taking the time to share your detailed feedback. We sincerely apologize that your stay fell far short of our usual standards and for the issues you experienced.

We take your comments regarding cleanliness, gym air quality, smoking area placement, and staff service very seriously. These matters have been escalated to our management team, and immediate corrective actions are being taken to address them.

We deeply regret that we failed to provide you with a satisfactory experience.

Best regards,
Areca Resort & Spa

The manager was outside in front of the salon at the time, and nobody seemed to understand what I was trying to convey. I ended the treatment early, and the therapist went outside to bring the manager back inside.

To her credit, she apologised and offered a 100 baht discount from the 700 baht price. The therapist also sincerely apologised once he clearly understood what had happened. I went directly to a nearby pharmacy and spent another 250 baht on treatment.

I bear no ill will towards the spa or staff, but based on this experience, I would hesitate in returning.

Mother and daughter from Russia🤗

reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Лучший салон на Пхукете! ❤️

Здравствуйте, уважаемый персонал! Хочу от всей души поблагодарить вас за ваши золотые руки, профессионализм и невероятно тёплое отношение к нам на протяжении всего нашего пребывания на Пхукете! 🥰

Единственное, о чём я жалею, — что не нашла вас сразу!

Массаж просто изумительный! 😍 Я несколько раз даже засыпала во время процедуры — настолько всё было расслабляюще и комфортно. Мастера очень милые, добрые и дружелюбные, всегда встречали нас с улыбкой.

Отдельно хочу отметить наращивание ресниц — я в полном восторге! Всё прекрасно держится, никакой аллергии или дискомфорта. Мастер подобрала идеальную форму именно под мои глаза и густоту натуральных ресниц. Получилось очень красиво и естественно! ❤️

В самом салоне очень чисто, уютно и приятно пахнет. Чистые полотенца, мягкие подушки, комфортная атмосфера — видно, что здесь действительно заботятся о клиентах. И отдельный плюс — отличное центральное расположение!

Мы вам очень благодарны и уже очень вас любим! ❤️ Будем скучать и обязательно вернёмся к вам в следующем году! 🇹🇭🌴

Спасибо вам огромное за вашу работу и заботу! До скорой встречи! 🥰
reviews.textTranslated:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

The best salon in Phuket! ❤️

Hello, dear staff! I want to thank you from the bottom of my heart for your skillful hands, professionalism, and incredibly warm welcome throughout our stay in Phuket! 🥰

The only thing I regret is that I didn't find you sooner!

The massage was simply amazing! 😍 I even fell asleep several times during the treatment – ​​it was so relaxing and comfortable. The lash artists were so sweet, kind, and friendly, always greeting us with a smile.

I'd also like to mention the eyelash extensions – I'm absolutely delighted! They're holding up beautifully, and I haven't had any allergies or discomfort. The lash artist found the perfect shape for my eyes and the thickness of my natural lashes. The results are beautiful and natural! ❤️

The salon itself is very clean, cozy, and smells wonderful. Clean towels, soft pillows, a comfortable atmosphere—it's clear they truly care about their customers. And the excellent central location is a special plus!

We're so grateful and already love you! ❤️ We'll miss you and will definitely be back next year! 🇹🇭🌴

Thank you so much for your work and care! See you soon! 🥰

reviews.text:
Wir waren zum zweiten Mal in diesem Spa und es war beide Male wirklich großartig.
Es ist Höherpreisiger als man es von Thailand gewohnt ist, aber definitiv jeden Baht wert. Das Personal ist super freundlich und man fühlt sich sofort gut aufgehoben, sobald man das Spa betritt.
Ich hatte beide Male eine Fußmassage und zusätzlich wurde auch eine Kopfmassage gemacht.
Ein wirklich tolles und erholsames Erlebnis.
Wir kommen sehr gern wieder, wenn wir wieder in Bangkok sind.
reviews.textTranslated:
This was our second visit to this spa, and both times it was truly wonderful.

It's more expensive than what you might expect in Thailand, but definitely worth every baht. The staff is incredibly friendly, and you immediately feel welcome and well taken care of as soon as you enter the spa.

Both times I had a foot massage, and they also gave me a head massage.

A truly fantastic and relaxing experience.

We'd love to come back again when we're in Bangkok.

reviews.name: Tammi - Luxury Travel
reviews.text:
Nalina Spa in Bangkok was such a great find. The first thing I noticed was the raised, heated massage beds. They were incredibly soft and comfortable, completely different from the hard, flat beds you find at so many massage places.

The spa itself is impressive. It’s a large, multi-floor building that is beautifully decorated, with a relaxing atmosphere from the moment you walk in.

The Thai massage was excellent, and the soft heated bed made the experience even better. It is a little pricier than many massage places in Bangkok, but the extra comfort, beautiful surroundings, and quality of the massage made it well worth it.

Definitely a place I would return to when I'm in Bangkok.

Learn from the original source of all Northern-style Thai Massage.

reviews.name: MÁRIO MIGUEL
reviews.text:
I had an incredible experience with Old Medicine Hospital Thai Massage School in Chiang Mai — it truly is a remarkable place to learn and grow. This school has a rich heritage as the birthplace of traditional Northern-style Thai massage, and you can feel that history and authenticity throughout the entire learning environment.
The staff and teachers are not only highly skilled but also genuinely warm, supportive, and professional. They create such a welcoming atmosphere that makes every student feel encouraged and valued. The way they share their knowledge with patience and care makes the learning process deeply rewarding.
In particular, I want to express special appreciation for Teacher Lek. Her level of professionalism, kindness, and respectful communication with every student has been truly inspiring. She teaches with such clarity and dedication, always ensuring every student feels supported and understood. Her positive energy and never-ending patience uplift the entire class, and her guidance has made a profound impact on both my learning and confidence.Txs Lek and Gap.
Overall, this school and its people have exceeded all expectations — a perfect blend of tradition, expertise, and heartfelt teaching that I would highly recommend to anyone looking to deepen their skills and understanding.

Mário Ribeiro

호텔 근처라서 방문했다가 예약이 다 차서 다음 날 예약 후 방문했어요. 대규모 샵은 아니라 저녁 시간대에는 예약을 하는 게 안전한 것 같아요.

발마사지 60분 + 타이마사지 60분했는데 정말 좋았습니다.
발마사지는 발, 종아리, 허벅지까지 체어에서 해주는데 너무 시원했습니다.
타이마사지는 방으로 이동해서 받았는데 발마사지와 연결되게 발부터 다리, 팔, 손, 등, 어깨 순으로 진행되었습니다.

한국에서도 타이마사지를 종종 받았었는데
여기서 받는 마사지가 훨씬 좋았습니다.
근육, 근막을 시원하게 풀어주십니다.
평소에 다른 곳에서 마사지를 받을 때는 허벅지가 항상 간지럽거나 아팠는데, 여기는 전혀 그렇지 않고 시원하게 마사지 해주십니다.
이제 떠나게 되어 다시 방문하지 못해서 아쉽습니다.
다시 방콕에 여행오게 되면 꼭 다시 오고 싶네요.
여기 마사지 정말 잘해요. 꼭 오세요.

- 대가 없이 서비스에 만족해서 쓰는 리뷰입니다. -
reviews.textTranslated:
I visited because it was near my hotel, but it was fully booked, so I made a reservation for the next day and visited. Since it isn't a large-scale shop, I think it's safer to make a reservation for evening hours.

I had a 60-minute foot massage and a 60-minute Thai massage, and it was really good.

The foot massage covered my feet, calves, and thighs while sitting in a chair, and it was incredibly refreshing.

I moved to a private room for the Thai massage; it was designed to connect seamlessly with the foot massage, proceeding in the order of feet, legs, arms, hands, back, and shoulders.

I used to get Thai massages often in Korea, but the massage here was much better.

They really loosen up the muscles and fascia.

Usually, when I get massages at other places, my thighs always feel ticklish or painful, but here, that wasn't the case at all; they gave me a truly refreshing massage.

I am sad that I won't be able to visit again because I have to leave now.

If I travel to Bangkok again, I definitely want to come back.

The massage here is really good. You must come.

- This is a review written out of satisfaction with the service, without any compensation. -

Alors tout d'abord, je suis venu le matin vers 11h, et il faut savoir qu'il n'y avait que 2 filles de disponibles à ce moment ( je ne sais pas du tout si l'on peut réserver celle que l'on préfère à l'avance ). J'ai choisi Candy, très jolie jeune femme, un joli visage et un joli corps. Elle est également extrèmement compétente. Bon, j'aurais aimé qu'elle me prévienne quelques minutes avant de la fin de la séance, pour que je puisse terminer. Et puis comme je suis très romantique, j'aurais aimé un calin ( hug ) qui dure au moins une minute à la fin. Mais sinon Candy a été excellente du début à la fin. C'est un très bon souvenir qui restera dans mon coeur pendant très longtemps. L'hotesse à l'accueil a aussi été très souriante et tellement gentille, c'est vraiment agréable, merci à elle également.
reviews.textTranslated: An honest review to help future customers. First of all, I arrived around 11 am, and there were only two girls available at that time (I have no idea if you can reserve your preferred one in advance). I chose Candy, a very pretty young woman with a lovely face and figure. She is also extremely skilled. I wish she had let me know a few minutes before the end of the session so I could finish. And since I'm very romantic, I would have liked a hug that lasted at least a minute at the end. But otherwise, Candy was excellent from beginning to end. It's a wonderful memory that will stay with me for a long time. The receptionist was also very friendly and kind; it was really pleasant, thank you to her as well.

reviews.text: My husband and I chanced upon this beautifully aesthetic massage parlour when visiting the matcha shop next to it and decided to book a 2-hour package. Before starting, they give you a delicious rose lime sofa and ask you to fill up a form to list down your preferences for massage strength and areas to focus on more. We had our own private room that had a toilet and shower area and I proceeded to have the best massage of my life. I usually find massages painful and stressful as my muscles are quite tight and sensitive, but my masseuse Gift was very attentive throughout and would ask if the pressure was ok. It was perfect - I was so relaxed that I actually dozed off! After the massage we were given a bowl of yoghurt with fresh mango and delicious granola, and some tea. 10/10 would come back again.

reviews.name: Martha Medina
reviews.text:
I rarely leave negative reviews, but my recent experience here was uncomfortable and deeply disappointing.

As a larger-bodied person, I intentionally messaged the spa on Facebook Messenger ahead of time to confirm whether they could comfortably accommodate my frame and deliver a good massage. They assured me they could, but that was far from reality.

From the moment the session began, the staff was unprofessional. Before even starting, the therapist assigned to me openly said, “You’re so big!” and giggled. Throughout the entire session, she and a colleague kept whispering, exchanging comments, and giggling whenever she had to adjust or move my body. It felt deeply insulting and made what should have been a relaxing environment feel completely uncomfortable.

As for the massage itself, it was lacking in skill. The pressure felt completely random rather than targeted, and my lower back pain felt no better when I left.

The only positive takeaway is that they accept credit card payments.

In an area frequented by foreigners and people of all shapes and sizes, management really needs to train their therapists on basic professionalism and how to properly work with larger body frames. I strongly advise going somewhere else to get your money’s worth.

최악임. 승무원이라 호텔 근처라 가끔 멀리가기 귀찮을 때 받는데 받을 때마다 만족한 적이 없음. 이번엔 1시간만 받겠다했는데 본인들 실수로 1시간 반 금액 받고 한시간 10분째에 왜 안 끝내냐니까 그제서야 1시간반 아니야? 하고 환불 못해준다하는 .. 마사지사들은 졸면서 하고 딴 데 보고 떠들면서하는 최악의 마사지샵 ㅠ 다른 데 가셔요들 여기 좀 그만 갑시다 저희 ㅠㅠ 크루 할인도 없는 수준으로 적고 현금 결제만 되는 곳인데 .. 다른데는 크루할인 30-50%해줘요ㅠㅠ

와 써놓고 최신순 다른 리뷰들 보니 저한테만 이렇게 시간 속여 계산한 게 아니었네요 ㅋㅋ 마사지사 별로인 건 뭐 사바사니까 그러려니했는데 여긴 진짜 가면 안 되겠어요 ㅎ
reviews.textTranslated:
It's the absolute worst. Since I'm a flight attendant and the hotel is nearby, I get massages here occasionally when I'm too lazy to go far, but I've never been satisfied. This time, I said I'd only get an hour, but due to their mistake, they charged me for an hour and a half. When I asked why they weren't finishing at the one-hour and ten-minute mark, they finally asked, "Isn't it supposed to be an hour and a half?" and refused to give me a refund. It's the worst massage shop ever; the masseuses doze off while working and chatter away. Please go somewhere else, everyone. Let's stop going here. The crew discount is practically non-existent, and they only accept cash... Other places give 30-50% crew discounts.

Wow, after writing this, I looked at other reviews sorted by newest and realized I wasn't the only one who got cheated on the bill like this. I used to let the masseuses be a matter of personal preference, but I really shouldn't go here anymore.

reviews.text:
素晴らしい体験でした。
ニックさんのマッサージは、今までに体験したことのない独特なリズムがあり、繊細なタッチと相まってとても心地良い気分になれました。
私自身もセラピストをしていて、いつもはマッサージで完全にリラックスすることが難しいので、新鮮な感覚でした。
力加減やお部屋の温度によく気を配ってくれたり、私の拙いタイ語を注意して聞き取ってお話してくれたりと、楽しく快適な時間を過ごしました。
強くおすすめ
reviews.textTranslated:
It was a wonderful experience.
Nick's massage had a unique rhythm unlike anything I've ever experienced before, and combined with his delicate touch, it made me feel incredibly comfortable.
As a therapist myself, I usually find it difficult to fully relax during massages, so this was a refreshing experience.
He paid close attention to the pressure and room temperature, and even listened carefully to my broken Thai, making for a pleasant and comfortable time.
Highly recommended.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
素敵なレビューをありがとうございます！🥰💖

reviews.name: ארז נחשון
reviews.text:
The couples massage was absolutely
terrible.

We had two therapists who looked like they were barely teenagers. I would be very surprised if they actually have professional
massage therapist diplomas.

They entered our private room while we were showering — without knocking, without asking for permission, and without any invitation whatsoever. This was completely unacceptable and made us feel extremely uncomfortable and violated.

When the massage started - I could immediately feel the unprofessionalism and lack of experience of these kids.

Poor technique, no support for the legs, and bad attitude. Zero English, zero Thai - NO COMMUNICATION.

therapist actually laughed when I told him in Thai (I speak Thai) that he was hurting me. He then continued to hurt me.

On top of that, during the massage I asked him to change the treatment from deep tissue to focusing only on my shoulders and neck. He completely ignored my request and continued touching my lower back, which made me even more uncomfortable.

I asked to stop about 10 minutes after the massage started.

After we asked to stop, and went downstairs to the reception, I requested a refund. The receptionist said, “Here is your refund.” Then I was shocked to see that she had refunded us only a quarter of the amount we had paid.

I asked her what the hell that was about, and she said, “We only refund the person who complained. It seemed like your girlfriend was enjoying her massage.”

What incredible nerve.

Only after I made a scene (which I genuinely did not want to do, but I felt I had no choice) did we receive half of the total amount back, and we left.
Extremely disappointing, especially because their price is also so much more expensive than other , better massage shops in chiang mai.
Stay away from this place like the plague.

Unprofessional massage and a disgusting attitude of business owner.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
We are forced to publicly address your review, as it contains deliberate fabrications that unfairly damage our business reputation and insult our hardworking staff.
To be absolutely clear, here are the facts:
1. Therapist Qualifications: Your derogatory claim that our therapists are "uncertified teenagers" is completely unacceptable. Every single therapist at our establishment is an adult professional who is fully trained, certified, and legally registered with the Thai Department of Health Service Support (สพส.14). We do not employ uncertified staff, and we will firmly defend our team against baseless defamation.
2. The 15-Minute Policy & Timeline: You stated that you asked to stop after 10 minutes due to dissatisfaction. However, our policy—which is clearly stated on the pre-massage questionnaire you filled out and visibly posted on the door of the treatment room—explicitly informs guests that they may request to change their therapist within the first 15 minutes if they are unsatisfied. You did not notify anyone or request a change within this timeframe. Instead, our service records clearly show you chose to continue the session and only stopped after exactly 30 minutes of your scheduled 60-minute Deep Tissue Oil Massage.
3. The Refund: Because you consumed exactly half of the service without utilizing our clearly stated 15-minute change policy, you received a 50% refund. Demanding a 100% refund after receiving 30 minutes of a physical treatment is entirely unreasonable, and creating a disturbance at our reception to pressure our staff into giving you more money is unacceptable behavior.
We take privacy and customer comfort very seriously, but given the proven falsehoods in your review regarding the timeline and our staff's legal certifications, we strongly question the validity of your remaining claims.
We welcome genuine, honest feedback, but we will not tolerate malicious reviews based on distorted facts. We agree that it is best for you to seek services elsewhere in the future.

Our luxury spa services near Sathorn include Thai massage, aromatherapy, reflexology, hot stone massage, lymphatic drainage, prenatal massage, facials, body exfoliation, and botanical head rituals. Experience full relaxation with wellness packages like the White Wood Green Restorative Day and enjoy nourishing refreshments at our on-site café, all curated to support holistic wellbeing.
